title: Data Engineer
description:
Chubb's PRS Data Science team builds data pipelines and analytical solutions that power predictive models directly supporting our insurance products and business partners. We operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where engineers own work end-to-end—from ingestion and transformation to delivery of production-ready datasets consumed by data scientists and decision-makers across the organization.

We are looking for an early to mid-career Data Engineer who is passionate about building reliable, scalable pipelines and who thrives at the intersection of engineering and business impact.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain production ETL pipelines for predictive modeling workloads.

  • Develop and optimize PySpark jobs on Databricks, ensuring performance and reliability at scale.

  • Write complex, well-structured SQL for data transformation, validation, and reporting across SQL Server, Synapse Analytics, and Snowflake.

  • Collaborate with data scientists to understand data requirements and translate them into robust engineering solutions.

  • Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot failures, and implement improvements to data quality and observability.

  • Document data flows, schemas, and pipeline logic to maintain institutional knowledge.

  • Present project progress, architecture decisions, and results to business stakeholders in a clear, concise manner.

  • Partner with platform and cloud engineering teams on Azure infrastructure and Databricks workspace management.

Technical Skills

  • Python: Expert-level proficiency; strong command of data engineering libraries (pandas, PySpark, SQLAlchemy), code quality practices, and packaging.

  • SQL: Expert-level; able to write complex analytical queries, window functions, CTEs, and performance-tune queries across multiple platforms.

  • Apache Spark / PySpark: Comfortable developing and debugging distributed data processing jobs; understands Spark execution model and optimization basics.

  • Databricks: Hands-on experience with notebooks, Delta Lake, Jobs/Workflows, and cluster configuration.

  • Azure: Working experience with core Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, or equivalent).

  • SQL Server & Synapse Analytics: Experience querying and loading data; understanding of schema design and indexing strategies.

  • Snowflake: Practical experience with Snowflake warehousing, data loading patterns, and role-based access.

  • Windows: Comfortable working in a Windows-based development environment.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • 2-4 years of professional experience in a data engineering, analytics engineering, or software engineering role with a significant data focus.

Soft Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to present technical concepts to non-technical business audiences.

  • Collaborative team player who engages proactively with data scientists, analysts, and business partners.

  • Detail-oriented with a bias toward clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.

  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced delivery environment.

Nice To Have

  • CLI tools: Familiarity with shell scripting, command-line data tools, and working in Linux environments.

  • Version control: Experience with Git-based workflows in a team setting.

  • Orchestration: Exposure to workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory pipelines, Databricks Workflows).

  • Insurance / financial services domain: Prior experience in a regulated industry is a plus but not required.

  • CI/CD: Familiarity with automated testing and deployment pipelines for data assets.

The pay range for the role is $82,000 to $92,000. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. Chubb offers a comprehensive benefits package, more details on which can be found on our careers website. The disclosed pay range estimate may be adjusted for the applicable geographic differential for the location in which the position is filled.

Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org. IFC, a member of the World Bank Group, is the largest global development institution focused on the private sector in emerging markets. IFC’s Blended Finance team combines concessional contributor resources with IFC financing to address market barriers, catalyze private investment, and support high-impact projects while preserving market discipline and minimizing concessionality. The team manages bilateral, multilateral, thematic, regional, and country facilities across their full lifecycle—from design and contributor agreements through pipeline development, deployment, portfolio monitoring, reporting, evaluation, and closure—in close coordination with IFC operational and corporate teams. Portfolio Management, Reporting and Knowledge Management • In coordination with BF investment and operations officers, monitor implementation status of individual investments; • In collaboration with portfolio officer/relevant IOs, track implementation of investment projects; • Maintain up to date records of these projects. In that context and under the supervision of BF IOs and OOs, liaise with relevant staff to identify and monitor weaknesses, risks and early warning signals in the portfolio of contributor-funded projects to assess progress and performance; • Contribute to the analysis and processing of client requests, including disbursements, waivers, and amendments related to the contributor-funded co-investments; • Prepare reports and presentations on the portfolio's performance for internal and external audiences; • Contribute to team's knowledge management activities, communication products, and sharing information and lessons of CBF projects with internal and external stakeholders;

The Facilities Management Team at Lancashire County Council are looking to recruit a Casual Cleaning Operative who is required to carry out cleaning duties in the Preston area.

The Government has confirmed that local government across Lancashire will be reorganised, with the current 15 councils being replaced by four new unitary councils covering North, South, East and West Lancashire from April 2028.

If you are successful in your application, you will initially join Lancashire County Council. However, as part of the planned transition, your employment will transfer to one of the new unitary councils from April 2028, subject to the implementation of the reorganisation and relevant employment legislation.

title: Senior Claims Director-CDH

  • Direct and closely monitor assignments to experts and defense counsel subject to established guidelines.
  • Provide superior customer service to insureds, agents, and internal business partners.

  • Travels to conferences, mediations, and trials as necessary.

Qualifications

  • 5-10+ years of experience as a casualty claim professional handling complex high exposure casualty claims with emphasis on hands-on file and litigation management.
  • Experience with primary and excess bodily injury, property damage, and personal injury claims.
  • Strong background and demonstrated ability in dealing with significant coverage matters.
  • Working knowledge of industry best practices and procedures.
  • An ability to work independently and assimilate learning materials on many different subjects from various sources.
  • Excellent interpersonal communications and negotiation skills; and an ability to deal with customers and business partners in a professional manner.

title: Construction and Facilities Specialist
description:

Every piercing is performed by licensed nurses and guided by our Rowan Clinical Piercing Standard® and paired with our hypoallergenic products, setting a clear standard that is differentiated from traditional retail models. Our goal is to create a destination where customers feel confident, cared for, and excited to participate.

Rowan is seeking a Construction + Facilities Specialist to support our growing store fleet (currently 100+ locations) and Construction + Facilities team members. In this dual-function operational role, you will serve as the backbone for both our Construction Project Managers and Facility Managers. The Construction + Facilities Specialist will bridge the gap between active studio build outs, project close out, and ongoing studio maintenance.

What you'll do:

Construction Project Administration & Closeouts

  • Closeout Package Management: Oversee the construction close out process to collect, review, audit, and organize all General Contractor closeout deliverables. Including executed unconditional lien waivers, AIA documents, warranties, as-built drawings, operations manuals, and attic stock records.

  • Tenant Allowance (TA/TIA) Draws: Manage the tenant Improvement Allowance reimbursement process to Landlords. Interpret commercial lease requirements for submission and eligibility. Tracking submittals through payment receipt.

  • Invoice & Budget Processing: Review, analyze, and track construction invoices/pay applications against project budget, following up with stakeholders as required for timely invoicing + swift project closeout.

  • Utilities Onboarding & Transfers: Coordinate utility setups, meter sets, account activations, and billing transfers (power, gas, water, internet) for new studio buildouts and lease turnovers.

  • Body Art & Health Compliance Coordination: Partner with the Licensing, Regulation + Leasing Administrator, Project Manager and General Contractor to evaluate physical build out requirements associated with health inspections and body art regulations.

    • Facilities & New Studio Turnover Coordination

    • New Studio Turnover Services: Schedule and coordinate pre-opening vendor walk-throughs and turnover scopes for newly completed builds, including post-construction deep cleaning, professional window cleaning, and initial HVAC inspections/filter changes.

    • Invoice & Budget Processing: Review,track, and analyze Facilities invoices against contract rates + allocated budget, following up with stakeholders as required for timely invoicing.

    • Preventative Maintenance Scheduling: Assist in evaluating and managing routine recurring services across the fleet, including HVAC maintenance contracts, fire protection, and pest control, following up with vendors as required for timely invoicing. Engage with vendor(s) to initiate new contract addendums for new studios as they open.

    • Vendor & Contract Management: Maintain organized vendor contracts and track insurance certificates (COIs) for all trade partners.

    • Facilities Work Order Platform: In coordination with the Senior Facilities Manager, maintain and update all data for active studios + active vendor partners.

Experience we're looking for:

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in a similar position (Project Coordinator, Facilities Coordinator, Retail Store Operations or Commercial Real Estate Administration)

  • Working knowledge of commercial construction processes, standard closeout documentation (lien waivers, certificates of occupancy), and landlord tenant allowance collections.

  • Familiarity with retail facility maintenance, commercial service trades (cleaning, HVAC, plumbing), or health department/body art permitting is a strong plus.

  • High proficiency in digital tools: Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides), Microsoft Excel, and project/work order management software.

  • Strong organizational, tracking, and detail-oriented skills with high accuracy in handling financial paperwork, vendor invoices, and compliance records.

  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to interface diplomatically with general contractors, commercial landlords, field teams, and external trades.

  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with the agility to shift between structured construction deadlines and urgent day-to-day facilities needs.

Full-Time Benefits + Perks

  • Medical/Dental/Vision Health Plans

  • Short and Long-term Disability

  • Life Insurance

  • 401k and Roth IRA Plans

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Open PTO policy

title: Åbent opslag – fire nye medlemmer til De Videnskabsetiske Medicinske Komitéer – både lægmedlemmer og forskningsaktive
description:
Har du lyst til at bidrage til vurderingen af videnskabsetiske aspekter i ansøgninger om kliniske forsøg med lægemidler og kliniske afprøvninger af medicinsk udstyr inden for sundhedsvidenskabelig forskning?

National Center for Etik (NCE) får fremadrettet mulighed for at indstille medlemmer til De Videnskabsetiske Medicinske Komitéer. Vi søger derfor interesserede, engagerede forskningsaktive og lægpersoner, der har lyst til at indgå i komitéerne.

Medlemmerne vil blive udpeget til komitéerne af sundheds- og kirkeministeren med henblik på tiltrædelse januar 2027

De Videnskabsetiske Medicinske Komitéer
De Videnskabsetiske Medicinske Komitéer (VMK) behandler ansøgninger om kliniske forsøg med lægemidler og kliniske afprøvninger af medicinsk udstyr og vurderer, om forskningsforsøg lever op til gældende videnskabsetiske krav. Derudover følger VMK udviklingen inden for sundhedsvidenskabelig forskning, bidrager til den offentlige og faglige debat om videnskabsetiske spørgsmål, udarbejder vejledende retningslinjer og samarbejder med nationale og internationale myndigheder og organisationer.

Komitéerne sekretariatsbetjenes af National Center for Etik (NCE).

De Videnskabsetiske Medicinske Komitéers sammensætning
Der er fire Videnskabsetiske Medicinske Komitéer. Hver komité består af 8 medlemmer samt én suppleant.

Ved udpegningen skal det sikres, at komitéen samlet består af:

  • 4 lægmedlemmer, og
  • 4 medlemmer, der er aktive inden for sundhedsvidenskabelig forskning

Medlemmerne udpeges af sundheds- og kirkeministeren på følgende måde:

  • 1 formand udpeges af sundheds – og kirkeministeren og skal være aktiv inden for sundhedsvidenskabelig forskning
  • 4 medlemmer udpeges efter indstilling fra regionsrådene
  • 2 medlemmer udpeges efter indstilling fra organisationer, der repræsenterer patienter (Danske Patienter og Danske Handicaporganisationer)
  • 1 medlem udpeges efter indstilling fra Nationalt Center for Etik (NCE).

Dette åbne opslag har til formål at finde medlemmer, som kan indstilles fra Nationalt Center for Etik (NCE) med henblik på ministerens udpegning af i alt fire medlemmer – én til hver af de fire Videnskabsetiske Medicinske Komitéer.

Sådan arbejder VMK

  • Hver komité mødes ca. hver 4. onsdag kl. 13-17 i lokaler på Statens Serum Institut. I ferieperioder eller enkeltstående situationer, kan mødet foregå virtuelt.
  • Der behandles ca. 10-14 sager pr. møde.
  • Mødematerialet tilgås via online platform 6 dage før mødet.
  • Mødematerialet består af fx protokol, rekrutteringsmateriale, deltagerinformation mv. Derudover forbereder sekretariatet sagen grundigt frem til mødets afholdelse og udarbejder en skriftlig sagsfremstilling, som udsendes sammen med mødematerialet.
  • Komitéens medlemmer indgår på lige vilkår. Det forventes, at man bidrager aktivt og møder resten af medlemmerne med en lyttende og dialogbaseret tilgang, herunder at man er nysgerrig på hinandens perspektiver. Sekretariatet bistår komitéen i behandlingen af sagen.
  • Det forventes, at medlemmerne forbereder sig forud for mødet. Det er individuelt, hvor meget forberedelsestid et medlem har brug for, men 4-10 timer pr. møde må påregnes.
  • En del af mødematerialet foreligger på engelsk, hvorfor det er nødvendigt at kunne læse og forstå akademisk engelsk.
  • Der udbetales et fast vederlag på ca. 2.000 kr. pr. komitémøde medlemmet deltager i. Der er derudover mulighed for dækning af transportudgifter.

Relevante kompetencer
Der søges både nye lægpersoner og forskningsaktive medlemmer.

Forskningsaktive medlemmer:
Et forskningsaktivt medlem er en person, der aktuelt er aktiv inden for sundhedsvidenskabelig forskning, og som fx er ansat i en forskningsstilling som adjunkt, lektor, professor eller underviser inden for et sundhedsvidenskabeligt eller sundhedsfagligt område.

De forskningsaktive medlemmer bidrager til at vurdere, om et klinisk forsøg er videnskabeligt og sundhedsfagligt forsvarligt at gennemføre, og om forsøgets formål og endepunkter står mål med de risici og den belastning, som forsøgsdeltagerne udsættes for.

Lægmedlemmer:
Et lægmedlem er en person, der ikke aktuelt er tilknyttet en sundhedsprofession. En tidligere sygeplejerske, laborant eller social- og sundhedsassistent kan derfor godt være lægmedlem, hvis vedkommende ikke længere er ansat i sundhedsvæsenet, lægemiddelindustrien eller lignende.

Lægmedlemmet skal repræsentere den brede offentlighed og varetage forsøgsdeltagernes interesser. Lægmedlemmet skal bidrage til at sikre, at sundhedsvidenskabelig forskning respekterer deltagernes rettigheder, sikkerhed og trivsel. Derudover skal lægmedlemmet vurdere, om forsøget er forståeligt og etisk forsvarligt set fra en almindelig borgers perspektiv.

De fire Videnskabsetiske Medicinske Komitéer er bredt sammensat.

For de forskningsaktive medlemmer kan forskningsmæssig erfaring inden for følgende fagområder være relevant:

  • Akutmedicin, pædiatri, psykiatri, infektionsmedicin, autoimmune sygdomme, kræftbehandling, cancerimmunterapi, avancerede terapier herunder CAR-T-celleterapi og genterapi. Derudover vil erfaring med kunstig intelligens i sundhedsforskning og klinisk praksis være relevant.

For lægmedlemmerne kan erfaring og interesse inden for følgende områder være relevant:

  • Patient- og pårørendeinddragelse i kliniske forsøg, erhvervserfaring med borgerkontakt inden for fx ældreområdet eller psykiatrien, komitéarbejde i landets regionale videnskabsetiske komitéer.

Der bestræbes en ligelig kønsfordeling samt ligelig geografisk placering, og man vil ved udpegningen have et ønske om, at komitéerne sammensættes under hensyn til denne balance.

Yderligere information
Yderligere information om De Videnskabsetiske Medicinske Komitéer kan findes her og om den videnskabsetisk vurdering her og ved henvendelse til specialkonsulent, Vibeke Mindahl Rafa på VIBMR@dketik.dk eller tlf. 72216212.

description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong technical and communication skills to contribute throughout the development lifecycle of products in various exciting domains, which are realized with Commencis’ expertise in a fast-paced team environment.
If you are curious by nature, adaptive, collaborative, and always one step ahead, then join us and be a Commencer!

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and high-performance backend systems using Java and Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, etc.)
  • Contribute to system architecture decisions and lead the design of both monolithic and microservices-based solutions
  • Develop and maintain Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layers and core backend services to support scalable applications
  • Strong understanding of design principles, design patterns, and architectural best practices (DDD, TDD, and layered architecture)
  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs and ensure high availability and performance
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and QA to deliver high-quality solutions
  • Ensure code quality through code reviews, best practices, and clean code principles
  • Write and maintain unit and integration tests
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing systems
  • Participate in CI/CD processes and support deployment activities
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to team knowledge sharing
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry best practices

Qualifications

  • BSc/MSc/PhD degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in backend development with Java Strong experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of OOP principles, design patterns, and scalable system design
  • Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Hands-on experience with relational and non-relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ) is a plus
  • Basic knowledge of front-end technologies such as JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3
  • Strong unit test and debugging skills
  • Proficiency in code versioning tools such as Git
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices is a plus
  • Strong sense of analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Highly effective time management and multitasking skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Experience with AI technologies and a strong interest in learning and applying them in real-world use cases
  • Proficiency in AI-assisted development practices, with the ability to effectively integrate AI tools into daily software development workflows.
  • Experience or domain knowledge in banking and financial services is considered a plus
Why Commencis?
We want people to thrive at Commencis. Here’s what Commencers like about working here:
Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We offer a competitive salary, private health insurance, pension and retirement plans through a company-backed pension system, meal card, commute compensation, work-from-home support, and a paid birthday off.
Happier Weekdays: We offer flexible working hours, including a remote working option. Enjoy online events, guest speakers, office refreshments, a meeting-light culture, and many more perks to enhance your weekdays.
Never Stop Learning: We support learning and development programs for almost anything. Additionally, we provide access to leading online e-learning platforms like Udemy and various libraries.
Community & Socials: We are a tight-knit community that loves gathering together. Our social activities include happy hours, workshops, a New Year party, breakfast & lunch get-togethers, movie nights, and our Summer Festival.
Open Culture: We maintain a flat organizational structure with a culture of direct and open communication. We value Commencers’ voices and address any suggestions and questions you may have.
About Commencis
Join us in paving the way for a thriving digital society!
Commencis has more than two decades of expertise in the world of experience design, software engineering and cloud technologies. Our products and solutions are used by leading brands in financial services, insurance, airlines and retail in more than 20 countries.
We help our clients around the globe to commence their next evolution and pave the way for a thriving digital society. We love discovering what’s next. We value collaboration, curiosity, and an open mindset at work.
If you share the same passion with our fellow Commencers, then let us unleash your world-class potential!
We will process your personal data as part of our recruitment procedures. To find out more, please consult our Candidate Privacy Notices.

title: Lab Pack Operations Supervisor

title: Part-Time: Community Recreation Specialist
description:
Salary: $18.09 -$21.85 per hour (GS.5)

Work Hours: Monday - Thursday, 10:00 A.M. - 3:00 P.M. (EST)
*Hours may vary due to work assignments, projects, or events. Occasional evenings and weekends.*

Work Location: 1102 South Watkins Street, Chattanooga, TN

FLSA Status: This is a Non-Exempt position.

Department: Parks & Outdoors

CLASSIFICATION SUMMARY:

Incumbents in this classification are responsible for instructing and participating in daily recreation and art activities for diverse populations including children, adults and seniors. Duties include coaching and/or officiating sporting events; organizing and leading outdoor activities; conducting administrative tasks such as creating program attendance reports, reserving facilities and creating marketing materials; may collect fees for programs or facilities usage and may train and oversee volunteer staff. Work is performed with moderate supervision.

SERIES LEVEL:

The Recreation Specialist is a stand-alone position

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
(The following duties ARE NOT intended to serve as a comprehensive list of all duties performed by all employees in this classification, only a representative summary of the primary duties and responsibilities. Incumbent(s) may not be required to perform all duties listed and may be required to perform additional, position-specific duties.)

Assists in planning, preparing, coordinating and facilitating a wide variety of recreational events, classes and/or activities which may include supervising patrons; reserving facilities and/or transportation; procuring supplies; scheduling events, classes and/or activities; developing promotional and marketing materials; preparing rosters; setting up sites; monitoring events and/or performing other related activities.

Performs tasks related to routine day-to-day operations including inventory maintenance activities and monitoring sites and facilities for potential safety hazards.

Responds to requests for information or complaints over the phone and in person regarding recreation programs, processes, procedures, events and/or activities.

Serves as a liaison with program participants and sponsors.

Performs routine clerical work.

Registers participants for programs, events and/or classes; receives and processes applications and fees; maintains related records and information.

May be required to use, carry and answer their cell phone as determined by their job duties and the department head.

Must meet regular attendance requirements.

Must be able to maintain good interpersonal relationships with staff, co-workers, managers and citizens.

Must accomplish the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodations, in a timely manner.

Performs other duties as assigned.

DEPARTMENT SPECIFIC DUTIES (if any):

Grant coordinator for Southeast Tennessee Area Agency on Aging and Disability (SETAAAD), attend SETAAAD meetings and conferences. Schedule annual Health Promotion classes and evidence-based workshops. These classes and workshops provide participants with structured activities that include group discussions, problem-solving, skill building, assertiveness training, videos, sharing practical solutions and exercise training.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Three (3) years of any combination of relevant education, training or experience sufficient to perform the essential duties of the job will be considered; or any combination of equivalent experience and education. Examples of relevant experience include recreation programming work and outdoor recreation instruction in areas such as whitewater kayaking.

LICENSING AND CERTIFICATIONS:

Ability to obtain First Aid/CPR Certification or certifications specific to area of assignment.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

Knowledge of basic recreation operations in assigned areas of responsibility; record keeping methods and procedures; customer service principles; modern office procedures and inventory maintenance principles.

Skill in providing customer service; using a computer and related software applications; maintaining records; operating modern office equipment; monitoring and maintaining inventory; communication and interpersonal skills as applied to interaction with coworkers, supervisor, and the general public, sufficient to exchange or convey information and to receive work direction.

Our Community Recreation programs are designed to provide children with safe, positive, educational, and enjoyable recreational experiences.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Positions in this class typically require climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, fingering, grasping, feeling, talking, hearing, seeing, and repetitive motions.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Medium Work: Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. extreme temperatures

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:

Safety Sensitive: Y
Department of Transportation - CDL: N
Child Sensitive: Y

SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION:

This position requires pre-employment screening(s) that include: background check / drug screening / lift test

title: Prosjektstøtte/PMO
description:
Om prosjektet:

Kodeverk har blitt brukt til å få oversikt over sykdommer og dødsårsaker i befolkningen i århundre. ICD - International Classification of Diseases - ble utgitt av Verdens Helseorganisasjon (WHO) for første gang på begynnelsen av 1900-tallet. ICD-10 som brukes i Norge i dag, ble utgitt i 1992. Den brukes globalt for diagnosekoding og sykdoms- og dødsårsaksstatistikk, og er nå oppgradert til ICD-11 etter en omfattende internasjonal revisjon. Norge har siden 1967 vært forpliktet til å bruke siste versjon av ICD ved rapportering til WHO. ICD-10 ble tatt i bruk i Norge fra 1997 til 1999. I 2022 ble den ellevte revisjonen av ICD lansert. I tillegg til den medisinskfaglige oppgraderingen, er kodeverket nå heldigitalisert for moderne bruk, forvaltning og samhandling.

Helsedirektoratet ser for seg å ta ansvar for å oversette, tilgjengeliggjøre, tilrettelegge og koordinere oppgraderingen til ICD-11, samt fortsette pågående kommunikasjonsarbeid om ICD-11, mens det ligger an til at virksomhetene i sektor vil få ansvar for å kartlegge konsekvenser lokalt ved oppgraderingen, klargjøre for den og å ta i bruk ICD-11 når den er tilgjengelig.

Bistanden som skal utføres

Behov/oppdrag:

I arbeidet med overgang til ICD-11, er Helsedirektoratet avhengig av samarbeid med helsesektoren og andre interessehavere. Konkret vil dette innebære møteplasser med interessehaverne for å koordinere nødvendige innsatsområder. Helsedirektoratet ønsker å videreføre dette arbeidet i 2027, ved å bruke etablerte samarbeidsarenaer med representanter fra relevante aktører i sektor. Helsedirektoratet vil koordinere og fasilitere arbeidet. Videre planlegges det med mindre utprøvinger.

For å sikre tilstrekkelig kapasitet til dette arbeidet har Helsedirektoratet behov for en dyktig prosjektstøtteressurs (PMO) med solid erfaring som med prosjektadministrative oppgaver i 100%-stilling i til ICD-11-prosjektet.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Rollen innebærer blant annet å bidra med:

  • Utvikle og kommunisere administrative prosesser, rutiner og maler​

  • Koordinere arbeidet med styrende dokumenter, planer og årlige planrevisjoner​

  • Fasilitere prosessene med å forberede og utarbeide presentasjoner basert på prosjektledergruppens faglige innspill, til møtefora internt og eksternt. Videre å kalle inn til og holde i disse møteforaene administrativt, samt å utarbeide referat

  • Bistå prosjektleder i arbeidet med å følge opp og rapportere prosjektet som helhet internt og eksternt herunder økonomi, fremdrift og risiko​

  • Koordinere prosjektets prosesser for risikostyring

  • Håndtere og administrere saker og kanaler på teams/SharePoint

  • Håndtere alle kommersielle avtaler med relevante leverandører i tråd med direktoratets retningslinjer​

  • Etablere oversikt over og plan for samarbeid med interessehavere, herunder koordinere informasjons-, kommunikasjons- og forankringsaktiviteter med ulike ​aktører

  • Koordinere prosjektets ressursbruk med Virksomhetsplan for linjen​

  • Bistå prosjektet i planlegging og gjennomføringen av for eksempel arrangementer, møter, seminarer osv.

  • Delta i og eventuelt lede mindre utprøvingsprosjekter.

Det kan tilkomme andre arbeidsoppgaver underveis i utførelsen av arbeidet.

Rollen rapporterer til prosjektleder og skal utøves i tråd med gjeldende føringer og beslutninger fra prosjektleder og prosjekteier. I tillegg til å jobbe tett med prosjektlederen vil rollen samarbeide tett med nøkkelroller og andre fagressurser som deltar i prosjektet både internt og eksternt.

Konsulenten som gjennomfører oppdraget, vil bli pålagt taushetsplikt. All dokumentasjon skjer på norsk. Arbeidsspråket er i hovedsak norsk, men engelsk vil forekomme.

Kompetanse/erfaring

Absolutte krav

  • Min. 3-7 års erfaring

  • Tilbudt konsulenten må ha høyere utdanning på universitets-/høgskolenivå.

  • Tilbudt konsulenten må ha minimum 5 års erfaring fra prosjektarbeid og/eller prosjektstøttearbeid​ (PMO).

  • Tilbudte konsulenten må ha erfaring som prosessdriver.

  • Tilbudte konsulent(er) skal ha erfaring med bruk av verktøyene i Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint)

  • Tilbudt konsulent skal være tilgjengelighet og tid for oppstart og Opsjon, ref. bilag 3.

Evalueringskrav

  • Tilbudte konsulenten bør ha erfaring fra helsesektoren, fortrinnsvis innenfor IKT/digitalisering.

  • Tilbudte konsulenten bør ha 2 års erfaring i rollen som PMO/prosjektstøtte.

  • Tilbudte konsulenten bør ha relevant erfaring med administrasjon – herunder administrere møtefora internt og eksternt, bistå med rapportering og håndtering av interessenter.

  • Tilbudte konsulent bør ha erfaring fra tidligere relevante prosjekter

Oppstart: 14.12.2026 avtales endelig ved kontraktsinngåelse. Inngåelse av kontrakt forutsetter bevilgning til prosjektet for 2027 fra Helse- og omsorgsdepartementet. Prosjektet er høyt prioritert i Helsedirektoratet.

Varighet: til 24.12.2027

Omfang: 100%

Opsjon: 2 x 6 mnd

Arbeidssted: Oslo

Søknadsfrist: 13. november 2026

title: Stock Manager - York Vangarde (N133341)
description:
SHIFTS YOU ARE APPLYING FOR: 35.50hrs p/w; Mon 14:00 - 21:00; Tue 09:00 - 17:00; Thu 10:00 - 18:00; Fri 07:00 - 14:00; Sat 12:00 - 20:00

To be an effective Stock Manager, you will lead and inspire your successful team to prioritise achieving performance targets. Every day will be varied, fast paced, challenging but ultimately rewarding. People are at the heart of what we do so your experience in providing leadership, coaching and motivating a team will be crucial to your success. You can count on us to invest in your personal development from day one. Flexible working options are available.


About the Role:

The Stock Manager supports the growth of our online business and ensures our customers get the very best online experience and customer service we can offer. You will support and encourage your team to meet performance targets, ensuring our customers get returned items refunded quickly or stock is packaged and ready to fulfil existing online orders.

To be a successful Stock Manager you will:

  • Support the Store management team across the back of house areas and communicate effectively with the Store Manager
  • Manage a team to deliver accurate stock processes in an environment which is operationally efficient, safe and where targets are met
  • Create an atmosphere where supporting, motivating and inspiring your team to be at their best is at the core of everything you do
  • Demonstrate a hands-on approach for all commercial and operational activities by adapting to change and working alongside the team
  • Ensure communication is up-to-date and accurate at all times in order to meet business needs

We’ll offer amazing benefits (see list further below)


About You:

  • You are passionate about our customers, our people and our products. The passion and energetic approach to work inspires and motivates others creating a great work atmosphere and team spirit
  • You are a great communicator who is friendly, calm and efficient and can work naturally with people at all levels. You stay calm and approachable even under pressure - always realistic with your expectations of others
  • A team player who works at their best in a result driven, fast and challenging environment. You have the ability to adapt and change quickly, bringing the rest of the team onboard with new objectives
  • Able to demonstrate the ability to problem solve, make sound business decisions, confidently challenge processes and generate innovative ideas to take the business forward
  • An effective multi tasker who can plan, organise and prioritise your workload

In accordance with Home Office guidance successful candidates will be required to evidence their right to work in the UK before commencement of employment.

This role is not one we would typically consider for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route due to, for example, the relevant Home Office requirements on skills level, not being met. Candidates are therefore encouraged to consider their own right to work options without Next sponsorship.

What’s Next

Our in store recruitment team will review the successfully completed online applications - those that match the job criteria closest will be contacted to arrange a Telephone or Video Interview so we can have a chat to find out more about you as a person. This may progress to an instore Assessment.

title: Automotive Flat Rate Detail Technician
description:
Automotive Flat Rate Detail Technician

Position Summary

The Automotive Flat Rate Detail Technician is responsible for cleaning, reconditioning, and detailing customer and dealership vehicles to established quality standards. This position is compensated on a flat-rate pay system, with earnings based on completed detailing services. The technician must work efficiently while maintaining high-quality results and ensuring customer satisfaction.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform complete interior and exterior vehicle detailing.
  • Wash, dry, wax, buff, and polish vehicle surfaces.
  • Shampoo carpets, clean upholstery, and condition interior components.
  • Remove stains, odors, and minor cosmetic imperfections.
  • Clean windows, mirrors, wheels, tires, and door jambs.
  • Apply paint sealants, dressings, and other protective treatments as required.
  • Inspect vehicles for cleanliness and quality before delivery.
  • Maintain detailing equipment, tools, and chemicals in safe operating condition.
  • Follow dealership safety policies and manufacturer guidelines.
  • Move and park vehicles as needed.
  • Communicate repair or appearance concerns to supervisors.
  • Meet daily production goals while maintaining quality standards.

Qualifications

  • Previous automotive detailing experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of detailing chemicals, tools, and equipment.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality.
  • Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to operate manual and automatic transmission vehicles preferred.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, and reach for extended periods.
  • Ability to safely operate detailing equipment, vacuums, buffers, and pressure washers.
  • Comfortable working in both climate-controlled and outdoor settings as weather conditions require.

Compensation

  • Flat-rate pay based on completed detailing services.
  • Earnings potential increases with productivity and efficiency.
  • Additional incentives or bonuses may be available based on performance and quality standards.

Skills and Competencies

  • Time management
  • Attention to detail
  • Quality workmanship
  • Dependability
  • Customer service focus
  • Team collaboration
  • Safety awareness

Job Type: Full-Time
Department: Reconditioning/Detail Department
Reports To: Detail Manager, Reconditioning Manager, or Service Manager

Equal Opportunity Employer: We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.

title: Manager II, Operations
description:
This is a key role which will oversee the operations and facilities functions within our regional office portfolio.

The position will be primarily responsible for supervising the day-to-day facilities management and building liaison within the office portfolio of your region.

The candidate will report to the Global Operations Director.

The candidate will be expected to assist with the managing of the relevant vendors for the office space as well as become involved in contract negotiation with external providers.

This position will be hybrid from one of our offices (Atlanta, Dallas, Nashville, Richardson or Austin).

Day-to-day responsibilities:

Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted business partner for all real estate, workplace, and facilities management matters across the assigned geographic region, ensuring consistent service delivery and operational excellence.

Partner with senior business leaders and stakeholders to understand current and future workplace requirements, proactively developing solutions that support business objectives and employee experience.

Lease Management & Administration

  • Support lease negotiations as necessary and renewals in collaboration with the Global Leasing Director.

  • Review and interpret lease agreements, construction work letters, maintenance agreements, tenant manuals, and related documentation to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and business requirements.

  • Manage building management relationships

Capital Projects & Workplace Strategy

  • Collaborate with the Global Head of Facilities Operations to deliver office fit-outs, relocations, refurbishments, workplace transformation initiatives, and space reconfigurations.

  • Conduct site inspections, monitor construction progress, manage snagging processes, validate completed work, approve project-related invoices, and ensure adherence to project timelines and specifications as necessary.

  • Coordinate with building management, contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless project delivery whether a relocation or as part of the new build team.

Project Governance & Documentation

  • Establish and maintain comprehensive project documentation within the global project repository, ensuring version control, accuracy, and accessibility of all project records.

  • Support project governance processes through effective reporting, tracking, and documentation management.

Facilities Operations Management

  • Oversee daily facilities operations across the regional real estate portfolio, ensuring a safe, efficient, and well-maintained working environment.

  • Monitor, prioritize, and resolve facilities-related requests and service issues in accordance with agreed service levels.

  • Identify opportunities to improve operational performance, service quality, cost efficiency, and employee workplace experience.

Vendor & Contract Management

  • Develop, negotiate, and manage service agreements for facilities-related services, including maintenance, storage, HVAC, security, and workplace support services.

  • Lead vendor selection, performance management, contract reviews, and commercial negotiations to ensure value, quality, and compliance.

  • Manage vendor relationships and resolve service, contractual, or payment-related issues.

Financial Management & Reporting

  • Review, approve, code, and process invoices in accordance with company policies and budget requirements.

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, including budget-versus-actual analyses, forecasts, and variance explanations.

  • Support departmental financial reviews and identify opportunities for cost optimization.

Health, Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements across the regional portfolio.

  • Partner with internal Health & Safety and Physical Security teams to coordinate risk assessments, audits, site inspections, certification programs, and remediation activities.

  • Implement recommendations and corrective actions arising from audits, inspections, and compliance reviews.

Workplace Services Leadership

  • Direct and coordinate workplace support functions, including reception, office services, facilities support, and business continuity requirements.

  • Lead the planning and delivery of office events, business meetings, employee engagement initiatives, and workplace-related activities as required.

Portfolio Management & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate portfolio data and operational reporting, including occupancy metrics, space utilization, capacity tracking, subtenant records, and other key performance indicators.

  • Analyze workplace data and trends to support strategic decision-making and portfolio optimization.

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal departments, business leaders, project teams, landlords, consultants, and external service providers.

  • Provide regular updates, strategic recommendations, and clear communication to stakeholders on operational, financial, and project-related matters.

  • Act as a key liaison between business units and corporate real estate functions to ensure alignment of priorities and successful outcomes.

Continuous Improvement & Strategic Initiatives

  • Identify and implement process improvements, operational efficiencies, and best practices across facilities and workplace operations.

  • Participate in regional and global initiatives, special projects, and transformation programs as assigned by the Global Head of Facilities Operations.

  • Support the evolution of workplace strategies to enhance employee experience, operational resilience, and portfolio performance.

Essential traits:

  • Experience managing real estate and facilities across multiple sites.

  • Experience managing real-estate and faculties service in-house for demanding clients.

  • Strong organizational and analytical skills; oral and written communication skills

  • Demonstrated ability in independent functioning.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field of study or Business Management

  • Knowledge of project management, lease administration, proficient in spreadsheet and database software applications. CAD or CAFM experience preferred.

  • Proven problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Good judgment and proven ability to effectively prioritize multiple tasks within a group environment.

  • Strong initiative to identify new processes for overall office efficiency.

  • Ability to accept direction and additional responsibilities from City Leader & Director of Global Real Estate & Facilities

  • Strong writing, organization and planning skills.

title: Software Development Engineer II, CloudWatch
description:
Come and build the future with us as we change the way the world sees the Cloud!

CloudWatch is the observability platform of AWS, built for developers, system operators, site reliability engineers (SRE), and IT managers. CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications and services that run on AWS, and on-premises servers. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for a software development engineer at the start of their career to help create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 68 quadrillion metric observations per month! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
• Design and develop scalable solutions using cloud-native architectures and microservices in a large distributed computing environment.
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation.
• Build and maintain resilient distributed systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, and cost-effective.
• Leverage and contribute to the development of GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity while staying current with emerging technologies.
• Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
• Expand our services across all AWS Regions, and when issues arise, dive deep to understand the root cause and apply fixes that prevent them recurring.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Early Careers: Technical Content DevOps Developer
description:
Early Careers: Technical Content DevOps Developer

Location: Burnaby, BC, Canada (in-office)

Type: Full-time

Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with more than two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. Our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are looking for a recent graduate to join us as an Early Careers: Technical Content DevOps Developer and help build the AI-powered tools and pipelines behind our technical content.

You will join the Technical Content team, which creates documentation and training for Fortinet’s cybersecurity products. Our documentation is published to the Fortinet Document Library at , and our training content is delivered through . Your job is to make that content faster to produce, easier to publish, and smarter to find, using automation, DevOps practices, and AI.

This is an entry-level role designed for new graduates. You will work on real production systems from your first months, with mentorship from senior DevOps developers and content leads.

What You Will Do

Working with guidance from senior team members, you will:

  • Build and maintain scripts, tools, and GitLab CI/CD pipelines that automate how documentation and training content is authored, built, and published, working toward single-touch publishing.

  • Develop AI agents, skills, and MCP servers that chain together research, writing, review, and publishing tasks for content developers.

  • Help build dashboards and analytics that track content metrics, such as page traffic and usage, for content teams and product managers.

  • Support the day-to-day operation of our internal AI tools and model servers, including routine maintenance, upgrades, backups, and deploying new models.

  • Add monitoring for AI token usage, GPU utilization, cost, and system performance.

  • Contribute to our knowledge framework by building workflows that ingest and curate content from internal and external sources for documentation, course blueprints, and lab scenarios.

  • Help automate lab environments used for courseware and content development.

  • Improve GitLab issue tracking and collaboration workflows across the team.

  • Troubleshoot issues in pipelines, tools, and infrastructure, and document what you fix.

  • Work with product managers, developers, QA, technical writers, and courseware developers to understand their challenges and turn them into tools that save time.

What We Are Looking For

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, MIS, or a related field, completed within the last two years or by your start date.

  • 0–2 years of experience. Co-op terms, internships, capstone projects, open-source contributions, and personal projects all count.

  • Working knowledge of Python or another scripting language, and the ability to automate tasks with it.

  • Familiarity with Git and source control workflows (branches, commits, merge requests).

  • Hands-on experience using LLMs or AI APIs in a project, such as building a chatbot, an agent, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) app, or an automation that calls a model.

  • Comfort working on the Linux command line.

  • Clear written communication and an interest in how technical content is created and consumed.

  • Curiosity, a problem-solving mindset, and eagerness to learn new tools quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) or containers (Docker).

  • Experience running open-weight models locally (for example, Ollama or vLLM), or working with vector databases.

  • Exposure to agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Coursework or projects using cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or virtualization (KVM, VMware, OpenStack).

  • Familiarity with HTML, JavaScript, Markdown, or static site generators.

  • Basic networking and security knowledge (TCP/IP, firewalls, VPNs).

  • Fortinet certifications (for example, Fortinet Certified Fundamentals or Fortinet Certified Associate) or entry-level cloud certifications.

Please include a link to your GitHub, GitLab, or portfolio. Projects that show what you have built matter as much as your résumé.

What You Will Gain

  • Mentorship from experienced developers, content leads, and product managers.

  • Ownership of tools that are used every day by documentation and training teams worldwide.

  • Hands-on experience with applied AI, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure in a production environment.

  • Deep exposure to Fortinet’s cybersecurity products and access to Fortinet Training Institute courses and certifications.

Compensation and Benefits

The Canada base salary range for this full-time position is expected to be between $59,000 - $71,000 annually. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.

Fortinet strives to provide you and your family with a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. We offer competitive Paid Time Off and flexible leave policies, including paid health days, to help you take care of yourself and your family members.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

About Our Team

Join the Fortinet team in Burnaby, BC, known for its collaborative culture and close work with global customers, internal engineering teams, and product development groups. We emphasize continuous learning, innovation, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. We embrace Fortinet’s core values of openness, teamwork, and innovation, and we support each other, share knowledge, and use AI to solve complex technical challenges.

Why Join Us

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support your overall health and financial well-being. Start your career with work that makes a meaningful and lasting impact for our 660,000+ customers around the globe.

Fortinet is an equal opportunity employer. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for den IT-drift, som en højteknologisk virksomhed i vækst er afhængig af hver dag?

Hos Weibel Scientific udvikler og producerer vi avancerede radarsystemer til kunder over hele verden. Vi er i kraftig vækst, og i takt med at organisationen og vores teknologiske setup udvikler sig, stiller det stadig større krav til vores IT Operations. IT er en vigtig forudsætning for vores evne til at udvikle, producere og levere vores løsninger.

Derfor søger vi en IT Operations Manager, der kan lede transformationen af vores eksisterende infrastruktur og IT-leverancer til en skalerbar, sikker og hybrid leveranceplatform. Platformen skal kombinere lokale miljøer, co-location og cloud på en måde, der giver den rette balance mellem robusthed, fleksibilitet, sikkerhed, performance og økonomi.

Led transformationen fra drift til en skalerbar hybrid platform

Som IT Operations Manager refererer du til vores IT Director og får det samlede ansvar for den daglige IT Operations samt udviklingen af den underliggende leveranceplatform. Rollen kombinerer personaleledelse, teknologisk retning og praktisk eksekvering.

Den centrale opgave bliver at etablere en klar arkitektur og en realistisk transformationsplan for, hvordan vores lokale infrastruktur, co-location-miljø og cloud-services skal spille sammen. Det indebærer blandt andet standardisering af platforme, lifecycle management, automatisering, overvågning, backup og recovery, kapacitetsstyring, sikkerhed og beredskab.

Du skal kunne fastholde stabilitet og sikkerhed i den eksisterende drift, mens platforme og arbejdsformer moderniseres trin for trin. Derfor skal du skabe tydelige prioriteringer, roadmap, governance og ansvar samt sikre, at tekniske beslutninger omsættes til holdbare løsninger i samarbejde med teamet, IT Security, IT Architecture, forretningen og eksterne leverandører.

En vigtig del af rollen er at udvikle teamets kompetencer og arbejdsformer. Du styrker videndeling, dokumentation og operationel disciplin, reducerer personafhængigheder og skaber en kultur, hvor incidents og driftsdata omsættes til konkrete og varige forbedringer.

Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder bliver at:

  • Lede og udvikle IT Operations-teamet og skabe klare prioriteringer, ansvar og retning.
  • Sikre stabil, sikker og forretningskritisk drift under hele transformationen.
  • Definere og gennemføre et roadmap for en skalerbar hybrid leveranceplatform på tværs af lokale miljøer, co-location og cloud.
  • Modernisere compute, storage, virtualisering, backup, monitoring og øvrige infrastrukturtjenester med fokus på standardisering, automatisering og lifecycle management.
  • Styrke beredskab, disaster recovery samt incident, problem og change management.
  • Sikre kapacitets-, performance- og økonomistyring samt et transparent beslutningsgrundlag for investeringer.
  • Sikre professionel leverandør- og kontraktstyring, herunder tydelige servicekrav og ansvar på tværs af leverancemodellen.
  • Samarbejde tæt med IT Security, IT Architecture og øvrige stakeholders om sammenhængende, sikre og skalerbare IT-services. Samarbejde tæt med de øvrige IT-funktioner og relevante stakeholders i organisationen om sammenhængende IT-services
  • Sikre professionel styring af relevante leverandører, aftaler, budgetter og investeringer.

Din erfaring med transformation er afgørende

Vi søger en erfaren IT Operations-leder med teknisk bredde og dokumenteret erfaring fra en tilsvarende moderniseringsrejse. Du har set, hvordan en professionel og skalerbar infrastruktur bør bygges, og du har enten ledet transformationen eller været en central del af det team, der planlagde og eksekverede den.

Det er vigtigt, at du kan omsætte erfaring til Weibels kontekst. Du skal kunne vurdere, hvilke workloads og services der bør placeres lokalt, i co-location eller i cloud, og forstå de praktiske konsekvenser for sikkerhed, tilgængelighed, performance, integrationer, kompetencer og driftsøkonomi.

Du behøver ikke være den dybeste specialist på alle teknologier. Du skal derimod have tilstrækkelig teknisk indsigt til at udfordre designvalg, stille de rigtige spørgsmål, træffe beslutninger og skabe følgeskab hos både specialister, ledelse og leverandører

Vi forestiller os, at du har:

  • Erfaring med ledelse og udvikling af tekniske specialister i et forretningskritisk IT Operations-miljø.
  • Dokumenteret erfaring med at designe, modernisere eller migrere infrastruktur til en hybrid leverancemodel, der kombinerer on-premises, co-location og cloud.
  • Praktisk forståelse for enterprise-netværk, compute, storage, virtualisering, backup/recovery, monitoring, identity og infrastructure security.
  • Erfaring med leverandørstyring, kontrakter, budgetter og investeringsbeslutninger.
  • Evne til at balancere stabil drift med transformation og til at skabe fremdrift i et miljø med mange afhængigheder.
  • Stærke kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner på dansk og engelsk.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Søg venligst jobbet via vores hjemmeside senest den 29. november 2026.

Har du spørgsmål inden da, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores IT Director, Thomas Steinmetz, på thst@weibel.dk

Vær opmærksom på, at ansættelse forudsætter ren straffeattest og PET sikkerhedsgodkendelse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: ANIMAL CONTROL OFFICER I/II
description:
Why Work for the City of Balch Springs?

The City of Balch Springs is a vibrant, inclusive, and sustainable community that thrives on its rich history, commitment to progress, and dedication to fostering a positive work environment. As a city, we focus on enhancing the quality of life for our residents, businesses, and visitors.

We are a forward-thinking organization that embraces innovation and strives for excellence in every department. With our clear vision to inspire growth and community pride, the City of Balch Springs is an excellent place to build a rewarding career. Whether you’re passionate about public safety, economic development, or community engagement, we offer diverse opportunities that allow you to make a meaningful impact.

As an employee of the City of Balch Springs, you’ll be part of a supportive team where professional development is encouraged, and collaboration is valued. We believe in providing employees with the tools and resources they need to succeed, ensuring a positive work-life balance and fostering a culture of respect, integrity, and open communication.

Employee Benefits & Compensation:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer competitive pay based on qualifications and experience.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package: Includes medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families.
  • Retirement Plans: Access to Texas Municipal Retirement System
  • Paid Leave: Generous paid time off, including vacation (15 days for 1st year), sick leave, and holidays (11 plus 2 floating.)
  • Professional Development: Opportunities for training, certifications, and career advancement within the city.
  • Employee Recognition: We value and celebrate the hard work and dedication of our employees.

Our core values of integrity, respect and transparency guide our everyday work, and we actively support our employees’ professional growth. Join our team and help shape the future of a city that’s committed to creating a thriving environment for all.

Job Summary:

The Animal Control Officer II is responsible for enforcing ordinances, regulations, and laws related to animal care and public safety. In this role, the Officer patrols City limits, responds to complaints, impounds stray animals, and provides support to the public, all while ensuring the proper care and maintenance of animals at the shelter. Additional duties include maintaining shelter facilities, safely removing wild animals from residential areas, disposing of deceased animals, and collaborating with other City departments. The Animal Control Officer II plays a key role in promoting animal welfare and ensuring a safe environment for the city and its communities.

Minimum Job Requirements:

  1. High School Diploma or General Education Degree.
  2. Certification in one of the following:
    1. Animal Control Basic Officer Certification
      1. Must obtain a basic Animal Control Officer (ACO) certification issued by the Texas Department of State Health Services (TDSHS) within the probationary period.
    2. Euthanasia Technician.
      1. Must obtain a Euthanasia certification issued by the Texas Department of State Health Services (TDSHS) within the probationary period.
    3. Veterinary Technician.
    4. Or a valid professional animal control related training and/or certification from a State or National recognized organization
  3. A valid state driver’s license.

All Animal Control Officer IIs hired without one of the above certifications will be hired as an Animal Control Officer I and will be considered in training until certification is achieved by the end of 12 months of employment.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Works with the public to assist, respond and provide information and education pertaining to animal related inquiries.
  • Captures both domestic and wild animals and livestock, using equipment and methods appropriate for animal abatement and control; may require chasing, climbing fences and crawling under houses.
  • Inspects and investigate animal facilities and complaints regarding animal welfare/cruelty, vicious or dangerous animals, animal bites and animal nuisances, to explains violations and ensure compliance.
  • Issues citations, licenses, warnings and/or legal notices; enforces licensing laws.
  • Maintains appropriate records and documents on investigations, citizen complaints, adoptions, euthanasia and other paperwork as required.
  • Performs humane euthanasia procedures as required and properly disposes of deceased animals.
  • Assists in community outreach programs and adoption events as needed.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Knowledge of:

  • City organization, operations, policies, and procedures.
  • Knowledge of federal, state and local laws relating to animals in the State of Texas.
  • Knowledge of safety practices and procedures relating to animals such as animal body
  • language, animal handling etc.

Skills in:

  • Providing exceptional external and internal customer service.
  • Communicating effectively.
  • Handling multiple tasks, planning, and prioritizing.
  • Enforcing regulations with tact and good judgment.
  • Working well under pressure with flexibility and professionalism.
  • Operating a personal computer and various software programs.

Physical Demands/Work Environment: Must have the ability to lift, carry, push and/or pull greater than 50 pounds, and may require infrequent lifting of greater than 100 pounds. This position is exposed to extreme elements including extreme heat and/or cold, wet and/or humid conditions, noise intensity level, moving mechanical parts/hazards, dirt/dust, and odors. Working with a wide variety of people. Ability to work weekends, holidays, and on-call schedules.

E.E.O.C. The City of Balch Springs does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, religion, age, disability or military service in employment or the provision of services.

title: Executive - MIS
description:

Established in 2010 in India, Hector Beverages rose to prominence with its signature brand, the Paper Boat, a ready-to-drink beverage that encapsulates the essence of traditional Indian flavors. The inception of Hector Beverages was driven by the founders' vision to bridge the market void for traditional Indian drinks and to present the world with a taste of India's rich cultural beverages.

Location

Headquartered in Whitefield, Bengaluru.

Current Standings

Over the past decade, Hector Beverages has expanded its product line to include fruit juices, coconut water, and iconic Indian beverages such as Aam panna and Jal-jeera and foods & dry fruits which includes products such as Chikki, Aam Papad, range of raw, roasted, and flavored dry fruits that includes mix of nuts, berries & seeds. The brand is synonymous with distinctive flavors and premium ingredients. Furthermore, the firm's commitment to quality and innovation is evidenced by its extensive infrastructure of nine dedicated factories (and counting) for Paper Boat products, providing direct employment to approximately 900 individuals and indirect employment to another 2000.

  • Ability to independently build reports and dashboards rather than simply following predefined formats.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, Pivot Tables, and data visualization techniques.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Fluency in Hindi and English is required. Knowledge of any additional regional language will be an added advantage.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good understanding of FMCG business processes and reporting requirements.
