title: Praktikant til Red Barnet i Aarhus - styrk frivillige fællesskaber for børn
description:
I Red Barnet gør mere end 2.000 frivillige hver dag en forskel for børn og familier i udsatte positioner. Som praktikant bliver du en del af vores jyske kontor i Aarhus, hvor du sammen med teamet understøtter lokalforeninger, familieoplevelsesklubber, ferielejre og genbrugsbutikker i Jylland og på Fyn.

Vi ser praktikanter som en vigtig ressource, der bidrager med nye perspektiver, energi og faglig nysgerrighed. Derfor får du ikke blot indblik i arbejdet i en af Danmarks største børnerettighedsorganisationer, men også mulighed for at tage ansvar og sætte dit eget præg på opgaverne.

Det kommer du til at arbejde med

Som praktikant bliver du en del af hverdagen i et team, der samarbejder tæt med frivillige ledere, bestyrelser og aktivitetsfrivillige. Du får både erfaring med organisationsudvikling, frivilligledelse og projektarbejde.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Understøttelse af lokalforeninger, familieoplevelsesklubber, lejre og genbrugsbutikker
  • Deltagelse i bestyrelsesmøder, frivilligmøder og lokale arrangementer
  • Rekruttering, onboarding og fastholdelse af frivillige
  • Udvikling af materialer, værktøjer og guides til frivillige
  • Kommunikation og formidling til frivillige
  • Støtte til den daglige drift af vores lokale aktiviteter og genbrugsbutikker

Opgaverne tilpasses naturligvis dine interesser, kompetencer og læringsmål og ovenstående er eksempler på opgaver.

Du får erfaring med

  • Frivilligledelse og frivilligunderstøttelse
  • Organisationsudvikling i en landsdækkende civilsamfundsorganisation
  • Kommunikation og rekruttering
  • Udvikling af materialer og digitale værktøjer
  • Samarbejde med frivillige, kommuner og andre lokale aktører

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er i gang med en relevant videregående uddannelse på bachelor- eller kandidatniveau
  • Har interesse for frivillighed, civilsamfund og socialt arbejde
  • Er god til at formulere dig skriftligt og mundtligt
  • Trives med både selvstændige opgaver og teamwork
  • Er struktureret, initiativrig og nysgerrig
  • Har lyst til at møde frivillige og komme ud i lokale fællesskaber

Det tilbyder vi

Du bliver en del af et engageret og fagligt stærkt fællesskab i Red Barnets sektion Børneliv i Frivillige Fællesskaber med base på vores lille, men hyggelige Aarhus-kontor. Vi er optagede af at skabe resultater for børn i udsatte positioner, samtidig med at vi passer på hinanden og skaber gode rammer for læring og udvikling.

Derudover får du:

  • En fast praktikvejleder og faglig sparringspartner
  • Introforløb sammen med andre praktikanter
  • Arbejdscomputer og telefon
  • En praktikplads på vores hyggelige kontor i hjertet af Aarhus

Praktiske oplysninger

Praktikperioden er i forårssemesteret 2027 med opstart i januar/februar efter nærmere aftale.

Praktikken er ulønnet og som udgangspunkt på 30-37 timer om ugen, men vi er fleksible og tager hensyn til undervisning, eksamener og eventuelt studiejob.

Vi foventer at indkalde til samtaler løbende, så søg gerne inden fristen.

Har du spørgsmål kan du række ud til Stine Alkert, Senior frivilligkonsulent på stal@redbarnket.dk eller Pernille Kjærholt, Projektkoordinator på pekj@redbarnet.dk

title: IT-arkitekt til CPR – vær med til at sikre og udvikle et af Danmarks mest centrale registre
description:
CPR er en vigtig grundsten i det digitale Danmark, og kravene til sikkerhed og robusthed er større end nogensinde. Den seneste tids hændelser har understreget betydningen af et vedvarende fokus på sikkerhed og på de tekniske og arkitekturmæssige valg, der beskytter CPR’s data.

Vi søger en erfaren it-arkitekt, der vil være med til at videreudvikle CPR’s arkitektur, styrke det langsigtede sikkerhedsarbejde og sikre et solidt teknisk fundament for de kommende års udvikling. Det kræver teknisk tyngde, overblik og lyst til at tage ansvar, når opgaven er kompleks, vigtig og under bevågenhed. Til gengæld får du en unik mulighed for at præge udviklingen af en løsning, hvor dit faglige bidrag har betydning langt ud over selve systemet.

Om stillingen
Visse opgaver ligger fast, men der er mulighed for at forme stillingen ud fra dine kompetencer og erfaringer.

Du får en central rolle i at videreudvikle CPR-registrets it-arkitektur og sikre et solidt teknisk fundament for CPR fremadrettet. Her skal tekniske hensyn gå hånd i hånd med forretningens behov og CPR-registrets betydning for samfundet. I den nuværende geopolitiske og sikkerhedsmæssige situation er der et særligt fokus på, hvordan arkitektur, tekniske løsninger og systemdesign kan bidrage til at forebygge fremtidige sikkerhedshændelser.

Du skal både kunne arbejde med de konkrete tekniske problemstillinger og løfte blikket for at skabe en langsigtet retning. Du får mulighed for at præge løsningerne og rådgive om de valg, der har betydning for CPR-registrets sikkerhed, robusthed og videreudvikling.

Mere konkret vil dine arbejdsopgaver være at:

  • rådgive ledelse og kolleger om teknologivalg, arkitektur og sikkerhedsmæssige konsekvenser
  • skabe sammenhæng mellem eksisterende systemer, nye løsninger og kravene til drift, vedligeholdelse og sikkerhed
  • udarbejde arkitekturprodukter og løsningsbeskrivelser, der kan omsættes direkte til udvikling og implementering
  • identificere arkitekturmæssige risici og sårbarheder samt bidrage til at forebygge fremtidige sikkerhedshændelser
  • samarbejde med tekniske specialister, sikkerhedsfunktioner og eksterne leverandører om at føre arkitekturen ud i livet.

Om dig
Vi leder efter en erfaren it-arkitekt med en relevant akademisk uddannelsesbaggrund og erfaring med at udvikle arkitektur for komplekse it-løsninger. Du har den faglige tyngde til at træffe velbegrundede valg – også når der er mange hensyn og stor opmærksomhed på opgaven.

Du vil passe godt til stillingen, hvis du:

  • kan analysere komplekse systemlandskaber samt omsætte forretningsmæssige og tekniske behov til holdbare arkitekturløsninger.
  • kan formidle og begrunde dine arkitekturvalg og skabe retning på tværs af tekniske fagligheder og interessenter.
  • har erfaring med informationssikkerhed og risikovurdering samt kan tænke sikkerhed ind i arkitekturen fra starten.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har kendskab til metoder inden for The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF) og arkitekturnoteringsværktøjer som Visio, Archi eller lignende.

CPR-administraionen
CPR er – også i en international målestok – et unikt register, som udgør et grundlæggende fundament for en smidig og effektiv administration i den offentlige og private sektor. Personnummeret er den entydige nøgle, der gør det muligt at sammenholde og ajourføre personoplysninger på tværs af en lang række både offentlige og private it-systemer.

CPR varetager dels opgaverne med CPR’s drift, vedligeholdelse, udvikling samt levering af CPR’s data til offentlige myndigheder og den private sektor, dels opgaverne i forbindelse med CPR-lovgivningen, herunder folkeregistreringsreglerne vedrørende bopælssager, juridisk kønsskifte mv.

CPR er organisatorisk placeret i Forsknings-, Uddannelses- og Digitaliseringsministeriets departement.

Vi er ca. 15 kollegaer i kontoret med en overvægt af tekniske specialister og jurister. Vi har et stærkt fagligt og socialt fællesskab, hvor vi vægter sparring og faglig udvikling højt. Vi bruger hinandens forskellige kompetencer og tror på, at vi kommer bedre og hurtigere i mål, når vi samarbejder, videndeler og koordinerer.

Vi tager et fælles ansvar for at være en god arbejdsplads, hvor det er sjovt at gå på arbejde, og hvor der er plads til at udvikle sig.

Til daglig mødes vi som udgangspunkt på vores kontor i København tæt ved Kongens Nytorv, men du kan løbende aftale hjemmearbejde med din chef.

Du kan læse mere om os på .

Skal du være med til at forme fremtiden?
Viden former fremtiden, og i Forsknings-, Uddannelses- og Digitaliseringsministeriet arbejder vi for at skabe værdi i samfundet gennem fremragende uddannelse og forskning. Digitalisering er en del af danskernes hverdag og verden, og i Forsknings-, Uddannelses- og Digitaliseringsministeriet skal vi samtidig være Danmarks strategiske blik på digitaliseringen, så Danmark også kan være et digitalt foregangsland i morgen. Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere bidrager til et miljø præget af samarbejde, trivsel og resultater.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Du ansættes som fuldmægtig eller konsulent i Forsknings-, Uddannelses- og Digitaliseringsministeriet efter overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Akademikere i staten (AC). Der er mulighed for at forhandle tillæg, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

Du kan finde oplysninger om lønniveauerne på .

Stillingen er på fuld tid. Vi forventer at byde vores nye kollega velkommen den 1. februar 2027.

Vi holder til hos Digitaliseringsstyrelsen, så arbejdsstedet er Landgreven 4, 1301 København K.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Maria Antonsen på telefonnummer 72 26 97 30 eller på e-mail man@cpr.dk. Send gerne en SMS, så ringer hun dig op.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og efterfølgende opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen i hele din ansættelsesperiode. I forbindelse med ansættelse vil du blive bedt om at fremvise en privat straffeattest.

Søg stillingen
Klik på knappen ”søg stillingen” eller søg via vores hjemmeside fudm.dk. Vi skal have din ansøgning senest fredag den 20. november 2026.

Vi forventer at holde 2 samtalerunder. Første samtalerunde afholdes i uge 49 og anden samtalerunde i uge 50. Der kan i forbindelse med ansættelsessamtalerne blive brugt case. Der vil forud for ansættelsen blive indhentet referencer.

Ligestilling i alle dens aspekter er vigtig. Derfor opfordres alle interesserede uanset etnisk tilhørsforhold, religion, køn, alder og lign. til at søge stillingen.

title: Lead Hospital Services Technician
description:
Lead Hospital Services Technician

$24/hr, Good Benefits, Day Shift, No Weekends


I. Job Summary

This includes, but not limited to: Sharps Management Service, Pharmaceutical Waste, Controlled Substances, and Document Management. This service is provided at regularly scheduled intervals for assigned facilities. Fills in for other Team Members who are on vacation, sick, leave, etc. Assists Supervisor, as needed, covers schedules and locations, which may vary based on coverage required. The Lead is in charge for a shift, providing guidance, training and coaching to other Technicians. Is primary Hospital Services worker contact for the customer.

Installs product, resurvey accounts and assists Supervisor in asset/inventory management.

  • Interacts professionally with onsite customer staff to ensure service expectations are met or exceeded. May travel to customers in assigned area to proactively resolve customer service questions and issues.

title: Wire Department Manager
description:
Empower your Future at One of the Nation’s Leading Independent Electrical Distributors!

At U.S. Electrical Services, Inc. (USESI), we combine over 100 years of expertise, $150M+ in inventory, and the power of 2,000+ dedicated employees across 150 locations to deliver excellence every day. As a family of 14 regional businesses, we thrive on innovation and teamwork, empowering our people to shape the future of the electrical industry.

Maurice Electrical Supply, an affiliate of USESI, is looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Wire Department Manager to join our team. Maurice Electrical Supply is adding 45,000 square feet to expand our wire operation. We’re seeking a Wire Department Manager to lead our team, improve production processes, and build the capacity to double cutting volume and handle 1,000 cuts per day. This is a leadership position with responsibility for people, production planning, inventory, equipment, safety, and service. The manager will be actively engaged on the floor—directing work, developing associates, and solving problems—with occasional cutting support during demand surges. This position will be located in Landover, MD.

Job Type: Full-time

Responsibilities:

  • Team leadership: Hire, train, schedule, and develop associates. Set clear expectations and hold the team accountable for results.

  • Production planning: Match staffing and equipment capacity to demand, establish daily priorities, and meet customer commitments.

  • Expansion execution: Help organize the additional space, including equipment placement, reel storage, material flow, and staging.

  • Operational improvement: Identify bottlenecks, improve workflows, reduce downtime, and establish consistent procedures.

  • Inventory management: Maintain accurate reel footage and stock records, manage remnants, reduce scrap, and coordinate replenishment with purchasing.

  • Safety and equipment: Establish safe operating practices, maintain training standards, and oversee preventive maintenance.

  • Business performance: Monitor productivity, labor costs, accuracy, and service levels. Recommend investments and improvements that support profitable growth.

  • Customer and branch support: Work with sales, purchasing, and delivery teams to support wire opportunities and provide dependable service throughout our footprint.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Leadership experience in wire manufacturing, wire processing, electrical distribution, or a related production environment.
  • A background with a wire manufacturer is a major plus, particularly experience in production supervision, plant operations, scheduling, or continuous improvement.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to engage with teams and leadership.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills to address challenges effectively.
  • Organizational and time management skills to handle multiple priorities.
  • The ability to lead people, organize a busy operation, and turn growth goals into practical operating plans.
  • Strong inventory, equipment, and production management skills.
  • A visible, approachable leadership style and a willingness to assist the team during peak demand.
  • Analytical and financial acumen for budget oversight and performance analysis.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field strongly preferred; equivalent experience accepted.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in a supervisory or management role preferred.
  • Ability to adapt to changing business needs and market conditions.
  • Commitment to fostering a high-performance work culture.

The Opportunity:

Help shape a growing wire operation with a substantial investment in space and capacity. You’ll have a direct role in building the team, establishing processes, and improving the department’s performance.

Interested or know someone who would be a strong fit? Send a direct message with your résumé or a brief summary of your experience.

Benefits:

At USESI, we believe that our benefits should make a difference—to you, your job, and the life you lead outside of work. We are dedicated to supporting our most valuable asset, our employees!

Full-time employees are eligible for the following comprehensive benefit plan:

title: Department Manager Produce-Valdez
description:

title: Supervisor, Clinical Laboratory, Pathology, Full Time Days, Summit, NJ
description:
Under the supervision of the Laboratory Manager, the Supervisor oversees specimen processing, test performance, and result reporting. The role supports patient safety, workflow efficiency, and collaboration with the health care team to ensure accurate, quality results. This Supervisor provides oversight of the Anatomic Pathology laboratory team.

- Section Administration: Responsible for laboratory operations for the appropriate section(s). Establishes and implements policies and procedures in collaboration with associated departments throughout the organization. Oversees and ensures appropriate coverage for all shifts, including actively participating in bench-level tasks when operational needs arise.
- Technical Operations: Acts a technical resource for section, evaluates and implements new procedures and instrumentation. Oversees technical performance of the section assuring that results are accurate, and turnaround time is optimal.
- Quality Control: Follows quality control policies, documents all related activities, and maintains records of instrument and procedural calibrations and maintenance. Analyzes, reviews results, monitors compliance with the Quality Control Plan standard operating procedures.
- Financial Responsibility: Supports budget preparation and monitors financial performance, identifies cost-saving opportunities, recommends capital purchases, and ensures efficient inventory management by maintaining supply levels and monitoring expiration dates.
- Communication: Leads and participates in system and site committees and team meetings, communicates key lab and site updates, addresses incident reports with follow-up actions, and collaborates across departments to support Atlantic Health laboratory operations.
- Team Member Management: Effectively leads and develops laboratory team members by fostering a collaborative work environment, setting clear performance expectations, and supporting professional growth to ensure high-quality clinical outcomes. Conduct effective discipline and performance management.
- Regulatory Compliance: Maintain required proficiency testing according to regulations. Monitor laboratory compliance with regulatory agency requirements. Coordinate self and onsite inspections. Maintains / reviews all documentation necessary for all regulatory compliance.
- Training: Oversees orientation, training, and competency of team members and students as assigned.
- Safety: Demonstrates knowledge and practice of all Atlantic Health and department safety procedures.

Must meet the CLIA personnel requirements for High Complexity testing:
- MD or DO with a current medical license, OR
- Doctoral degree in clinical laboratory science, chemical, physical or biological science, OR
- Master's degree in medical technology, clinical laboratory, chemical, physical, or biological science, OR
• Bachelor's degree in medical technology, clinical laboratory, chemical, physical or biological, OR
• Associate degree in chemical, physical or biological science or medical laboratory or equivalent education and training
• Foreign education credentials require US equivalency documentation by an AHS approved agency.

Must meet the CLIA requirements for General Supervisor:
• Qualified as a Director for high complexity testing, OR
• Qualified as a Technical Supervisor for high complexity testing, OR
• Doctoral degree in clinical laboratory science or chemical, physical or biological science
with 1 year training and experience in high-complexity testing, OR
• Master's degree in clinical laboratory science, medical technology or chemical, physical or
biological science and 1 year training and experience in high-complexity testing, OR
• Bachelor's degree in clinical laboratory science, medical technology or chemical, physical or
biological science and 1 year training and experience in high-complexity testing, OR
• Associate degree in medical laboratory technology (or pulmonary function) and 2 years
laboratory (or blood gas analysis) training or experience, or both, in high complexity testing
• Refer to the CLIA regulation 42CFR493.1461 for additional qualifications

Previous high complexity lab experience preferred.

ASCP, AMT or defined equivalent required or eligible; must pass exam within one year or when eligible per ASCP standards.

Organized: Maintains a structured approach to tasks and keeps workspaces orderly.

Adaptable: Adjusts effectively to shifting priorities and workplace needs.

title: Sea Site Technician
description:
Mowi is the world’s leading seafood company and the largest producer of Atlantic salmon. As the first global seafood company with an end-to-end supply chain, Mowi brings supreme quality salmon and other seafood products to consumers around the world. Mowi is also ranked the most sustainable animal protein producer in the world by Coller FAIRR. With headquarters in Bergen, Norway, Mowi employs 11,600 people in 26 countries worldwide, and is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange with a market capitalisation of EUR 9 billion and total assets of EUR 8.2 billion.

If you are looking for an exciting opportunity to explore a career in the aquaculture industry, then this is the role for you! Join Mowi Canada West as a Sea Site Technician and learn more about growing salmon in a safe and sustainable manner while enjoying the beautiful marine environment of coastal BC.

Applicants with aquaculture experience and/or relevant post-secondary education will be given preference, as we are a company that embraces constant learning and industry professionalism. The ability to get along with a wide variety of people from different backgrounds and cultures is paramount. Responsibilities:

  • Feeding and performing all other required care for our fish
  • Cleaning, power-washing, and sanitizing to ensure a pristine environment for our fish and our employees
  • Ensuring accurate reporting, record-keeping, and document management
  • Conducting environmental sampling and plankton monitoring using specialized technology and equipment
  • Assisting with fish health sampling, and grading fish by size
  • Monitoring fish behaviour, appearance, and health
  • Operating a forklift and other site equipment when authorized and trained

What We Offer:

  • Competitive industry wages and full-time, year-round employment
  • Camp shift of 8 days on and 6 days off
  • Comprehensive flex benefits plan, including life and disability insurance
  • Wellness program, including an annual wellness reimbursement

title: Claim Director
description:
This is a role focused on technical claim handling for Chubb’s Casualty Complex Team. In this role you will manage auto and general liability claims, both litigated and non-litigated, under both primary and excess policies. This role requires an individual to be accountable for the handling and disposition of claims including investigation, coverage determination, reserving, negotiation and settlement or trial strategies. This position will require some travel, as well as coordinating with and servicing both internal and external business partners. You will represent the company at meetings with management and business partners, as well as at mediations, arbitrations, settlement conferences and trials.

Responsibilities

  • Manage an inventory of claims involving moderate severity exposures and coverage issues.
  • Conduct, coordinate, and direct investigation into loss facts, damages and risk transfer opportunities.
  • Evaluate coverage, liability, and damages to determine the exposure to the insured and the policy.
  • Analyze coverage and communicate coverage positions, as warranted, within assigned authority.
  • Demonstrate and implement effective defense, resolution and claim strategies.
  • Provide superior customer service to insureds, agents, and internal business partners.
  • Adhere to Best Practices Guidelines.
  • Adhere to individual authority grants, all statutory and regulatory requirements, fair claim practices and local compliance requirements, including examiner licensing.
  • Travels to conferences, mediations, and trials as necessary.

Qualifications

  • Seven or more years of experience as a casualty claim professional with a high degree of specialized and technical competence in the handling of high exposure claims with emphasis on hands-on file and litigation management.
  • Experience with primary and excess bodily injury, property damage, and personal injury claims.
  • Strong background and demonstrated ability in dealing with significant coverage matters.
  • Working knowledge of industry best practices and procedures.
  • An ability to work independently and assimilate learning materials on many different subjects from various sources.
  • Excellent interpersonal communications and negotiation skills; and an ability to deal with customers and business partners in a professional manner.
  • Ability to make prompt, intelligent decisions based upon detailed analyses of complex issues.
  • Demonstrated strong relational skills particularly in adverse or high-pressure situations.
  • A law degree is not necessary but helpful.

Who are we looking for?

Successful professionals at Chubb come from many backgrounds with experiences rich in diversity that they bring with them to our company along with:

  • an inclusive mindset which allows differences to be leveraged for better business results;
  • open, transparent communication;
  • teamwork and inclusion which draws on diverse ideas and perspectives; and
  • new ideas, innovation, and ways of thinking which support diversity.

If you do not already have one, you will be required to obtain an applicable resident or designated home state adjusters license and possibly additional state licensure.

The pay range for the role is $83,600 to $119,900. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. Chubb offers a comprehensive benefits package, more details on which can be found on our careers website. The disclosed pay range estimate may be adjusted for the applicable geographic differential for the location in which the position is filled.

title: CDS Technician - OKC
description:
Rig up and down CDS tool and operate it in a safe manner, ensuring all joints are made up properly.

  • Must be able to communicate clearly and professionally with rig and operator personnel, complete all required paperwork (including job packets), and troubleshoot equipment on location.

  • Connect CDS tool to drilling rig top drive

  • Complete function tests for CDS

  • Use various hand tools to make necessary adjustments or repairs to equipment to ensure proper function

  • Control hydraulics to secure, lift, and connect casing together

  • Work in conjunction with the driller to lower casing into well bore after each joint is screwed together, repeat until total depth is reached

  • Rig-up and down equipment using hydraulics to maneuver and control the CDS equipment from the drill floor, the cat walk and the transport unit

  • Disconnect CDS from Top Drive

  • Prepare and load equipment for transport to return from rig location back to the shop

  • Prepare vehicle and equipment for the next job upon return to the shop

  • Maintains a safe working environment and reasonably clean and tidy rig floor area by picking up and storing all tools in their respective storage areas after using, discarding waste materials and washing down the rig floor and rig floor equipment as often as necessary.

  • Communicate with customer in a professional manner as appropriate to complete the job and appropriate paperwork.

  • Maintain a knowledge and awareness of safe working habits and rig safety rules and regulations

  • Financial responsibilities will be communicated by manager and/or local or global Delegation of Authority, when applicable

  • Compliance with all Nabors Policies, Systems, and Standards, including, but not limited to: Compliance and Legal, Finance, Human Resources, Quality and HSE, etc.

REQUIREMENTS

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • Previous oilfield experience required.
  • 1-2 years of Floor Hand experience preferred.
  • Mechanically inclined, hydraulic/electrical

ESSENTIAL SKILLS / PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS / WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Safety and service oriented
  • Good problem solving skills
  • Communication with the rig crew and shop personnel
  • Ability to multi-task, be well organized both cooperatively and independently.
  • May be asked to operate a company vehicle.
  • Requires the ability to stand for long periods of time. Requires the ability to stand and walk more than 90% of the time.
  • Requires the ability to walk, sit and use hands to finger, handle, or feel over 2/3 of the time.
  • Requires the ability to talk to hear more than 2/3 of the time.
  • Requires the ability to work prolonged hours in some circumstances.
  • Must be able to lift, pull and push loads of up to 50 pounds unassisted.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Requires the ability to go up and down stairs.
  • Repetitive motions.
  • Typically works in a moderately noisy environment.
  • Routine exposure to the elements, including working outdoors and in a non-climate controlled building.

title: MAINTENANCE ASSOCIATE (OPS)
description:
About Children’s Home Association of Illinois (CHAIL):

CHAIL is a youth, family, and community focused 501(c)(3) organization with multiple locations and 450 staff, located in Peoria, IL. For over 160 years CHAIL has been helping the kids and families who need it most. Children’s Home Association of Illinois (CHAIL) is the largest social service agency for youth and families in downstate Illinois. The services we provide don’t just impact the individual child, they create positive ripple effects within their immediate family, neighborhood, community, and world by providing an opportunity to thrive.

Here at CHAIL, employees experience a “People First - Culture of Care” working atmosphere. From the most tenured staff to the newest team member, everyone is welcomed into a community that prioritizes diversity, equity, wellness, belonging, and good health. Starting with our CEO/President and migrating to every employee, this agency takes pride in taking care of each other. We believe if our employees are cared for, they can better live out the mission of the agency which is to help the kids and families who need it most. By putting our people first at CHAIL, they have the opportunity to share their expertise, talents, and passions with clients as they are changing the lives of the kids who will change the world. Other tasks come in as requests from program staff, which may include plumbing, electrical work, or work on the physical structure of facilities. Maintenance staff also engage in major building and remodeling tasks from time to time. These projects will be labor intensive and require a variety of skills. In addition, programs at times may move to a new facility, or staff even shift office space requiring moving assistance.   • Responds to all duties as assigned by the Facilities Manager or Maintenance Lead.
  • Responds as soon as possible to requests by staff to address special cleaning needs, especially in school and residential settings.

  • Undertakes major remodeling projects as outlined by the facilities manager.

  • Continues to expand knowledge of techniques through formal training and on the job learning from the Facilities Manager and other Maintenance staff.

  • Effective time management.
  • Ability to work independently and in a project team.
  • Maintains a professional and courteous attitude and demeanor.
  • Communicates effectively and professionally with agency staff and clients.

  • Treats every individual with the same level of courtesy and respect regardless of any personal factors, and acts without bias toward co-workers and clients.
  • Maintains confidentiality regarding client and agency information.
  • Has a good understanding of the agency’s mission and programs and supports the program staff in striving toward their desired outcomes.
  • Must be able to read written instructions.
  • Must be able to communicate well in writing or speaking.
  • Ability to lift at least 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand and walk most of the working day.
  • Physical body dexterity allows bending, stooping, reaching, pushing, pulling, etc. when moving, lifting, or installing equipment, appliances, furniture, etc.

title: COATING  BATCHER
description:
Job Summary

The Batcher is responsible for ensuring fabric is processed accurately and efficiently according to shop order requirements. This role plays a critical part in maintaining product quality, safety, and production flow by supporting machine operations, inspections, and documentation.

Essential Job Functions

  • Maintain complete knowledge of all emergency and safety devices on tenter frames.
  • Properly follow and adhere to the bell communication system for entering and exiting machine ends.
  • Ensure compliance with all plant and departmental safety, quality, and housekeeping policies.
  • Follow shop order notes precisely and maintain accurate records in IFS and physical logbooks.
  • Assist operators and inspectors during all machine setups.
  • Perform operator or inspector duties during scheduled breaks and unscheduled absences as needed.
  • Complete additional tasks or duties as assigned by management or shift leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Basic reading, writing, and math skills required.
  • Forklift license preferred or willingness to obtain certification.
  • Basic computer skills required.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and maneuver fabric rolls weighing up to 1,000 pounds.
  • Ability to stand on concrete floors and metal catwalks for up to 7 hours per day.
  • Ability to walk distances of approximately 200 feet up to 40 times per day.
  • Ability to climb stairs and ladders as required by the job.
  • Good vision with the ability to identify fabric defects and shade variations.

Work Schedule

  • Must be able to work assigned shifts and scheduled workdays.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Why join Nextech?
We are a leader in specialty healthcare technology solutions.
We’re committed to hiring and retaining talent, which is why we invest in our employees through competitive pay, a generous bonus structure, great healthcare, a comprehensive wellness program, and many other benefits.
If you are a software engineer, finance or accounting professional, customer support specialist, or a business development expert with a passion for healthcare technology (just to name a few), we want to hear from you.
We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics are encouraged to apply. If you are a candidate in need of assistance or an accommodation in the application process, please contact talent@nextech.com.

Job Summary

The Senior Data Engineer will be part of a six-person Data Services team supporting mission-critical healthcare applications, including real-time clinical workflows, patient data analytics, and regulatory reporting. The team has deep SQL Server expertise, and this position represents an intentional step toward expanding its capabilities in modern data engineering, lakehouse architecture, and agentic AI.

This individual will help build and enhance the enterprise lakehouse, curate the semantic layer needed to make AI-driven analytics reliable, and partner closely with Product Engineering, FP&A, and other teams that depend on accurate and accessible data. During the first year, the Senior Data Engineer is expected to drive meaningful technical debt reduction within the enterprise lakehouse, become a trusted technical partner across product roadmaps, and strengthen the capabilities of junior engineers through active mentorship.

This role is well suited for a data engineer who is energized by the intersection of lakehouse architecture and emerging agentic AI patterns and wants to develop these capabilities within a healthcare environment where data quality has meaningful consequences.

All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA, and other regulations, as appropriate.

Essential Functions:

  • In addition to working in accordance with appropriate conduct and behavioral standards, specific responsibilities of this role include:
  • Design and build robust data pipelines and lakehouse solutions using Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, PySpark, and Python.
  • Design AI-ready schemas, semantic layers, and metadata structures that allow AI agents to query data accurately and reliably.
  • Build automated validation processes for agent-generated queries.
  • Pilot agentic automation for data quality and reconciliation workflows while measuring accuracy and maintaining clear rollback plans.
  • Curate and maintain the semantic layer that grounds AI agents and reduces incorrect responses caused by ambiguous or poorly defined data.
  • Catalog and steward enterprise data assets to support internal analytics, financial planning, and product engineering needs.
  • Partner proactively with Product Engineering, FP&A, and other stakeholders to identify and understand data requirements.
  • Troubleshoot performance issues and support SQL Server and Azure SQL environments while continuing to develop operational expertise.
  • Mentor junior engineers on data engineering best practices, architecture patterns, and technical standards.
  • Contribute to data protection, security, and compliance reviews to ensure that tools and processes meet applicable standards, including HIPAA requirements where relevant.
  • Carry out additional responsibilities assigned based on business needs.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 7+ years of production experience in data engineering roles, including hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines at scale.
  • Advanced proficiency with Python and PySpark or Apache Spark in production data engineering environments.
  • Hands-on production experience with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable modern data platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and operating lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake, Parquet, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience designing AI-ready schemas, semantic layers, or metadata structures with downstream AI or machine learning query patterns in mind, or experience building automated validation for programmatically generated queries.
  • Experience with agentic or automation-driven data quality workflows, such as AI-assisted reconciliation, agent-grounded semantic layers, or comparable applied solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner directly with product, analytics, finance, or business stakeholders to understand and shape data requirements proactively.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure cloud concepts, including platform as a service, infrastructure as a service, Azure SQL, and hybrid cloud models.
  • Willingness and ability to develop deeper operational expertise within Azure SQL and SQL Server environments.
  • Meaningful experience mentoring junior or mid-level engineers on technical standards, architecture patterns, and data engineering best practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on production experience with Azure SQL, SQL Server, or Azure SQL Managed Instance.
  • Proficiency with T-SQL and PowerShell for automation and operational support.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or Azure Resource Manager templates.
  • Familiarity with streaming data architectures and technologies such as Azure Event Hubs or Apache Kafka.
  • Understanding of data mesh principles and distributed data ownership.
  • Experience working within healthcare or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements or healthcare data standards such as FHIR and HL7.

Working Environment/Physical Demands:

  • 100% Remote in the United States
  • Activities require a significant amount of work in front of a computer monitor
  • Long-distance or air travel as needed – not to exceed 10% travel

title: Family Services Specialist IV
description:
Title Description- This is the beginning leadership level in the occupational group for Family Services. Employees function as a lead worker for subordinate family services specialists and/or acts as an expert resource specialist. Employees serve as support for the supervisor by performing tasks such as ensuring staff coverage, workload balance, training staff, reviewing case files, and providing back-up supervision of staff. Employees may provide consultation on complex cases and may also work on complex case assignments such as individual and group therapy, crisis intervention, case management, client advocacy, prevention, and education. Employees work within established policies, procedures and guidelines with a high degree of independence, seeking supervisory assistance only in unusually complicated and difficult cases/situations. The Family Services Specialists IV class is distinguished from the Family Services Supervisor class by the latter’s spending a majority of time in supervisory activities such as handling personnel issues, problems, and evaluating the work of others.

General Work Tasks (Illustrative Only) –
  • Provides persons, families, or vulnerable populations with the psychosocial support needed to cope with chronic, acute, or terminal illnesses, neglect and abuse;
  • Ensures that reports of suspected abuse/neglect are assigned to appropriate staff;
  • Ensures that the local department has staff on duty 24 hours per day, seven days per week to respond to reports of abuse/neglect;
  • Provides guidance, consultation and supervision to other staff in the absence of the supervisor;
  • Prepares social histories and psychosocial diagnoses and develops treatment plans which identify problems, clinical methods for dealing with them, and the means by which services will be provided either within the agency or through referral to other community resources;
  • Represents the agency in both civil and criminal court proceedings which involves interpreting laws, filing petitions, preparing court records, testifying before the court, preparing witnesses for examination, and compiling evidence;
  • Provides direct intervention and service delivery for difficult, complex social work cases, and coordinates casework;
  • Develops and conducts training for staff, interns and other professionals in the community;
  • Supervises social work interns by guiding them in their service delivery, assessing their strengths and weaknesses, and communicating with the school liaison about their progress;
  • Conducts field visits to residential facilities, consults with therapists and residential staff and participates in the staffing and planning of meetings;
  • Functions as a lead worker providing guidance and training to other staff;
  • May perform same functions described in Family Services Specialist III; and
  • Coordinates program functions, develops programs, and evaluates materials.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Knowledge- Comprehensive knowledge of: social work principles and practices; human behavior and motivational theory; laws, policies, and regulations relating to human services program areas; investigating and interviewing techniques; and the assessment and treatment of behavioral and affective disorders; principles and processes for providing customer and personal services to include needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of satisfaction; principles, methods, and procedures for diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation of physical and mental dysfunctions, and for career counseling and guidance; and therapeutic treatment technique. Some knowledge of supervisory practices and principles if required in specific assignment.

Skills- Skill in: operating a personal computer and the associated software; and the operation of a motor vehicle.

Abilities- Demonstrated ability to: provide guidance and training in program areas to other employees if required in specific assignment; write court reports, home studies, evaluations, mediation agreements, letters, committee reports, presentations, and general information; make clinical judgments, assess clients’ needs, and formulate plan of action; communicate effectively both orally and in writing; interview, assess needs, counsel and refer clients to other resources as needed; investigate high profile cases; testify in court proceedings; develop and present training programs and other presentations; interpret program laws, policies and regulations; develop and implement service plans in order to insure the delivery of appropriate services to the client; analyze case information to make sound judgments within the framework of existing laws, policies, and regulations; respond to the client's emotions in order to accomplish services objectives; develop speeches and represent the agency on program training and workshops; work in stressful situations and maintain diplomacy; plan and manage own work activities including service delivery preparing reports, and correspondence, record keeping responsibilities and related activities; establish and maintain effective relationships with others; and stay abreast of current trends and developments in the social work field.

Education and Experience- Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in a Human Services field or minimum of a Bachelor's degree in any field with a minimum of two years of appropriate and related experience in a Human Services area (Section 22VAC40-670-20 of the Administrative Code of Virginia). Considerable experience in assigned program area/human services programs and completion of required training programs. Work experience in a leadership role. Equivalent combination of training and experience which provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities. Possession of a BSW or MSW degree and a Commonwealth of Virginia Social Worker license are desirable.

Minimum Qualifications: Possession of a Bachelor's degree in the Human Services field or a minimum of a Bachelor's degree in any field with a minimum of two (2) years of appropriate and related experience in a Human Services area.

Preferred Qualifications: Possession of a BSW or MSW degree and/or a Commonwealth of Virginia Social Worker's License or a Master's degree in a Human Services field, or a Master's degree in any field with two (2) years’ experience in Human Services. Prefer Virginia Social Services experience as a lead worker providing experience and training to other staff. Prefer bi-lingual (English/Spanish).

Special Requirements: Applicants will be subject to a criminal history background search, central registry search, DMV/driving record check and/or pre-employment drug screen.
Employees will be required to participate in afterhours on-call schedule on a rotating basis. Employee must be willing to work in the community emergency shelter in the event of a natural disaster or emergency.

Special Instructions to Applicants: Applicants are encouraged to provide a complete listing of work experience, either paid or unpaid and qualifications on the application.

title: Teamleder til Drift Teknik
description:
I HOFOR arbejder vi hver dag for at sikre en stabil og bæredygtig forsyning til hovedstadsområdet. Det kræver styring, overvågning og udvikling af tekniske anlæg, der er afgørende for en sikker og effektiv spildevandsforsyning. Vi søger derfor en teamleder til Drift Teknik, som får en vigtig rolle i udviklingen af vores tekniske anlæg og digitale løsninger, og samtidig skal sikre en velfungerende daglig drift og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Vær med til at udvikle fremtidens drift

Som teamleder får du til opgave at samle og udvikle teamet omkring fælles mål og bliver en central drivkraft i den fortsatte digitalisering af driften, herunder anvendelsen af eksisterende og fremtidige digitale værktøjer. Samtidig får du en vigtig rolle i den kommende udskiftning af vores SCADA-system og skal sikre, at løsningen lever op til de standarder og krav, der er defineret i samarbejde med HOFORs IT- og digitaliseringsområde.

Du skal også fremme samarbejdet på tværs af området Vand & Byudvikling, særligt inden for hydrauliske modeller, driftsoptimering af pumper og tekniske anlæg. Derudover skal du være med til at sikre, at styring af elektriske anlæg og digitale systemer fungerer stabilt og effektivt i hverdagen.

Dine opgaver omfatter bl.a. at:

  • Have ansvaret for den daglige ledelse og den langsigtede udvikling af området
  • Sikre et højt niveau af arbejdsmiljøledelse og sikkerhed
  • Have ansvar for kontraktstyring inden for teamets område
  • Indgå i den daglige ledelse på Kløvermarken samt tæt samarbejde med driftschefen
  • Sikre efterlevelse af gældende krav inden for KLS og ansvaret for el-autorisation

Du får ansvar for både mennesker, drift og udvikling

Som person er du nærværende og tilgængelig. Du formår at skabe tillid og engagement omkring dig, samtidig med at du kan sætte retning og følge op på resultater. Du motiveres af forandringer, ser muligheder i nye løsninger og arbejder målrettet for at skabe udvikling og forbedringer.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med ledelse i en teknisk driftsorganisation
  • Har en teknisk uddannelse som maskinmester, elinstallatør, ingeniør eller tilsvarende
  • Har erfaring med el-tekniske anlæg og kan opnå eller allerede besidder el-autorisation
  • Har erfaring med SRO (Styring, Regulering og Overvågning)
  • Har erfaring med arbejdsmiljøledelse
  • Kommunikerer sikkert på dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk
  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for digitale værktøjer og systemer, eksempelvis Microsoft Dynamics 365

Kørekort er en forudsætning, da du skal rundt på flere lokationer.

Vi er klar til at byde dig velkommen

Du bliver teamleder for Drift Teknik, der er en del af sektionen Spildevand Egen Drift. Her er der yderligere to teams, hvor du sammen med deres teamledere indgår i en ledergruppe.

Dit team består af ca. 16 erfarne medarbejdere med teknisk kunnen og et godt sammenhold. Kulturen er præget af stor tillid og høj faglighed. Sammen skal I skabe en sikker forsyning for fremtiden ved styring af vores elektriske anlæg og brug af digitale værktøjer. Arbejdsstedet er Kløvermarken, Herjedalsgade i København.

Du kan læse mere om vores medarbejdergoder her.

Sådan bliver du vores kollega
Er du klar til nye muligheder, så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig senest den 29. november 2026. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt for dig at søge, du skal derfor ikke skrive en ansøgning, men blot sende dit CV, hvor du sætter nogle ord på din motivation for at søge stillingen. Du kan finde inspiration til at skrive et motiveret CV her.

Vi afholder 1. samtaler i uge 50 og 2. samtaler i uge 51.

2. samtale vil tage udgangspunkt i en personlighedsprofil, som du skal udfylde på forhånd.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Johnny Pedersen. Du kan skrive en mail til johpe@hofor.dk eller ringe på telefon 2795 3504.

Denne stilling kræver sikkerhedsgodkendelse til ”Fortroligt”, ligesom du skal kunne opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen gennem hele din ansættelse.

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen”.

title: 23844 - Engineer Senior Asset Management Structure and Bridge
description:
Manage or support areas of the statewide tunnel, bridge, ancillary, or other programs, as assigned. Coordinate efforts with relevant internal and external stakeholders. Provide engineering expertise in assigned program areas. Provide recommendations for resolution of project issues. Communicate with internal VDOT staff, local government staff, consultants, citizens and FHWA regarding transportation projects and programs. Assist in developing, implementing and monitoring policies, procedures, guidance and practices for engineering projects and programs.

How you will contribute:
  • Asset Management Program: Lead or participate in the development of and maintain a long-term asset management program for structural assets. Work includes development of near-term and long-term prioritized needs and work plans, reports of annual costs and accomplishments.
  • Communications: Communicate effectively with customers internal and external to VDOT including local governments, elected officials, citizen groups, and FHWA.
  • Conduct Engineering Studies: Participate in or oversee engineering studies. Collect, analyze and process data and information. Develop written reports, recommendations, and solutions that are technically accurate and compliant. Prepare business correspondence and technical letters with recommendations for suggested corrective measures as a result of studies. Prepare or present formal presentations for VDOT staff, or other organizations.
  • Policies and Procedures: Assist in the development of policies, procedures and practices reflecting proactive management of the assigned engineering program area.
  • Process Improvements: Develop, recommend and implement process and policy improvements as needed. Assist in monitoring compliance to ensure conformance to the policy, procedures and state and federal laws and regulations.
  • Project Management and Documentation: Organize work and monitor work tasks such that projects and documentation are completed within schedule using VDOT's standards, policies and procedures.
  • Project Team Participation: Participate or lead project teams as assigned. Ensure timely communications between project team members and stakeholders. Ensure information is technically accurate and effectively disseminated. Review and resolve challenges to enhance team performance.
  • Reporting and Studies: Develop reports describing the structural asset programs, priorities, accomplishments, risks, and needs. Responsible for the preparation of feasibility studies, cost and schedule estimates, consultant procurement, and the review of governing documents such as technical specifications.
  • Responsible Charge Engineer: Fulfill duties as responsible charge engineer in compliance with policies, procedures and the Code of Virginia.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate with stakeholders statewide to understand the current and planned activities for structural assets. Address safety and security, emergency response, risk, policy guidance, and inspection.
  • Technical Guidance: Provide technical advice for structural asset inspection, construction and maintenance. Review, comment, and assist in the development of specifications, procedural scope of work and contracts relating to structural inventory and inspection work. Review, comment, and assist in the development of consultant task orders for structural asset work and selection of consultants.


What will make you successful:
  • Ability to apply advanced engineering principles and practices to a variety of complex transportation projects.
  • Ability to build networks and relationships with employees from other divisions, field personnel, contractors, manufacturers and FHWA representatives.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with diverse audiences and to make presentations and conduct meetings.
  • Ability to develop effective working relationships at all organizational levels, both internally and externally.
  • Ability to draw rational conclusions and develop solutions from analysis; make independent decisions; and manage multiple assignments.
  • Ability to interpret and apply local, state and federal transportation laws, regulations and guidelines.
  • Ability to lead and coordinate a large group of stakeholders to find consensus on an action plan for maintaining a large assets or inventories.
  • Ability to plan, coordinate and manage multiple, concurrent assignments.
  • Ability to read and interpret plans, contracts, specifications and regulations.
  • Ability to readily learn and understand new technical subject matter, relating to assigned asset type.
  • Ability to research, analyze, and prepare technical reports and project correspondence.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Knowledge and understanding of asset deterioration and preventive maintenance.
  • Knowledge and understanding of asset management.
  • Knowledge and understanding of fundamental geotechnical hydraulic and geological principles.
  • Knowledge and understanding of investment decisions, value engineering and life-cycle cost analysis.
  • Knowledge of federal, state and local laws, codes and ordinances and policies pertaining to transportation engineering.
  • Knowledge of financial management to include budgeting and cost estimation.
  • Knowledge of project management processes.
  • Knowledge of strategic, operational and financial management principles, practices and techniques.
  • Knowledge of transportation engineering principles, practices, standards, and specifications.
  • Skill and ability to positively interact with employees, citizens and government officials.
  • Skill in delivering exemplary customer service and the ability to interact courteously and professionally with the public and other employees.
  • Skill in negotiating.
  • Skill in the use of computers and software applications to include engineering software.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • Ability to communicate in written and verbal forms, including ability to make presentations.
  • Considerable engineering knowledge associated with the management of complex highway assets.
  • Degree in Civil Engineering or related field.
  • Knowledge of relevant asset design and construction methods, such as tunnel and shaft support systems/techniques or bridge materials and construction methods.
  • Knowledge of specific design, construction, inspection, and/or maintenance considerations for assigned asset types,
  • Skill in delivering or managing construction, inspection, or maintenance projects involving highway structures.
  • Valid Professional Engineer's license.

Additional Considerations:
  • Collaborative skills with a track record of leading multi-discipline teams.
  • Experience in asset and data management of highway structures relevant to assigned asset types, such as complex facilities or structures.
  • Experience with maintenance projects involving highway structures.
  • Experience with project estimation, monitoring, cost control, and cost variance analysis.
  • Experience with structural access equipment, access methods and relevant workplace safety procedures and regulations.
  • Experience with ventilation, mechanical and electrical systems for tunnels or bridges with complex design features.
  • Extensive engineering experience associated with the inspection of assets, relevant to assigned program areas.
  • Successful completion of FHWA-NHI training courses, on subjects including but not limited to bridge inspection, ancillary inspection, scour, NSTM inspection, and load rating.

12 Month Secondment Opportunity/ Fixed Term Contract and Full Time

About Us:

Located in the heart of South London, Lambeth Borough is a vibrant community of over 317,600 residents. Stretching from the dynamic neighbourhood of Streatham in the South to the iconic landmarks of Waterloo in the North, we are proud to be the 9th largest borough in London. Our diversity is our strength, with more than 130 languages spoken, making Lambeth the home of the Windrush generation, London's largest LGBTQ+ community, and a thriving Portuguese-speaking community.

It is an exciting time to join Lambeth Council, we have bold ambitions for the future of Lambeth’s communities and residents through our Lambeth 2030 Plan ‘Our Future, Our Lambeth.

title: Akademisk generalist til udvikling af CPR
description:
CPR er en grundsten i det danske samfund, og området står over for en række vigtige opgaver i den kommende tid. Du har nu muligheden for at blive en del af det.

Vi søger en akademisk generalist, der kan drive processer fremad, skabe overblik over komplekse problemstillinger og omsætte dem til klare beslutningsgrundlag. Du skal trives med at ting går hurtigt, og du får en central koordinerende rolle på et område med stor samfundsmæssig betydning, hvor politiske dagsordener, faglige hensyn og konkrete løsninger skal gå hånd i hånd.

Om CPR

CPR er – også i en international målestok – et unikt register, som udgør et helt grundlæggende fundament for en smidig og effektiv administration i den offentlige og private sektor. Personnummeret er den entydige nøgle, der gør det muligt at sammenholde og ajourføre personoplysninger på tværs af en lang række både offentlige og private it-systemer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som generalist i CPR-administrationen får du en varieret opgaveportefølje, hvor du skal bidrage til at understøtte de beslutninger, der sætter retningen for området. Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med både faglige specialister, ledelse og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Opgaverne kan blandt andet handle om at omsætte nye behov og krav til konkrete initiativer, koordinere udviklingsopgaver og sikre, at komplekse problemstillinger bliver belyst og håndteret på et solidt grundlag.

Mere konkret vil dine arbejdsopgaver være at:

  • udarbejde beslutningsoplæg, notater og andre skriftlige produkter
  • drive og koordinere tværgående opgaver og udviklingsinitiativer
  • følge op på opgaver, beslutninger og leverancer og sikre fremdrift på tværs af involverede parter
  • bidrage til at udvikle arbejdsgange og processer med fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og en velfungerende forvaltning af CPR

Opgaverne vil udvikle sig i takt med CPR’s behov og dine kompetencer. Der er derfor mulighed for at præge stillingens indhold og tage ansvar for de områder, hvor du kan gøre størst forskel.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant akademisk uddannelse. Du kan være relativt ny på arbejdsmarkedet eller have nogle års erfaring fra en politisk styret organisation, offentlig administration eller en anden organisation med komplekse opgaver og mange interessenter.

Det vigtigste er, at du kan skabe overblik, arbejde struktureret og omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til klare anbefalinger og konkrete handlinger. Du trives med at tage ansvar for dine opgaver og kan bevare fremdriften, også når der er mange hensyn at balancere.

Du vil passe godt til stillingen, hvis du:

  • er analytisk stærk og kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til klare og præcise beslutningsoplæg
  • er god til at samarbejde og kan skabe fremdrift på tværs af fagligheder og interessenter.
  • arbejder struktureret, tager initiativ og følger dine opgaver til dørs

CPR-administrationen

CPR varetager dels opgaverne med CPR’s drift, vedligeholdelse og udvikling. Derudover leverer vi CPR’s data til offentlige myndigheder og den private sektor, dels opgaverne i forbindelse med CPR-lovgivningen, herunder folkeregistreringsreglerne vedrørende bopælssager, juridisk kønsskifte mv.

Vi er ca. 15 kollegaer i kontoret. Vi har et stærkt fagligt og socialt fællesskab, hvor vi vægter sparring og faglig udvikling højt. Vi bruger hinandens forskellige kompetencer, og tror på, at vi kommer bedre og hurtigere i mål, når vi samarbejder, videndeler og koordinerer.

Vi tager et fælles ansvar for at være en god arbejdsplads, hvor det er sjovt at gå på arbejde, og hvor der er plads til at udvikle sig.

Til daglig mødes vi som udgangspunkt på vores kontor i København tæt ved Kongens Nytorv, men du kan løbende aftale hjemmearbejde med din chef.

Du kan læse mere om os på .

Skal du være med til at forme fremtiden?
Viden former fremtiden, og i Forsknings-, Uddannelses- og Digitaliseringsministeriet arbejder vi for at skabe værdi i samfundet gennem fremragende uddannelse og forskning. Digitalisering er en del af danskernes hverdag og verden, og i Forsknings-, Uddannelses- og Digitaliseringsministeriet skal vi samtidig være Danmarks strategiske blik på digitaliseringen, så Danmark også kan være et digitalt foregangsland i morgen. Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere bidrager til et miljø præget af samarbejde, trivsel og resultater.

Løn og ansættelse

Du ansættes efter overenskomst for akademikere i staten og vil blive indplaceret som fuldmægtig eller konsulent med mulighed for at forhandle tillæg på baggrund af dine kvalifikationer.

Stillingen er på fuld tid. Vi forventer at byde vores nye kollega velkommen den 1. februar 2027.

Vi holder til hos Digitaliseringsstyrelsen, så arbejdsstedet er Landgreven 4, 1301 København K.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Maria Antonsen på 72 26 97 30.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og efterfølgende opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen i hele din ansættelsesperiode. I forbindelse med ansættelse vil du blive bedt om at fremvise en privat straffeattest.

Søg stillingen

Send ansøgning, CV og eksamensdokumentation elektronisk via stillingsopslaget på www.fudm.dk. Vi skal have modtaget din ansøgning senest fredag den 20. november.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 49-51.

Ligestilling i alle dens aspekter er vigtig. Derfor opfordres alle interesserede uanset etnisk tilhørsforhold, religion, køn, alder og lign. til at søge stillingen.

title: Loading Lead Associate
description:
Empower Your Future at One of the Nation’s Leading Independent Electrical Distributors!

At U.S. Electrical Services, Inc. (USESI), we combine over 100 years of expertise, $150M+ in inventory, and the power of 2,000+ dedicated employees across 150 locations to deliver excellence every day. As a family of 14 regional businesses, we thrive on innovation and teamwork, empowering our people to shape the future of the electrical industry.

USESI is looking for a motivated and dependable Loading Lead Associate to join our team in Cranbury, NJ. This hands-on position will help coordinate daily loading activities, support and train associates, and ensure outbound orders are loaded safely, accurately, and on time. The Loading Lead Associate will work closely with CDC management to communicate priorities and keep the team on track throughout the shift.

Job Type: Full-Time
Hours: 3rd Shift — 7:00 p.m. start time

Key Responsibilities:

  • Help coordinate daily loading activities and communicate work assignments and priorities established by CDC management.
  • Work alongside loading associates to load customer orders and transfers onto designated trucks according to routing instructions.
  • Verify that orders are staged accurately by delivery method and loaded in the proper sequence.
  • Check outbound loads for accuracy, completeness, stability, and proper securement before departure.
  • Monitor loading progress and communicate delays, shortages, damaged products, or other concerns to management.
  • Train and guide associates on loading procedures, safe equipment operation, order accuracy, and established work standards.
  • Support CDC operations by picking, packing, staging, and checking outbound orders as needed.
  • Secure shipments by shrink-wrapping pallets and following load securement procedures to protect products during transit.
  • Reinforce safety expectations and promptly report hazards, incidents, and equipment concerns.
  • Help maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment throughout the shift.
  • Support shift handoffs by communicating outstanding work and loading status to management and incoming team members.
  • Set a positive example through dependable attendance, teamwork, accountability, and a strong work ethic.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous warehouse, loading, shipping, or logistics experience preferred.
  • Prior lead experience or demonstrated ability to train and guide team members preferred.
  • Experience operating reach trucks and sit-down forklifts; certification may be required.
  • Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with inventory or warehouse management systems.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to provide clear direction and constructive feedback.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to identify loading issues, solve problems, and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Capable of lifting up to 50 pounds and standing for extended periods.
  • Positive attitude and a commitment to safety, accuracy, and teamwork.

title: Relationsstærk og kvalitetsbevidst driftleder
description:
- til Jeudans Facility-afdeling

Trives du med at tage styringen, strukturere processer og have kundekontakt? Synes du, det er sjovt at få den daglige drift til at køre som smurt? Og har du sans for salg og økonomi - og stort kendskab til rengøringsservice? Så er det dig, vi leder efter.

Som driftsleder i Renhold i Facility Service bliver du garant for, at Jeudans kunder altid møder en rengøring i top. Sammen med driftschefen, driftskoordinatoren og de to andre dygtige og dedikerede driftsledere, får du en helt central rolle for den positive udvikling og vækst af Renholdsafdelingen og Jeudans rengøringsservice generelt.

Sammen sørger I for, at alt spiller – fra kælder til kvist – i Jeudans over 200 ejendomme. Vi har fokus på at løse opgaver med høj kvalitet, til tiden og inden for den aftalte økonomi. Det bidrager din solide driftsstyring af vores rengøringsservice til.

DINE PRIMÆRE OPGAVER VIL VÆRE:

  • Daglig drift af din del af porteføljen (eksisterende kunder)
  • Kvalitetssikring
  • Kundebesøg og kundeopfølgning
  • Opfølgning på underleverandører
  • Tilbuds- og salgsarbejde i samarbejde med driftschefen
  • Personaleledelse og rekruttering
  • Ressourcestyring – herunder registrering af løntimer
  • Fakturering og oprettelse af rekvisitioner

ERFAREN LEDER MED GODE SAMARBEJDSEVNER
Vi søger dig, der har erfaring som leder – gerne fra en tilsvarende rolle i rengøringsbranchen. Din interesse for mennesker og du motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem andre. Du har en stærk faglig baggrund og vil være vores rengøringsfaglige fyrtårn med styr på kvalitetssikring, overflader, midler og metoder. Du er glad for at lære fra dig - og vi er glade for at lære mere!"

Din evne til at kommunikere er i top både mundtligt og skriftligt – på dansk og engelsk. Du arbejder fra din kontorplads, hvor du planlægger og styrer dine opgaver, men du tager også ofte på besøg hos vores kunder, som du skaber gode relationer med. Dine gode relationelle kompetencer bruger du også aktivt til at motivere dine medarbejdere og skabe fælles retning.

SMUKKE KLASSISKE RAMMER
Din nye arbejdsplads ligger i Bredgade 30-34 i København K, tæt på Marmorkirkens Metrostation. Jeudans hovedkontor består af tre klassiske ejendomme, der er slået sammen til én ejendom, hvor det pibler frem med detaljer og historiske kendetegn. Her arbejder omkring 300 medarbejdere, mens de resterende knap 400 arbejder ude i byen på Jeudans mange byggepladser eller som servicemedarbejdere hos vores kunder.

HER KAN DU FÅ
Jeudan byder på morgenmad og frokostordning i Bistroen, baristakaffe fra egen kaffebar, medarbejderaktieordning, massageordning, rabataftaler og en aktiv personaleforening. Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde, løn efter kvalifikationer inklusive pensions- og sundhedsordning.

ER JOBBET NOGET FOR DIG
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingschef Katrine Grathe på mail: kgra@jeudan.dk. Der er ingen ansøgningsfrist, da vi løbende tager kandidater ind til samtale.

title: Supervisor II  Production W
description:
Prior Experience in a Supervisory role in a Marine/Boat Manufacturing Environment is Highly Preferred

Everglades Boats is an industry leader in premium offshore fishing boats. Founded in 1997, Everglades provides the ultimate choice for discerning boat owners and knowledgeable big-water anglers. Everglades is a high-end, refined brand that makes a personal statement about the status and savvy of its owner by applying best-in-class fishing amenities, premium-grade materials, and a highly refined fit and finish. Widely recognized and respected in the industry for its hull performance and ride, Everglades patented RAMPCAP hulls are found throughout its model lineup. Receiving numerous industry awards and an unparalleled reputation for superior performance, Everglades recruits and retains the best talent in the industry.

Position Summary

As a representative of the company and a role model to team members, the Production/Operations Supervisor is responsible for consistently interpreting, communicating, and enforcing company policies and safety regulations. This individual identifies training and development needs and leverages available resources to address them. The Supervisor ensures that all team members meet expectations to deliver defect-free products on time, while promoting a safe, collaborative, and high-performing work environment in compliance with applicable regulations.

Responsibilities & Accountabilities

  • Coach, mentor, and provide performance management and constructive feedback to frontline team members.

  • Manage to key performance indicators (KPIs), production forecasts, and execution plans.
  • Ensure consistent adherence to company policies, procedures, and safety standards.
  • Determine and adjust staffing levels based on production demands.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to manage the value stream and meet production targets.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Foster a positive work environment through effective employee relations and development.
  • Make employment decisions, including hiring, assignments, training, and corrective actions.
  • Resolve employee issues and concerns through timely problem resolution.
  • Balance safety, quality, productivity, cost, and morale to achieve optimal outcomes.
  • Drive continuous improvement in safety, processes, and performance metrics.
  • Manage departmental KPIs, maintain visual controls, and report progress to leadership.
  • Provide leadership and oversight within a rolling 30-day production planning cycle.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal suppliers and customers to support workflow and schedule adherence.
  • Conduct accident investigations and maintain appropriate documentation.
  • Set and manage department priorities, ensuring resources are aligned with operational needs.
  • Monitor timekeeping and attendance to ensure accuracy and accountability.

Additional Functions

  • Identify future training and development needs for the production team.
  • Support and promote company-wide operating priorities and initiatives.
  • Lead all aspects of personnel management, including hiring, work assignments, equipment/workspace oversight, training, performance reviews, and career development.

Competencies

  • People Leadership
  • Performance Management
  • Problem Solving & Analysis
  • Results Driven
  • Communication Proficiency
  • Time Management
  • Technical Capacity
  • Learning Orientation

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience

  • Associate’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 3–5 years of direct supervisory experience in a production environment.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 5–8 years of direct supervisory experience in a production environment.
  • Prior experience as a Production or Operations Supervisor in an assembly department within the boat or marine manufacturing industry is highly preferred.

Physical Requirements:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
  • Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) requirements include eye protection, hearing protection, gloves, protective suits, dusts masks and respirators.
  • The employee is regularly required to be on their feet; occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Constant use of hands/hand tools for assembly, fine manipulation, inspecting parts, and/or machine operating. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 15 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Employees must be able to work a 10-hour shift or more in one workday, including planned and unplanned overtime.
