title: Custom Model Finisher - SLA
description:
Be yourself at Protolabs
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace. So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply! You can help make our company even better. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself. We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams.
Why Protolabs?
We are the leaders in digital manufacturing. We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home.

Join our team as a

Custom Model Finisher - SLA!

Monday - Friday (9 am - 5 pm)

Bring innovative designs to life as a Custom Model Finisher at Protolabs. In this hands-on role, you'll transform 3D printed parts into high-quality finished products through advanced finishing techniques, precision craftsmanship, and creative problem-solving. Working with cutting-edge additive manufacturing technologies, you'll refine, customize, and prepare parts to meet unique customer specifications while collaborating on custom projects, analyzing designs, and helping deliver exceptional results that turn complex ideas into reality.

What You Will Do:

  • Perform custom finishing by means of sanding, scraping, cutting, honing, polishing, and cleaning of additive manufactured parts.

  • Use of standard tools, such as: calipers, sandpaper, tweezers, clippers, air guns, dremels, drills, and soldering rods, specialized tools such as micro sanders, orbital sanders, and rotary tools, and other appropriate tools.

  • May fabricate custom tools necessary to complete specific finishing.

  • May assist Tech Ops to complete custom quotes.

  • Prepare parts for custom coatings with proper materials, including masking, mounting, repairing, bonding, etching, or priming parts.

  • Use of solvents or chemicals such as: aerosol primers and paints, epoxy, polyester glazing putty, and UV curing agents.

  • Use Protolabs and 3D CAD software to analyze details of individual parts and project custom requirements.

  • Use of taps to manually cut threads and install any required inserts.

  • Maintain and clean all custom finishing equipment to assure the continued use and longevity of the equipment.

  • May back up the Model Finisher team.

  • Use of computer workstation to review order and part information, and to enter related information regarding the order.

  • Follow and complete all applicable checklists.

  • Maintain a clean and safe work area and individual workspace and assist in general cleanliness and maintenance of the facility.

  • Assist in the removal and disposal of contaminated materials.

  • Continually seek ways to improve work processes and individual performance.

  • Follow processes to maintain appropriate inventory and supply levels.

  • Observe and follow all Protolabs Safety and Quality policies and procedures, including use of any required PPE (safety glasses, gloves, steel-toed footwear, etc.) and safety/compliance training.

What You Bring:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.

  • Minimum 1 year experience in the Finishing Department of the applicable technology group.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to focus on one task for extended periods.

  • Excellent hand eye coordination.

  • Able to work in a fast paced, team-oriented environment.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Must be able to effectively collaborate with team members, leaders, and other departments.

  • Must have strong service and quality focus.

  • Able to work safely with sharp tools/objects including hobby knives, utility knives, files, abrasives, rotary tools, general cutters and more.

  • Able to comprehend and follow printed and computer-screen instructions, and direction from Supervisors and Leads.

  • Must be able to read, write and speak communicate English fluently.

  • Must be able to perform basic arithmetic skills.

  • Able to use a computer and calculator.

  • Able to use measuring instruments such as scales and calipers.

  • Excellent punctuality.

  • Wear all required PPE (gloves, lab coats, etc.).

What Sets You Apart:

  • 18+ months of experience in the Finishing Department.

  • Craft-oriented experience (jewelry making, woodworking, etc.).

  • Experience with measuring tools and hand/power tools.

What's In It For You:

  • We offer a competitive salary and total rewards package
  • We offer amazing benefits including but not limited to:
  • Health Insurance: Traditional OR High Deductible plan
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Health Savings Account (including employer contributions)
  • Dental and Vision
  • Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  • Paid caregiver leave
  • You will receive at least 3 weeks of PTO + Wellness + Holiday Pay + Volunteer Hours
  • 401k with company match and immediate vest
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program at a discounted rate
  • Matching grants through Protolabs foundation
  • And More!
Proto Labs maintains ITAR-compliant operations in all of our United States based facilities. Due to ITAR regulations, this role is only open to U.S. Citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders) or foreign nationals granted refugee or asylee status. Individuals with temporary visas (e.g. E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, TN or OPT) are not eligible for hire in this role.
Proto Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer
Physical Demands:
While performing the essential duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use a computer keyboard, monitor and mouse, telephone and printer; reach with hands, and arms, talk, see and hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, stoop or kneel and must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
Work Environment:
Indoors (A/C); nonsmoking; the majority of this job function is performed in an office setting requiring normal safety precautions. However, there may be job duties that require the employee to spend time in the manufacturing areas exposed to machinery and noise; eye protection occasionally required. Occasionally works in outside weather conditions. Occasionally works near moving mechanical parts and in high, precarious places and is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, risk of electrical shock and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate.

title: Assistant Grocery Manager
description:
Why choose us?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Join us for an exciting opportunity at Albertsons Companies, where innovation and customer service go hand-in-hand!

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to the growth of a company that values great service and lasting customer relationships. This position offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that’s constantly evolving.


POSITION SUMMARY

The Assistant Grocery Manager supports the Grocery Manager in the daily operation of the Grocery Department, including customer service, merchandising, inventory management, product availability, associate supervision, and department conditions. This position helps ensure the department is properly stocked, organized, clean, and operated in accordance with company standards.

The Assistant Grocery Manager provides day-to-day direction to associates, supports department sales and operational goals, and assumes additional department leadership responsibilities in the Grocery Manager’s absence.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Leadership & Customer Service
  • Provides leadership, direction, and support to Grocery Department associates.
  • Promotes excellent customer service and responds to customer questions and concerns.
  • Assigns daily tasks and follows up to ensure work is completed accurately and timely.
  • Coaches associates on department procedures, customer service, merchandising, and operational expectations.
  • Supports a positive, professional, and team-oriented work environment.
  • Assists with training and development of new and existing associates.
  • Communicates department priorities, promotions, and operational expectations to associates.
Grocery Operations
  • Assists with the daily operation of the Grocery Department.
  • Ensures shelves, displays, endcaps, and promotional areas are properly stocked and maintained.
  • Monitors department conditions and addresses stocking, recovery, and merchandising needs.
  • Supports receiving, breaking down loads, stocking, backroom organization, and product rotation.
  • Ensures products are properly faced, rotated, and maintained.
  • Helps maintain a clean, organized, and safe sales floor and backroom.
  • Supports opening and closing responsibilities as assigned.
  • Assumes department leadership responsibilities in the Grocery Manager’s absence.
Inventory & Product Availability
  • Monitors inventory levels and product availability throughout the department.
  • Helps identify out-of-stocks, inventory discrepancies, and ordering opportunities.
  • Supports accurate ordering and inventory management processes.
  • Maintains proper product rotation and helps reduce product loss and shrink.
  • Ensures backstock is properly organized and worked to the sales floor.
  • Supports inventory counts and other inventory-control activities as assigned.
Merchandising & Sales
  • Executes merchandising plans, promotional programs, and seasonal displays.
  • Ensures promotional merchandise and displays are properly stocked, signed, and maintained.
  • Supports department sales and merchandising objectives.
  • Monitors product movement and identifies opportunities to improve sales and product presentation.
  • Ensures pricing and promotional signage are accurate.
  • Maintains department presentation standards throughout the shift.
Associate Supervision & Scheduling
  • Assists the Grocery Manager with associate scheduling and daily work assignments.
  • Helps ensure staffing aligns with workload and business needs.
  • Provides coaching and feedback to associates regarding performance and department expectations.
  • Communicates attendance, performance, or conduct concerns to appropriate store leadership.
  • Helps maintain productivity and effective utilization of scheduled labor.
Safety, Sanitation & Compliance
  • Ensures associates follow company safety policies and procedures.
  • Maintains clean and safe working and shopping conditions.
  • Supports proper lifting, stocking, equipment-use, and backroom safety practices.
  • Ensures products are handled, stored, and rotated appropriately.
  • Reports safety, maintenance, product-quality, and compliance concerns to appropriate leadership.
  • Supports shrink prevention, asset protection, and inventory-control procedures.

We also provide a variety of benefits including:

  • Competitive wages paid weekly
· Access to up to 50% of your earned wages before payday, via our partnership with Stream
  • Associate discounts
  • Health and financial well-being benefits for eligible associates (Medical, Dental, 401k and more!)
  • Time off (vacation, holidays, sick pay). For eligibility requirements please visit myACI Benefits
  • Leaders invested in your training, career growth and development
  • An inclusive work environment with talented colleagues who reflect the communities we serve

description:

title: Data Engineer
description:
Snowy Hydro is a dynamic, integrated energy business that has been providing on-demand, reliable energy to Australia for generations. Snowy Hydro owns and operates a powerful combination of generation assets, including the mighty Snowy Mountains Scheme, gas and diesel plants, and contracted wind and solar energy.

We also provide electricity and gas to over 1.5 million retail customers through our retail brands Red Energy and Lumo Energy. Snowy 2.0 is Australia's largest committed renewable energy project. This nation-building project will provide on-demand energy and large-scale storage for many generations to come.

Key Responsibilities

  • Medallion Architecture & Data Ingestion: Build end-to-end Medallion pipeline architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold), utilising open data formats such as Iceberg. Design and implement resilient native pipelines to connect into core enterprise systems, including SAP and ServiceNow. Collaborate closely with Data Governance, Data Architecture, and Reporting & Analytics teams to translate business intent into reusable data assets.
  • Data Modeling & CI/CD Production: Design, build, and test enterprise-grade data models using Snowflake-native capabilities, Python and SQL. Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of moving data models from development through testing into production using automated CI/CD pipelines.
  • Data Governance, Privacy & Pipeline Standards: Implement data quality validations, dynamic security controls, masking, and pipeline observability with automated alerting for failure detection. Develop automated unit, integration , and regression tests for data pipelines.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering & Innovation: Using AI coding agents (e.g. GitHub Colpilot, Cursor, Snowflake native AI features) with appropriate guardrails, prompt context, and rules to accelerate code wiring, data modelling, unit testing, and documentation generation.

About the location

This role is based in Sydney.

About you

  • Snowflake & Core Engineering Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in Snowflake environments (virtual warehouse optimisation, performance tuning) with expert level proficiency in Python and SQL for data transformation and modelling. Knowledge of Matillion is beneficial but not mandatory.
  • Enterprise Source Integration & Architecture: Proven track record of constructing Medallion architecture layers (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and setting up native connectors to ingest raw data from core enterprise systems such as SAP and ServiceNow.
  • CI/CD, Governance & Observability: Hands-on experience deploying data models through staging and production using Git and automated CI/CD pipelines, whilst embedding data quality validations, pipeline observability, and automated alerting.
  • AI Guardrails & Tooling: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to build, test and document data models, along with the ability to define prompt context, rules, and governance guardrails.
  • Business Acumen & Industry Experience: Strong business acumen to understand domain context, translate business goals into relevant and compliant data models, and ensure end-to-end utility. Background in a fast-paced or regulated industry (such as Financial Services, Energy, or Utilities) is highly regarded.

title: Post Doctoral Research Associate - Department of OBGYN
description: Position Summary The Postdoctoral Research Associate will participate in a 12-month Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH) Advanced Practice Nurse Fellowship offered through a partnership between the University of Illinois Chicago College of Nursing and College of Medicine. The fellowship provides advanced clinical training in comprehensive sexual and reproductive health care, including contraception, medication and procedural abortion, and early pregnancy loss management. The position combines supervised clinical experiences, didactic education, research, advocacy, leadership development, and scholarly activities. The fellow will work collaboratively with an interdisciplinary team of advanced practice nurses, physicians, and allied health professionals to develop clinical expertise and advance high-quality, evidence-based reproductive health care. Duties & Responsibilities • Clinical Practice and Patient Care (40%) • Participate in outpatient clinical rotations at Mile Square Health Center and the Center for Women's Health. • Develop clinical expertise in comprehensive family planning, contraception, early pregnancy loss management, and sexual and reproductive health care. • Conduct comprehensive health histories and physical examinations, assess patient needs, and develop individualized care plans in collaboration with supervising providers. • Provide comprehensive contraceptive counseling and care, including IUD and implant placement and counseling regarding permanent sterilization. • Deliver trauma-informed, patient-centered, evidence-based care using compassionate and culturally responsive communication. • Comprehensive Abortion Care Training (40%) • Participate in clinical rotations at affiliated abortion care facilities (Carafem, UIHealth, PPIL, Hope, Access). • Develop clinical knowledge and skills in medication and procedural abortion, ultrasound, patient counseling, follow-up care, and clinical workflows. • Apply current evidence-based practices and clinical guidelines in comprehensive abortion care. • Collaborate with interdisciplinary clinical teams to support safe, effective, and patient-centered care. • Education, Research, Advocacy, and Leadership Development (10%) • Participate in didactic seminars, educational activities, and professional development opportunities related to reproductive health, leadership, policy, and clinical practice. • Develop foundational research, advocacy, and leadership skills related to abortion access, reproductive health equity, and comprehensive sexual and reproductive health care in the United States. • Develop the knowledge and skills needed to integrate sexual and reproductive health care into future advanced practice clinical settings, including recognition of the clinical, organizational, legal, geographic, and social barriers and facilitators that affect abortion access. • Participate in scholarly, teaching, and quality-improvement activities that support the fellowship's objectives and advance high-quality comprehensive abortion care. • Collaborate effectively as a member of an interdisciplinary team and strengthen professional communication, consultation, presentation, and patient-education skills. • Elective Rotations and Scholarly Project Development (10%) • Participate in elective subspecialty clinical rotations aligned with professional interests and fellowship objectives. • Develop and advance an independent scholarly, research, quality-improvement, or advocacy project. • Collaborate with faculty and interdisciplinary teams on project activities and dissemination of findings. • Integrate knowledge and skills gained through clinical and scholarly experiences into future advanced practice nursing settings. • Perform other related duties and participate in special projects as assigned.

title: Konsulent til international arbejdskraft, netværk og virksomhedssamarbejde
description:
Konsulent til international arbejdskraft, netværk og virksomhedssamarbejde

Virksomhedsservice, Arbejdsmarkedsområdet i Billund Kommune

Vil du være med til at skabe stærke netværk, nye jobmuligheder og et godt hverdagsliv for internationale medarbejdere og deres familier i Billund?

Billund Kommune søger en engageret og relations stærk konsulent til en spændende stilling i krydsfeltet mellem virksomhedsservice, international arbejdskraft og lokal tilknytning.

Vi søger en medarbejder, der trives med at skabe relationer, bygge bro mellem mennesker og virksomheder og omsætte netværk til konkrete muligheder. Du motiveres af at arbejde med mennesker med forskellige kulturelle og faglige baggrunde og har lyst til at styrke både virksomhedernes adgang til arbejdskraft og internationale familiers mulighed for at skabe et godt liv i Billundområdet.

Stillingen er forankret i Virksomhedsservice på Arbejdsmarkedsområdet. Cirka halvdelen af arbejdstiden er knyttet til projektet Global Talent Billund i tæt samarbejde med Billund Erhverv, mens den anden halvdel består af opgaver som beskæftigelseskonsulent i Virksomhedsservice.

Om stillingen

Stillingen består af to tæt forbundne opgaver:

  • Cirka 50 % af arbejdstiden vil være knyttet til projektet Global Talent Billund.
  • Cirka 50 % af arbejdstiden vil være knyttet til de ordinære opgaver som beskæftigelseskonsulent i Virksomhedsservice.

Koblingen mellem de to områder er central. Gennem arbejdet i Virksomhedsservice opbygger du relationer til virksomhederne og får viden om deres behov for arbejdskraft. Den viden og de relationer bringer du aktivt i spil i arbejdet med internationale medarbejdere og deres medfølgende partnere.

Omvendt bidrager erfaringerne fra Global Talent Billund til at styrke virksomhedernes muligheder for at tiltrække, modtage og fastholde international arbejdskraft. Du bliver derfor en vigtig brobygger mellem virksomheder, internationale talenter, Virksomhedsservice, Billund Erhverv og lokalsamfundet.

Du bliver organisatorisk ansat i Virksomhedsservice på Arbejdsmarkedsområdet, men kommer i projektopgaven til at arbejde tæt sammen med Billund Erhverv samt med virksomheder, uddannelsesinstitutioner, mentorer, foreninger og andre relevante aktører.

Dine opgaver

Global Talent Billund

Du får særligt ansvar for aktiviteterne Open Door Events & Networking og Talents & Corporate Matchmaking. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • planlægge, koordinere og afholde netværksaktiviteter for internationale medarbejdere, medfølgende partnere og deres familier
  • facilitere arrangementer, netværksmøder og dialoger på engelsk
  • etablere og vedligeholde samarbejde med virksomheder, uddannelsesinstitutioner, kultur- og fritidsaktører samt frivillige fællesskaber
  • gennemføre individuelle samtaler med medfølgende partnere om job-, uddannelses- og karrieremuligheder
  • foretage kompetence- og karriereafklaring og understøtte kandidaternes vej mod job eller uddannelse
  • identificere relevante virksomheder og jobåbninger og skabe kontakt mellem internationale kandidater og lokale virksomheder
  • facilitere matchmaking mellem virksomheder og kandidater
  • bidrage til opbygning og aktivering af mentor- og netværksindsatser
  • dokumentere aktiviteter og følge op på resultater og progression.

Virksomhedsservice

Du indgår samtidig i de almindelige opgaver i Virksomhedsservice, herunder at:

  • samarbejde med virksomheder om rekruttering, fastholdelse og behov for arbejdskraft
  • skabe jobmatch mellem virksomheder og ledige borgere
  • gennemføre virksomhedsbesøg og varetage relations skabende og opsøgende arbejde
  • rådgive om beskæftigelsesrettede muligheder og ordninger
  • samarbejde tværgående med kolleger på Arbejdsmarkedsområdet
  • bidrage til udviklingen af en virksomhedsrettet og resultatorienteret indsats.

Vi søger en kollega, der

  • er stærk til at skabe relationer og netværk
  • trives med kontakt til både borgere, virksomheder og samarbejdspartnere
  • er initiativrig og kan arbejde selvstændigt
  • har blik for muligheder og kan skabe forbindelser mellem mennesker og virksomheder
  • er nysgerrig på andre kulturer og motiveres af internationale samarbejder
  • kan planlægge og koordinere aktiviteter fra idé til gennemførelse
  • kan skabe struktur, følge op og bevare overblikket i en hverdag med mange samarbejdsflader.

Faglige kvalifikationer

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra ét eller flere af følgende områder:

  • virksomhedsservice eller beskæftigelsesområdet
  • rekruttering og jobmatch
  • karrierevejledning og kompetenceafklaring
  • HR eller talentudvikling
  • projekt- eller netværkskoordinering
  • arbejde med internationale borgere, medarbejdere eller studerende
  • planlægning og facilitering af events og netværk.

Vi lægger særlig vægt på, at du

  • behersker engelsk på et rimeligt niveau i både skrift og tale og er tryg ved at gennemføre samtaler, møder og netværksaktiviteter på engelsk
  • er en stærk facilitator og kommunikator
  • kan skabe tillid hos både borgere og virksomheder
  • har flair for at omsætte relationer og netværk til konkrete job- og uddannelsesmuligheder
  • trives i en rolle med mange samarbejdspartnere og en høj grad af selvstændighed.

Vi tilbyder

  • en spændende og meningsfuld stilling med stor selvstændighed
  • mulighed for at arbejde i spændingsfeltet mellem beskæftigelse, virksomheder og international arbejdskraft
  • et stærkt fagligt fællesskab i Virksomhedsservice
  • et tæt samarbejde med Billund Erhverv og områdets virksomheder
  • mulighed for at sætte dit præg på en ny og ambitiøs indsats
  • en varieret hverdag med mange relationer og samarbejdsflader.

Hvem er du?

Måske er du virksomhedskonsulent, beskæftigelseskonsulent, karriererådgiver, HR-konsulent eller projektmedarbejder. Det vigtigste er ikke din nuværende titel, men din evne til at skabe relationer, facilitere netværk og bygge bro mellem mennesker og virksomheder.

Vi leder efter en medarbejder, der ser muligheder, skaber forbindelser og har lyst til at være med til at gøre Billundområdet til et attraktivt sted at arbejde, bo og leve for internationale medarbejdere og deres familier.

Kort sagt søger vi en brobygger mellem internationale talenter, virksomheder og lokalsamfund.

Praktiske oplysninger

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, så send meget gerne en sms eller ring til afdelingsleder Bettina Andersen på telefon 29386250.

Ansøgningsfrist er onsdag d. 9. december kl. 23.59.

Første samtale afholdes d. 14. december. Der kan blive behov for anden samtale som afvikles d. 15. december online.

title: Head of Insights & Product Delivery
description:
The Head of Insights & Product Delivery serves as the strategic bridge between North America business priorities and enterprise analytics capabilities, leading the end-to-end lifecycle from first-mile solutioning to supporting last-mile delivery. Overseeing North America product modeling and analytics product teams for commercial, underwriting platforms, and claims insights, this leader harmonizes regional and global efforts to build and deploy scalable, high-quality data analytic assets and AI capabilities. The role partners closely across stakeholders (business, product owners) to co-create and lead the build and delivery of various types data & analytic solutions that align to business strategy, address business needs, and drive measurable outcomes, working with various teams – global analytics, global data, and IT. This leader brings strong acumen in business intelligence, data science, product development, and technical delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive business engagement to ensure alignment of analytics and platform capabilities to enterprise and North America strategy, business priorities, and adoption needs.
  • Lead the model through which business problems become real, deployed solutions.
  • Partner and collaborate closely with global teams to align on product roadmap and manage communications with business stakeholders to determine fit, execute planning, and prioritization of capabilities into business solutions.
  • Key technical lead overseeing diverse team of modelers, data scientists, product owners and business delivery leaders.
  • Lead first-mile solution definition, build, and platform/product delivery across multiple business domains and capabilities.
  • Set strategy and direction for solutioning for product modeling and business delivery teams, leading and providing oversight to NA Data & Analytics teams supporting Commercial Product, UW Claims Product, Commercial Data Science, and UW Claims Data Science.
  • Partner with Global Analytics and GDO to manage the flow of data & analytic product deployments into the business and facilitate integration of global assets into business work processes.
  • Partner with business and product operations teams on prioritization, backlog management, strategic portfolio management, and execution of post deployment quality and feedback loops.
  • Partner internally within NA Data & Analytic team to support adoption and scaling of AI capabilities and to drive last-mile delivery readiness and successful handoff for IT and business integration of completed data & analytics assets.
  • Drive the harmonization of North America, Global Analytics, and GDO on critical strategic items to ensure alignment, consistency, and execution.
  • Strengthen cross-functional alignment with underwriting, actuarial, claims, global teams, and enterprise technology.
  • Govern solution standards, technical standards alignment, and reusable asset development.
  • Shape the next generation of underwriting, claims, and consumer analytics capabilities.
  • Collaborate and partner with other NADA leaders to plan, develop, and execute solutions – including AI and Asset Integration/Business Deployment teams.
  • 15+ years of experience leading data, analytics, AI, or platform programs.
  • Strong executive presence.
  • Deep technical and systems expertise, particularly in the insurance space, including policy administration and claims systems.
  • Strong understanding of insurance datasets and data products.
  • Proven ability to deliver at scale in a complex, regulated enterprise.
  • Experience in P&C insurance or other regulated industries preferred.
  • Execution-focused, strategic, and cross-functional.
  • Commercially oriented and people-first.
  • Ability to translate business needs into delivery momentum.
  • Expertise in enterprise AI/ML, digital product lifecycle management, and large-scale delivery.
  • Strong predictive modeling experience.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and delivering complex initiatives.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and strategic planning abilities.

The pay range for the role is $273,900 to $397,100. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. Chubb offers a comprehensive benefits package, more details on which can be found on our careers website. The disclosed pay range estimate may be adjusted for the applicable geographic differential for the location in which the position is filled.

title: Bliv en del af Bo og Læring – Vi mangler vikarer i Lyngsø og Ungbo
description:
Bo og Læring består af 3 afdelinger inden for handicap og psykiatri, hvoraf vi mangler tilkaldevikarer til Lyngsø og Ungbo. Begge steder ligger i Grindsted.

Vi søger dig, som brænder for arbejdet med mennesker og har lyst til at gøre en positiv forskel i borgernes hverdag. Samtidig, går vi op i at du har et stort gåpåmod, høj grad af engagement og et stærkt fokus på den enkelte borgers behov, ressourcer og udviklingsmuligheder.

Som vikar hos os, bliver du en del af en faglig hverdag, hvor relations arbejde, struktur og nærvær er centrale elementer.

Det er kun en fordel, hvis du har erfaring inden for området med handicap og psykiatri.

Ungbo:

Ungbo er et døgndækket §107 tilbud, målrettet unge i alderen 17 til 30 år. Opholdet er midlertidigt og har primært et afklarende formål. Målet er at støtte den unge i at opnå kompetencer til at kunne bo i egen bolig – eventuelt med støtte – eller at finde det mest hensigtsmæssige fremadrettede tilbud. Borgerne er fysisk velfungerende, men kan have en bred variation af psykiske eller sociale udfordringer og diagnoser.

Derudover tilbyder Ungbo §85 støtte til borgere i nærmiljøet samt til 4 borgere, der bor i et opgangsfællesskab i samme bygning som Ungbo.

Vagterne på Ungbo kan variere og kan være dag, aften, nat og weekendvagter.

Lyngsø:

Bofællesskabet Lyngsø er et §105 tilbud med §85 støtte, til voksne udviklingshæmmede. I Lyngsø bor 8 borgere, alle med mod på livet og med mange ønsker og drømme.

Alle borgere er mobile og klarer flere opgaver selvstændigt. Din fornemmeste opgave i løsning af kerneopgaven, er at stå bag borgeren og via guidning og støtte, motivere borgerne til at gøre det de kan, selvstændigt. Vi skal kunne sætte os på vores hænder, så vi ikke fratager borgerne deres ressourcer og kompetencer.

Vagterne i Lyngsø vil variere, det kan både være dag, aften og weekendvagter.

Fælles for alle afdelinger, er at vi arbejder ud fra kerneopgaven:

”Med respekt for borgernes selvstændighed og selvbestemmelse vil vi – gennem tværfaglig, professionel støtte, vejledning og omsorg – motivere den enkelte til at mestre livsudfoldelse og bevare identitet.”

Vi forventer af dig:

  • At du har engagement og vilje til at lære nyt og udvikle dig fagligt samt personligt

  • At du kan reflektere over egen og andres praksis og er villig til at dele dine refleksioner med henblik på læring

title: Strategisk etableringsledare IAM, hälso- och sjukvård
description:
emagine söker: Strategisk etableringsledare IAM, hälso- och sjukvård (kompetensnivå 4)

Vår kund inom offentlig sektor/hälso- och sjukvård bygger en sammanhållen infrastruktur för identitets- och behörighetshantering (IAM). Den ska ge en gemensam grund och möjliggöra informationsutbyte, både internt och med externa aktörer. Programmet tar fram lösningsdesignen för en första version av IAM-lösningen och förbereder implementationen, i takt med införandet av ett nytt huvudjournalsystem.

Vi söker en senior etableringsledare som leder arbetet hela vägen från behovsanalys och kravställning till upphandling och operativ etablering av plattformen, med dess anslutande system och förmågor. Rollen verkar i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, IT, informationssäkerhet, upphandling och externa leverantörer. Den omfattar också leverantörsstyrning och att etablera arbetssätt, processer och en mottagarorganisation för förvaltningen.

Uppdragsinformation

  • Start: deltid från 2026-12-08, heltid från 2027-01-01

  • Omfattning: 100 %

  • Längd: t.o.m. 2028-06-30, med option på förlängning 2 × 6 månader

  • Plats: Stockholm, cirka 60 % på plats, resten på distans efter överenskommelse

  • Språk: svenska och engelska, flytande i tal och skrift

Ska-krav

  1. Minst 10 års dokumenterad erfarenhet i ledande roller (förvaltningsledare, förändringsledare, verksamhetsutvecklare, uppdragsledare) i komplexa organisationer och systemlandskap inom hälso- och sjukvård, e-hälsa eller offentlig sektor.

  2. Aktuell erfarenhet av praktisk etablering, övertagande eller införande av nya plattformar, IT-system, leverantörer eller förmågor.

  3. Aktuell erfarenhet av upphandling och inköpsprocesser: behovsanalys, kravställning, utvärdering och underlag för upphandling av IT-system/plattformar, licenser, konsulter eller applikationsförvaltningsleverantörer.

  4. Aktuell erfarenhet av operativ och strategisk leverantörsstyrning, inklusive avtalsuppföljning och införande av ny leverantör.

  5. Erfarenhet av förändringsledning, verksamhetsutveckling och att bygga struktur, styrformer och arbetssätt i miljöer med delade ansvarsytor.

  6. God förståelse för IAM: roller, informationsflöden, systemberoenden och integrationsbehov.

  7. God förståelse för regional hälso- och sjukvård och de regulatoriska krav som påverkar åtkomst- och behörighetshantering, inklusive Patientdatalagen, sekretess och spårbarhet.

  8. Erfarenhet av att leda workshops, genomföra intervjuer, förankra strategiska vägval i styrgrupper och pedagogiskt presentera komplexa underlag.

  9. God förståelse för katalogtjänst, masterdataplattform, personuppgiftstjänst och autentiseringstjänst och deras beroenden inom IAM.

Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet från en större regions vårdnära IT-miljö, särskilt katalogtjänst på Evidian DirX, masterdata på Tibco EBX och autentisering/identitetshantering med Clavister/PhenixID (PAS, Identity Manager, Identity Provisioning).

  • Erfarenhet av upphandling, etablering och förvaltning av samhällsviktiga, verksamhetskritiska plattformstjänster som katalog-, masterdata- och autentiseringstjänster.

  • Erfarenhet av systemförvaltning kopplad till centrala katalog- och behörighetslösningar mot anslutande system.

  • Erfarenhet av licensupphandling och av att onboarda och styra leverantör till full avtalsuppfyllnad från start.

Referensuppdrag (krav)
Konsulten ska kunna redovisa två referensuppdrag. Båda ska ha pågått sammanhängande i minst 6 månader, någon del av dem ska ligga inom de senaste 5 åren, och de får inte ha avbrutits i förtid.

  • Uppdrag 1: Du har självständigt lett arbetet med att etablera struktur, samverkansformer och leverantörsstyrning vid införande, övertagande eller etablering av en ny leverantör, plattform eller systemnära tjänst i en komplex vård- eller systemmiljö.

  • Uppdrag 2: Du har analyserat verksamhetens behov och självständigt drivit kravställning och upphandling av applikationsförvaltningsleverantör, system, licenser och/eller specialistkonsulter, kopplat till förändringsledning och verksamhetsutveckling.

title: Kostfaglig kollega til Børnekøkkenet
description:
Brænder du for ernæring og det gode måltid, og kan du bidrage med godt fagligt niveau med fokus på den gode patientoplevelse? Er du glad for at arbejde omkring børn, og klar på at tilberede og servere alle deres livretter?

Børnekøkkenet på Rigshospitalet har beliggenhed i Juliane Marie Centeret, på Børneonkologisk afdeling, men står overfor at skal flytte til helt nye omgivelser når Mary Elisabeths Hospital står færdigt i 2027. Du har derfor en unik mulighed for at blive en del af udviklingen sammen med øvrige kollegaer i børnekøkkenet, hvor vi gør os klar til nyt kostkoncept og test før indflytning.

Vi søger en dygtig kollega, som skal være med til at sikre, at patienterne får dækket deres næringsbehov under indlæggelsen. Arbejdet indebærer bland andet tilberedning, anretning og servering af dagens tre hovedmåltider, samt mellemmåltider og snacks ved behov.

Du vil i høj grad være i direkte kontakt med patienterne og deres familier, da vores køkken er åbent og i forbindelse med spisestuen. Køkkenet er for mange af vores børn og familier et frirum, hvor man skal kunne tale om stort og småt samtidig med, at man får noget at spise. Du skal derfor kunne trives i dialog med patienter og pårørende, som kan være i kritiske tilstande.

Eksempler på opgaver:

  • Tilberede, anrette og servere mad efter en fastlagt plan
  • Vaske op, rydde op og holde rent
  • Udføre egenkontrol
  • Bidrage til at patienterne får dækket deres næringsbehov under indlæggelsen
  • Være med til at sætte et positivt præg på måltidsoplevelsen og højne den kulinariske kvalitet
  • Bidrage med gode idéer til små og store arrangementer, som kan sætte lidt guldkant på børnenes ophold

Vi forestiller os:

  • At du er uddannet ernæringsassistent, kok, Professionsbachelor i Ernæring og Sundhed eller anden kostfaglig uddannelse
  • At du er serviceminded, rummelig og smilende
  • At du trives i omgivelser med børn i alle aldre
  • At du bidrager med faglig viden indenfor kost og ernæring til kollegaer og patienternes pårørende
  • At du kan arbejde selvstændigt og er fleksibel
  • At du er en god bidragsyder til det gode arbejdsmiljø
  • At du er imødekommende for nye tiltag og har lyst til at bidrage til udviklingen
  • At du taler, forstår og skriver dansk
  • At du er stabil

Vi tilbyder:

  • At være del af et sammentømret team hvor dine kollegaer er af blandet baggrund, køn og alder
  • Et meningsfyldt arbejde, hvor du gør en stor forskel for patienterne og deres pårørende
  • Stor mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på måltider og oplevelser til patienterne
  • En spændende arbejdsplads i udvikling, med udsigt til at arbejde i det nye børnehospital Mary Elizabeths hospital, som lige nu er ved at bliver bygget.

Ansættelsesvilkår:

Fastansættelse 20-25 timer pr. uge.

Ansættelse 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Arbejdstiden vil være i tidsrummet 06:30 til 19:00 med weekendvagt hver 4. weekend. Vi serverer mad alle årets dage, hvorfor der også forekommer arbejde på helligdage som fordeles mellem kolleger i fællesskab.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst for ikke-ledende personale på sundhedskartellets område.

Der skal fremvises børneattest ved ansættelse.

Kontakt og ansøgning:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamkoordinator Nana Johannsen Rasiah på tlf. 20 15 83 50 eller på mail: nana.johannsen.rasiah@regionh.dk

Sådan søger du:

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante uddannelsesdokumenter via linket i annoncen.

Ansøgningsfrist d. 20. november 2026.

Der afholdes ansættelsessamtaler i uge 48.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Hvem er vi:

Børnekøkkenet hører under Enhed for mad og drikke (EMD) som er en del af Rigshospitals servicecenter.

EMD har i alt ca. 280 medarbejdere fordelt på 2 matrikler: Rigshospitalet Blegdamsvej og Rigshospitalet Glostrup. Vores medarbejdergruppe spænder bredt – fra elever, ernæringsassistenter, slagtere, bagere, kokke, hospitalsmedhjælpere til administrative medarbejdere.

I EMD lægger vi vægt på professionalisme i vores opgaveløsning og på at være en åben og imødekommende samarbejdspartner. Vi stræber efter at være i front, når det gælder kvalitet, nytænkning og effektivisering – uden at gå på kompromis med medarbejdertrivsel.

Vi arbejder ud fra værdierne, trivsel, ansvarlighed, troværdighed samt professionalisme. Det er derfor helt naturligt, at du kan se dig selv i disse værdier og vil være med til at arbejde ud fra dem.

title: Registered Medication Associate (RMA)
description:
Pay Range: $20 - $23.50 per hour

The Registered Medication Associate (RMA) role provides high quality care and services to meet the overall needs of residents in a caring, consistent, individualized, and efficient manner. He or she ensures that residents receive comprehensive care and services by assisting them in the administration of medications, in accordance with state licensing and regulatory standards. The Registered Medication Associate is a Culture Ambassador who will model the core values of the company, leading by example, and ensure all team members exemplify the core values of the company.

• We Care About People

• We Do the Right Thing

• We are Passionate, Have Fun, and Celebrate Success

• We Speak Up! It is Our Responsibility

• We Take Ownership and Add Value

• We are Respectful

Full-time associates are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, which may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability options
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Paid time off
  • Employee assistance program
  • Additional voluntary benefits

Qualifications

• This employee must have successfully completed course work and examinations to obtain certification as a Resident Care Associate.

• The RMA must obtain continuing education credits as required by the state to maintain certification as an RMA and must provide evidence of continued certification to the community in a timely and accurate manner.

• The RMA must possess knowledge of safe medication administration techniques and demonstrate this knowledge through a competency skills evaluation.

• CPR and First Aid certified or willing to obtain as per company policy.

• The RMA must understand and practice resident confidentiality.

• The RMA must have the ability to work weekends and flexible hours as needed for resident care and services.

• The RMA must have the ability to show sincere compassion and demonstrate genuine concern for the physical and emotional needs of seniors and their families.

• Must be proficient in basic office equipment, including a personal computer, for the purpose of accomplishing and maintaining a high level of job performance.

• Live out Commonwealth Senior Living’s Noble selling purpose – “We improve the lives of seniors, their families, and each other.”

Areas of Primary Responsibility

• Assists in monitoring and safe delivery of the Medication Management Program.

• Adheres to all established policies and procedures of Commonwealth Senior Living and state regulatory standards when administering medications.

• Administers and accurately records the administration of medications for residents as prescribed by the physician.

• Presents medication to residents and observes ingestion or completion of other application or administration techniques.

• Observes, records, and reports complications, symptoms of adverse actions or side effects of medications and obtains input from the Resident Care Director, as indicated, to ensure the optimum health and safety of the resident.

• Determines and records effectiveness of medications in a timely and accurate manner.

• Documents refusals of medications and reasons why prescribed drugs are not administered as per physician order.

• Stores medications in a safe and accurate manner.

• Monitors medications to ensure adequate accountability measures are taken when medications are ordered, received into the community, administered, and reported off at change of shift.

• Documents on the Daily Shift to Shift Communication Log each shift with resident and medication updates, changes, concerns, and follow up.

• Demonstrates safe handling of controlled substances including appropriate shift counting and reporting of discrepancies or concerns to the Resident Care Director.

• Routinely inspects, cleans, audits, and monitors equipment and supplies to ensure resident safety. Reports any equipment or supply issues to the Resident Care Director for correction or repair.

• Obtains, records, and reports vital signs as indicated during the administration of medications.

• Records and restocks medication inventories, as needed, and requested.

• Re-orders resident medications from pharmacy, as needed, and requested.

• Documents pertinent information in the resident record, completes incident reports as indicated.

• Demonstrates awareness of proper infection control practices by using Universal Precautions and following policies and procedures of the company, including OSHA’s Blood-Borne Pathogen Standard.

• Communicates with residents, staff and others in an accurate and factual manner and seeks clarification from or refers questions to Resident Care Director, when indicated.

• Prioritizes and provides verbal encouragement and support to residents.

• Assist in maintaining a safe and clean environment.

• Maintains a positive and professional demeanor toward residents, families, and associates.

• Participates in and attends all required in-service training and education programs as scheduled.

• Acts as a shift supervisor when appropriate or as directed.

• Maintain regular communication with the Resident Care Director.

• Perform other duties as assigned or as listed in the Resident Care Associate job description.

Physical/Sensory Requirements

The RMA must be able to lift, stoop, carry, turn, and assist high-risk residents, push medication carts and be willing and able to work a flexible work schedule. The RMA must be able to sit, stand, bend, and move continuously during work hours. Must be able to lift and/or carry 50 to 75 pounds. This position is considered a medium risk for exposure to COVID, as it provides direct care to potential COVID-positive residents.

title: Clinical Assistant
description:
The Clinical Assistant (CA) works under the guidance of the Director of Quality & Compliance. This team member assists in receiving patients and serves as a liaison between the physician, patients, and other staff members.

  • Greet every patient in an exam room
  • Build initial chart by entering New Patient form data into EMR, keep updated with each visit to comply with MIPS requirements to include Pharmacy, Allergies, Current Medications, Family History, Medical History, Social History, Surgical History
  • Update the patients’ allergies, medications, HIPPA, surgical history, medical history with changes.
  • Explain and provide Advance Directive information/instructions for pamphlet
  • Address depression screening and go through PHQ 2/9 survey if needed
  • Relay any complaints, refill requests, etc. to the provider if needed
  • Look at vitals, if not WNL retake manually, report any vital that is not WNL, verify pain scale is charted
  • FMLA/Disability paperwork
  • Administer vaccinations
  • Specialty pharmacy prescription processing
  • Chaperone for Provider
  • Manage Telehealth visits by checking patients in within Aria, provide test results to provider, provide checkout sheet to provider and take to front desk for processing of next appointments.
  • Assist patients with Cyracom (Interpreter Servies via IPAD using app)
  • Serve as back-up for lab for staffing when proficient in venipuncture.
  • Monitor Navigating Care Triage and Patient Portal Dashboard for specialty drug refills

title: Part Time Hospital Services Technician
description:
Part Time Hospital Services Technician

Working up to 16 hrs a week

$19/hr, Good Benefits, Day Shift & No Weekends

Job Summary:

The Certified Radiologist Assistant is an experienced, registered radiographer who has obtained additional education and certification that qualifies them to serve as a radiologist extender. The Certified Radiologist Assistant works under the supervision of a radiologist to provide quality patient care in a hospital and/or outpatient facility.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Able to perform a variety of hospital and outpatient procedures following the protocols established by the hospital and/or outpatient facility.

2. Conducts initial and on-going assessment of patients' medical and physical status, periodic evaluation, and progress notes. Records pertinent data in the medical record.

3. Implements physician-directed treatment plans. Conducts patient/parent education and counseling covering health status, test results, disease processes, and discharge planning. Explains effects and potential side effects to the patient prior to the exam.

4. Demonstrates compassion to ensure quality patient care and satisfaction while maintaining patient confidentiality.

5. Performs various procedures, follow-up patient evaluations, and communicates findings to the radiologist.

6. Evaluates images for completeness and diagnostic quality, and recommends additional images within the same modality as required. Reports clinical observations to the radiologist.

7. Demonstrates current competence based on results of OPPE and outcomes with a minimum of care for at least 50 diagnostic radiology cases within the past 24 months.

Work Experience/Educational Requirements:

Current certification or registration as a Registered Radiologist Assistant (R.R.A.) granted by the ARRT.

Licensed by the State of Florida as a Certified Radiologist Assistant or be able to obtain licensure prior to employment.

Documentation of the number and types of cases performed during the past 24 months.

Must be able to successfully obtain hospital privileges as a CRA/RRA.

Current ACLS certification.

Skills/Physical Requirements:

Skills in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with staff and patients, and the ability to work independently.

This job requires prolonged sitting or standing, frequent bending, stooping, or stretching; Must be able to see with or without corrective eyewear, must be able to hear clearly, with or without assistance. This position may require lifting 50 plus pounds.

title: Vil du gøre en forskel for børn med funktionsnedsættelser og deres familier? Vi søger Børne- og Ungerådgiver til vores børnehandicapteam
description:
Vi søger dig, der har en særlig interesse indenfor børn med funktionsnedsættelser og deres forældre.

I vores team får du en vigtig rolle i, at hjælpe familier med at finde vej i en hverdag, der ofte er præget af mange spørgsmål, hensyn og komplekse problemstillinger.

Du vil ikke bare hjælpe med at træffe afgørelser, du vil hjælpe familier med at få hverdagen til at hænge bedre sammen. Du kommer tæt på familiernes virkelighed og får mulighed for at omsætte din socialfaglige viden til løsninger, der kan skabe mere overskud, sammenhæng og muligheder for barnet og familien.

Du kommer til at arbejde med nogle af de spørgsmål, der kan have stor betydning for familiernes hverdag, herunder med behandling af ansøgninger om tabt arbejdsfortjeneste, kompensationsydelser og anden støtte omkring familierne og børnene.

Faxe kommunes børne- og ungeafdeling er i god udvikling og vores område er højt prioriteret af politikerne. Vi har igennem det sidste år, opnormeret med flere kollegaer, så der er mere tid og plads til faglig udvikling, med et mål om at have styr på lovmedholdeligheden og det gode samarbejde med børnene og deres familier.

Du vil blive en del af et team på op til 10 børne- og ungerådgivere, hvor vi ikke forventer at du skal have alle svarene selv.

Vi bruger hinanden i hverdagen, sparrer om svære vurderinger og hjælper hinanden når en sag kræver et ekstra blik. Vi tror på at faglighed og godt kollegaskab går hånd i hånd. Samt at der både skal være plads til faglige diskussioner, et godt grin og en kop kaffe.

Vi har fra 1. maj 2026 fået en ny organisering, som skal sikre tættere ledelse i hverdagen. Herunder er der teammøde hver uge med bevillingskompetence. Vi lægger vægt på det gode arbejdsmiljø, som for os handler om psykologisk tryghed, ordentlighed, tydelig kommunikation og en god tone i hverdagen.

Udover arbejdet med barnets lov, ønsker vi at øge samarbejdet mellem myndighed og udfører og styrke den tidlige forebyggelse.

I det næste år vil vi fortsætte arbejdet med vores udviklingsplan for Familieområdet herunder forløb med Task Force, koblet direkte til vores hverdag. Vi er i en spændende proces, hvor vi på Familieområdet og direkte med vores tætte samarbejdspartnere i kommunen, ønsker at arbejde ud fra tilgangen LØFT.

Hvis du har lyst til at være med i denne spændende udviklingsproces og gerne vil gøre en forskel for børn, unge med funktionsnedsættelser og deres familier i Faxe Kommune, så er det dig vi søger!

Vi tilbyder:

  • En afdeling, hvor myndighed og udfører er samlet under en tæt DUO ledelse, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen for at løse opgaven.
  • Dygtige, hjælpsomme og omsorgsfulde kollegaer, som sætter pris på godt humør og socialt samvær.
  • God mulighed for faglig sparring både fra kollegaer, teamledere, jurister og øvrig ledelse.
  • Fokus på kvalitet, systematik og høj faglighed i sagsbehandlingen.
  • Et afvekslende job, hvor du i høj grad selv tilrettelægger dine arbejdsopgaver.
  • Gode muligheder for at præge arbejdsgange og indgå i udviklingsopgaver.
  • Ekstern supervision.
  • Fleksibel arbejdstid og mulighed for hjemmearbejde.

Om dig:

  • Du er uddannet socialformidler eller socialrådgiver – eller i gang med sidste del af uddannelsen.
  • Du har særlig interesse for myndighedsarbejdet indenfor børnehandicap.
  • Du værdsætter og søger faglig udvikling.
  • Det er en fordel hvis du har erfaring fra myndighedsarbejdet og et godt kendskab til lovgivningen.
  • Du arbejder systematisk og kan skabe og bevarer et overblik i komplekse opgaver.
  • Du er god til at udtrykke dig mundtlig og skriftlig – du er særlig god til at formidle lovgivning og rettigheder til de børn og familier du arbejder med.
  • Du har lyst til at reflektere over egen praksis og udvikle dig fagligt sammen med dine kolleger
  • Du har kendskab til DUBU, ICS og LØFT
  • Du er initiativrig og ansvarlig i din opgaveløsning – opsøger hjælp og sparring, når det bliver svært.
  • Du har lyst til at bidrage til det gode arbejdsmiljø i samspil med kollegaer, ledelse og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Du har gode relationelle kompetencer og gode samarbejdsevner.
  • Du har kørekort.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Lønnen fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst og efter reglerne om Ny Løn. Børne- og straffeattest indhentes inden ansættelse

Opstart: 1.1.2027 eller hurtigst muligt

Ansøgningsfrist: er d. 19.11.2026

Ansættelsessamtaler:

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler fredag d. 24. november 2026

title: Post Doctoral Fellow, Center for Earthquake Research and Information (CERI)
description:
The postdoc will work in the earthquake physics group at the Center for Earthquake Research and Information (CERI) under supervision of Dr. Goebel and should contribute broadly to geothermal and induced seismicity research. Specific research topics include seismicity analysis, machine learning, reservoir modeling, geothermal reservoir characterization, and geomechanics. The postdoc should contribute to and collaborate with other group members on multi-disciplinary research problems in induced seismicity, earthquake physics, volcano seismicity and earthquake triggering.

The University of Memphis is located in Memphis, TN, a vibrant, friendly, and affordable major city in the Mid-South. Memphis is home to essential Civil Rights histories as well as multiple healthcare, logistics, and technology headquarters. The city boasts a rich and diverse culture. It is the cradle of both Blues and Rock ‘n Roll and has a strong historical legacy. The city is located near the New Madrid and Eastern Tennessee seismic zones and home to CERI’s extensive seismic network.

The postdoc will work in the earthquake physics group at Center for Earthquake Research and Information (CERI) under supervision of Dr. Goebel and should contribute broadly to geothermal and induced seismicity research. The postdoc should contribute to and collaborate with other group members on multi-disciplinary research problems in induced seismicity, earthquake physics, volcano seismicity and earthquake triggering.

The ideal candidate enjoys teamwork and has the ability to connect observational, and theoretical results across different scales. The postdoc is encouraged to seek collaborations with different faculty at CERI, the seismic monitoring team, and other departments at the University of Memphis such as Civil Engineering, Earth Sciences and the Center for Applied Earth Science and Engineering Research.

The preferred start date is January 1st, 2027, but later dates may be possible. Applicants should upload: 1) CV; 2) statement of research interest - 1-page max.; 3) a list of three references (email and phone number), and two exemplary publications. Candidate screening will start on November 18, 2026, and continue until the position is filled. Questions may be directed to Dr. Goebel (thgoebel@memphis.edu). Applications can be submitted online at: https://workforum.memphis.edu.

Ph.D. completion in geophysics, structural geology, engineering seismology or a related discipline within 2½ months after being hired.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

The University of Memphis is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.

title: Associate Dir, Medical & Scientific Affairs
description:
About Us
We are a publicly traded pharmaceuticals company committed to improving patient outcomes through
the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of innovative therapies. Our Legal and
Compliance team is a strategic partner to the business, supporting a dynamic portfolio of branded,
generic, and specialty pharmaceutical products. We foster a culture built on integrity, collaboration, and
a shared sense of purpose.
At ANI Pharmaceuticals, there are opportunities to contribute to our purpose every day. We value
authenticity, knowledge, and hard work, we strive to celebrate our employees in a positive
environment. Our culture empowers everyone to be successful and apply our full potential

Job Summary

The Associate Director, Medical & Scientific Affairs will play a key role in the development and execution of publication plans, medical and scientific communications, and medical material review activities across the rare disease portfolio. Working closely with Medical Affairs leadership, this role will be responsible for managing publication and scientific communication initiatives aligned with the broader Medical Affairs strategy, supporting the timely dissemination of clinical and scientific evidence, and ensuring the development of accurate, balanced, and compliant scientific content.

The Associate Director will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including Clinical Operations, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, and external scientific experts, to support scientific exchange and evidence dissemination across the product lifecycle. This role requires strong scientific expertise, strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to independently manage complex projects and competing priorities in a dynamic rare disease environment. This is a hybrid position requiring three days per week in the office.

Position Responsibilities
  • Support the development and manage the execution of publication and scientific communication plans aligned with Medical Affairs strategies and priorities across the rare disease portfolio.
  • Manage the development of scientific publications, including peer-reviewed manuscripts, abstracts, posters, oral presentations, and plain language summaries, ensuring scientific accuracy, quality, and timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to identify publication opportunities, evidence gaps, and scientific dissemination priorities.
  • Coordinate with external investigators, authors, and publication agencies to support publication development, review, and submission in accordance with Good Publication Practice (GPP), ICMJE recommendations, and applicable company policies.
  • Identify and recommend appropriate peer-reviewed journals, scientific congresses, and other channels for dissemination of clinical and scientific evidence.
  • Manage the development of core scientific narratives, medical slide decks, disease-state educational materials, and other evidence-based scientific communication resources.
  • Translate complex clinical trial results, real-world evidence, and emerging scientific data into accurate, balanced, and clear scientific communications for internal and external audiences.
  • Coordinate scientific congress activities, including the development and review of abstracts, posters, presentations, and related scientific materials.
  • Support the development and scientific review of materials for advisory boards, investigator meetings, and other Medical Affairs scientific engagement activities.
  • Represent Medical Affairs in medical, legal, and regulatory review processes, providing scientific expertise to ensure the accuracy, balance, and appropriate substantiation of medical and promotional materials.
  • Manage external publication and medical communication agencies, including project timelines, deliverables, and budgets, in alignment with established Medical Affairs priorities.
  • Independently manage assigned publication and scientific communication initiatives, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality scientific outputs.
Skills/Competencies
  • Scientific and clinical expertise with the ability to interpret and communicate complex data.
  • Strategic and analytical thinking.
  • Cross-functional leadership and collaboration.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to compliance.
  • Strong project management skills.
  • Ability to develop high-quality scientific content and deliver impactful medical information services.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex scientific data into clear, concise, and balanced communications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; strong interpersonal and collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving rare disease environment with a high degree of autonomy and accountability.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent scientific judgment, manage competing priorities, and provide recommendations to Medical Affairs leadership.
Qualifications
  • Advanced scientific/clinical degree required (PharmD, PhD, MD, or equivalent).
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in Medical Affairs, Scientific Communications, Publication Planning, or related functions within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry (rare disease experience strongly preferred).
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical industry regulatory and compliance requirements, medical material review processes, and scientific publication standards, including GPP and ICMJE recommendations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing publication development, medical and scientific communication deliverables, cross-functional review processes, and external publication or medical communication agencies.
  • Experience interpreting and communicating clinical trial results, real-world evidence, and other scientific data to healthcare and scientific audiences.

The base salary range for this position is $175,000-$230,000; the exact salary depends on various factors such as experience, skills, education, location, competencies and industry-specific knowledge. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a competitive short term and long term incentive program based on performance and company results.

ANI Pharmaceuticals offers a variety of benefits to eligible employees, including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, paid holidays and paid time off. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.

title: Fagligt stærk og handlekraftig Teamleder til vores vedligeholdsafdeling i Havnsø.
description:
På Stryhns Gruppens fabrik i Havnsø er stabil drift afgørende for vores succes. Derfor søger vi en fagligt stærk og handlekraftig Teamleder til vores vedligeholdsafdeling. Er det dig?

Til vores tekniske afdeling søger vi en Teamleder, som kan sikre den daglige drift, skabe overblik i en travl hverdag og være tæt på de tekniske udfordringer, når de opstår.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt og engageret team, hvor du får ansvaret for at koordinere ressourcer, prioritere opgaver og sikre, at produktionen kan køre videre, selv når uforudsete nedbrud kræver hurtig handling.

Stillingen er for dig, der trives med at være tæt på driften og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem både faglighed, planlægning og samarbejde.

Daglig drift, koordinering og teknisk overblik

Du bliver Teamleder i vedligeholdsafdelingen og får en central rolle i den daglige koordinering af et kompetent team af teknikere og reparatører, som hver dag arbejder for at sikre høj oppetid på fabrikken. Personaleansvaret ligger hos den tekniske chef, mens du får ansvaret for den daglige koordinering, planlægning og prioritering af opgaverne.

Som Teamleder skal du have indsigt i, hvordan maskinparken og de tekniske installationer fungerer, så du kan prioritere opgaver, fordele ressourcer og understøtte teamet i hverdagen.

Jobbet kræver stor selvstændighed og evnen til at bevare overblikket i en hverdag, hvor prioriteterne ofte ændrer sig. Du er med, hvor tingene sker, og bidrager selv aktivt, når situationen kalder på det.

En vigtig del af rollen er at håndtere akutte nedbrud. Du skal kunne bevare overblikket, prioritere indsatsen og sikre, at de rette ressourcer sættes ind de rigtige steder, samtidig med at den øvrige drift understøttes bedst muligt.

"Vi lykkes bedst, når vi er tæt på driften, hjælper hinanden og finder løsninger sammen. Derfor søger vi en Teamleder, som både kan skabe overblik og være en aktiv del af hverdagen i afdelingen." fortæller Dennis Holmgaard Larsen, Teknisk Chef i Havnsø.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sikre den daglige drift og koordinering i vedligeholdsafdelingen.
  • Planlægge og fordele opgaver mellem afdelingens teknikere.
  • Håndtere akutte nedbrud og prioritere ressourcer, så produktionen påvirkes mindst muligt.
  • Deltage aktivt i fejlfinding og tekniske problemstillinger ved behov.
  • Bidrage til planlagt vedligehold og løbende forbedringer.
  • Samarbejde om afdelingens økonomi og sikre, at driften understøtter budgetmålene.
  • Udarbejde og følge op på vagtplaner i samarbejde med teknisk chef.
  • Drive tavlemøder og sikre opfølgning på afdelingens mål og KPI'er.
  • Gennemføre mindre maskin- og procesrelaterede projekter.
  • Bidrage til et sikkert og velfungerende arbejdsmiljø.

Fagligt stærk Teamleder med bred driftsforståelse

Vi forestiller os, at du har en teknisk baggrund og erfaring fra produktions- eller procesindustrien.

Vi forventer ikke, at du er specialist i alle anlæg, men du har en bred teknisk forståelse og interesse for de systemer, der holder fabrikken kørende. Du har gerne erfaring med produktions- og pakkemaskiner, procesanlæg, el og automatik samt utility-anlæg som køl, ventilation, trykluft, varme- og vandforsyning. Derudover har du forståelse for tekniske installationer og bygningsvedligehold i en produktionsvirksomhed.

Hos os spænder opgaverne bredt. Den ene dag handler det om et kritisk nedbrud på en produktionslinje, den næste om en ventil, en port, et tag eller et toilet, der kræver opmærksomhed.

Det vigtigste er, at du kan skabe overblik, forstå sammenhængene i driften og prioritere de rette ressourcer, når hverdagen kræver det.

Struktureret, handlekraftig og god til at bevare roen

Du er dygtig til at planlægge og organisere, og du arbejder struktureret og vedholdende.

Samtidig er du handlingsorienteret, har et godt overblik og evnen til at bevare roen i pressede situationer, så du kan træffe de rigtige prioriteringer, når det gælder.

Derudover er du:

  • En synlig og nærværende Teamleder, som naturligt tager ansvar og skaber fremdrift.
  • God til at skabe samarbejde og engagement.
  • Beslutningsdygtig og løsningsorienteret.
  • Positiv af natur og god til at motivere andre.
  • Praktisk anlagt og ikke bange for selv at tage fat.

Hverdagen er præget af højt tempo, og prioriteterne kan ændre sig flere gange i løbet af dagen. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du trives i en omskiftelig hverdag og kan bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver kræver din opmærksomhed samtidig.

Tillid til hinanden og et stærkt fællesskab – dét er vores opskrift på den gode hverdag

Når du arbejder hos Stryhns Gruppen, bliver du en del af et større mærkevarehus med fokus på kvalitet, udvikling og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Hos os får du engagerede kolleger, der hjælper hinanden og løfter i fællesskab. Vi tror på, at vores medarbejdere er vores vigtigste ingrediens, og vi arbejder hver dag for at skabe rammerne for en god hverdag med plads til både faglig og personlig udvikling. For når vores medarbejdere lykkes, lykkes vi som virksomhed.

Hos Stryhns Gruppen hjælper vi danskerne til en nemmere og bedre hverdag – vil du være med?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte Teknisk Chef, Dennis Henrik Holmgaard Larsen på tlf.nr. 26795812, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.
Send din ansøgning og dit cv hurtigst muligt, da vi behandler de indkomne ansøgninger løbende.

Ansøgningen sendes via knappen ’Søg stillingen’ til højre.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

I. Job Summary

Responsible for monitoring material bunker levels and activating the conveyors and controls to bale sorted recyclable material.
