title: Proposal + Grant Writer
description:
The Organization

What if K-12 education were designed to help all students develop lives of meaning and purpose? Wayfinder, a division of Lemnis, was founded at the Stanford d.school to answer this question. Our goal is to double our impact each year for the coming years. Our vision is to become the preeminent future-readiness curriculum company in the world — leading the global movement of purpose, meaning, and belonging-based education worldwide.

Wayfinder joined the Lemnis Collective as a nonprofit division in 2026. As a public charity, Lemnis is dedicated to the concept of the unlimited learner. Their mission is to create more accessible, flexible, learner-centered systems that help young people navigate the challenges and opportunities of the future. Wayfinder and Lemnis share that vision, especially when it comes to supporting learners in underserved communities and the institutions that serve them.

Wayfinder is the third organization to join the Lemnis Collective. The Collective brings mission-aligned organizations (both for-profit assets and nonprofits with earned revenue) under the Lemnis umbrella through mergers and acquisitions. Lemnis provides long-term, mission-driven investment, stability, freedom from the pressure of constant fundraising, and operational and strategic support, so organizations like Wayfinder can stay focused on our mission, impact, growth, and innovation.

What We Value

You’ll be joining a team of incredibly motivated and dedicated staff members committed to living our organization's values. We work collaboratively across teams, and we feel and act like a purpose-driven organization. To the best of our abilities, each person’s role aligns with their own sense of purpose, which feeds into Wayfinder’s larger sense of purpose.

Read this article about our workplace culture in Conscious Company.

We value equal access, inclusive community, and belonging, and these values are represented in our product, our team, and our school partners.

Product: We develop our learning tools using human-centered design principles. We work with grade-level experts to ensure our curriculum is developmentally appropriate and engaging at all levels. Every Wayfinder lesson is supported by relevant research, prototyped in classrooms, and vetted by teachers over rounds of feedback and iteration. We use Universal Design for Learning principles to give every student an equal opportunity to succeed.

Team: Our team is composed of people from all different backgrounds and walks of life. We intentionally recruit, hire, and work with people of all identities + experiences. We focus on belonging: being connected, accepted, and valued by the people around us.

School Partners: We intentionally target a wide array of educational partners, from traditional to non-traditional, that work with a range of students from different socioeconomic groups. We’ve taught our curriculum in high-need schools in the Bronx, independent schools in Silicon Valley, and after-school programs in San Antonio.

Responsibilities

Your work will fall into a few areas, and we expect them to evolve.

Proposals + RFPs

  • Vet incoming RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, and help the team decide which ones to pursue

  • Write, edit, and submit clear, compliant responses on time

  • Build and maintain a library of approved answers, templates, and references

  • Work cross-functionally and pull in the right input from the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams

Grants + Funding

  • Seek out and research funding sources that fit Wayfinder and our partners’ goals

  • Write grant applications and funding narratives

  • Help new partners connect Wayfinder to the funding they already have

Co-op Partnerships

  • Own our relationships with cooperative purchasing organizations

  • Manage contract renewals, reporting, fees, and compliance requirements

  • Help Sales use co-op contracts to shorten the path to purchase for new partners

  • Spot new co-ops and state contract options worth pursuing

Pricing + Quotes

  • Know our pricing, packaging, and discount guidelines inside and out

  • Build accurate quotes and pricing sections for proposals and bids

  • Flag requests that need leadership approval before they go out

Whatever Comes Next

We’re a growing team, so you’ll pitch in where it counts (ex: follow-up emails, one-pagers, and school board materials).

Requirements

Essential experience

  • Three or more years writing proposals, grants, or other persuasive business content

  • Strong writing and editing skills that make complex ideas clear, warm, and jargon-free

  • Familiarity with pricing, quoting, and contract terms

  • Strong project management skills and the ability to juggle several deadlines at once - we move fast!

  • A startup mindset: flexible, resourceful, and quick to take initiative

  • A seller’s instinct for listening first, understanding what a district needs, and shaping the answer around it

  • Ease working across teams with Sales, Marketing, and Product

Preferred experience

  • Experience in K-12, edtech, or public-sector procurement

  • Experience managing cooperative purchasing contracts

  • Experience with proposal management software

  • APMP certification (a plus, not a requirement)

Benefits

We offer a competitive package that is based on location and experience. We also offer the following benefits:

  • + 403b: We care about your ability to save for your future.

  • + Family Focus: Parental leave and flexibility for families.

title: Color Assistant
description:
Principal Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Functions**):

Responsibilities:

We are looking for a skilled Color Assistant to support our finishing team on the swing shift. This role is critical to ensuring a seamless workflow between colorists, editorial, and operations during afternoon and evening hours, including theatrical finishing sessions. Unlike an apprentice role tied to a single colorist, this position serves the entire color team, assisting across multiple projects—including theatrical releases—and ensuring that work moves efficiently through the post-production pipeline.

This is a flexible-location role—some days will be spent in Burbank, others in Hollywood, based on project needs.

Key Responsibilities:

Project preparation & media management

  • Set up and organize projects for color sessions.
  • Ingest, conform, and manage media, ensuring all assets are ready before grading sessions.
  • Track and apply editorial updates as they come in.
  • Perform color tracing across timelines and projects to verify accuracy, and flag any assets delivered in an incorrect color space for correction with production.
  • Prepare color suites ahead of scheduled session start (typically 15+ minutes prior) and verify project integrity and playback performance before client arrival.

Rendering & quality control (QC/QA)

  • Render final graded content and review outputs against the colorist’s timeline for accuracy and consistency.
  • Check for technical or visual errors, ensuring deliverables meet quality standards.
  • Set up fixes for any issues flagged in QC, as coordinated by production or the client.
  • Label and organize all rendered elements according to project naming conventions.
  • Alert production immediately if delivery timelines or cutoffs are at risk.

Technical setup & support

  • Route video signals and set up calibrated monitors for accurate color reproduction.
  • Ensure all technical systems are functioning properly before color sessions.
  • Report machine downtime or technical issues to production and engineering immediately, logging tickets through Freshdesk as needed.
  • Liaise with engineering when technical troubleshooting is needed.

Theatrical finishing support

  • Support theatrical finishing sessions with working knowledge of DCI (Digital Cinema Initiatives) specifications and theatrical EDR (Extended Dynamic Range) workflows.
  • Assist with shooting and calibrating theaters using CR (colorimeter) and/or PR (photometer/spectroradiometer) probes.
  • Help prepare and QC theatrical deliverables, including DCP-related color and technical checks.
  • Support sessions with high-end filmmakers and director clients, maintaining a professional, detail-oriented presence in the theater and on the client-facing side of the workflow.

Collaboration & workflow management

  • Collaborate with the workflow department and imaging science team to determine proper color pipelines for each project.
  • Work with clients as needed to ensure workflow paths align with final deliverable requirements.
  • Protect and prepare final assets for studio archives to ensure long-term preservation.
  • Work closely with online editors, operations, deliverables, and producers to ensure a smooth workflow from edit to color and back.
  • Send out streaming session invites and coordinate with clients as needed.
  • Monitor and maintain workflow efficiency to avoid bottlenecks.
  • Log completed tasks accurately and submit them promptly to support billing and project tracking.

Session handoff & communication

  • Capture and maintain hero stills across timelines.
  • Provide clear handoff notes to the incoming shift and production team for any ongoing projects at the end of each shift.
  • Keep production informed of prep status, session progress, and any issues that could impact sessions, schedules, or deliveries.

Light color work & VFX integration

  • Perform basic color correction when checking VFX drop-ins, color tracing, and QC fixes.
  • Ensure VFX elements are properly integrated within the final color timeline.

Required Skills:

  • 2+ years of experience in a post-production color or editorial support role.
  • Strong understanding of color workflows, video formats, and deliverables.
  • Knowledge of color spaces, color-managed workflows, and LUT/CDL application is a must.
  • Knowledge of DCI specifications and theatrical EDR mastering workflows.
  • Experience shooting theaters with CR and/or PR probes for theatrical calibration and QC.
  • Comfortable working with high-end filmmaker clients in a theatrical finishing environment.
  • Experience with color grading software (e.g., DaVinci Resolve, Baselight, or similar).
  • Familiarity with editorial workflows and conforming techniques, including offline editing and file-based workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of HDR and Dolby Vision workflows.
  • Knowledge of digital capture cameras and camera files.
  • Familiarity with mobile storage devices and formats.
  • Avid and/or Final Cut Pro experience a plus.
  • Experience with a task-based or work-order system.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with an ability to teach and support others.

Preferred Skills:

  • Must be flexible with scheduling based on production deadlines, including theatrical delivery timelines.
  • Must be able to work occasional overtime, weekends, and variable shifts as needed.

Qualifications:

Education:

  • High School education or equivalent required.
  • BA/BS in applicable field preferred.

title: Coach
description:

title: MongoDB Database Reliability Engr
description:
Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) / Advanced Software Engineer

Location: Hyderabad
Function: Engineering / Platform & Data Infrastructure

About the Role

We are looking for a highly experienced Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) with deep expertise in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch to own and support mission-critical database platforms serving enterprise SaaS applications. This role is not suitable for candidates with only development or basic DBA experience. The ideal candidate has extensive hands-on experience designing, operating, troubleshooting, and optimizing large-scale production environments containing millions of records, supporting 24x7 high-availability systems with strict uptime SLAs. The engineer will independently diagnose complex database failures, perform failovers, optimize performance under load, ensure business continuity, influence technical direction, and mentor junior engineers.

Database Design & Architecture

  • Architect and implement scalable, high-availability MongoDB solutions including replica sets, sharded clusters, Atlas deployments, and disaster recovery architectures.
  • Design, implement, and manage MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch environments across development, staging, and production.
  • Define schema design standards, sharding strategies, indexing approaches, data lifecycle management, and capacity planning.

Production Reliability & Operations

  • Own 24x7 production database operations with accountability for uptime, reliability, and SLA compliance.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex database incidents, execute failovers, recovery activities, root-cause analysis, and business continuity procedures.
  • Lead rolling upgrades, patching, migrations, and maintenance with minimal or zero downtime.

Performance & Optimization

  • Analyze query patterns, design optimal indexes, tune aggregation pipelines, and eliminate bottlenecks.
  • Monitor performance metrics and drive continuous improvements using profiler, explain plans, Atlas tools, and observability platforms.
  • Optimize high-volume databases containing millions of records and heavy workloads.

Security & Reliability

  • Implement RBAC, TLS/SSL, encryption, LDAP integration, auditing, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Ensure enterprise-grade database security, resilience, and operational governance.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Define database best practices, review data models, and provide technical leadership.
  • Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with development, platform, SRE, and DevOps teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 8–12 years of database engineering, DBRE, DBA, or related experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on MongoDB production support experience.
  • Deep expertise in replica sets, sharding, Atlas, replication, failover, query tuning, and aggregation framework.
  • Strong PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch administration and performance tuning experience.
  • Experience managing databases supporting enterprise SaaS applications and millions of records.
  • Cloud experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP and strong Linux administration skills.
  • Programming experience in .NET, Java, Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or similar technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MongoDB Certified DBA or Developer certification.
  • MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, time-series collections, Ops Manager, or Cloud Manager experience.
  • Experience with Kafka, Spark, Redis, Elasticsearch, Azure Cosmos DB, and database migrations.
  • Background in SaaS, telemetry, IoT, or large-scale enterprise data platforms.

title: IT Business Partner
description:
Vil du sætte retning for IT-initiativer, der gør en forskel for forretningen?

Hos Weibel Scientific udvikler og producerer vi avancerede radarsystemer til kunder over hele verden. Vi er i kraftig vækst og søger en erfaren IT Business Partner, der vil være med til at forbinde forretningens ambitioner med teknologiens muligheder.

Her får du en central rolle i at gøre moderne teknologi anvendelig og værdiskabende på tværs af R&D, Engineering, Produktion, Logistik og Supply Chain. Dit fokus bliver hele produktets livscyklus, fra de første udviklingsaktiviteter og engineering-data til produktion, materialeflow, levering og løbende forbedringer.

Vi søger en IT Business Partner, der kan forstå forretningens arbejdsgange, skabe et fælles billede af udfordringerne og omsætte dem til enkle, prioriterede og forståelige IT-leverancer. Du skal hjælpe organisationen med både at realisere hurtige gevinster og bygge et mere sammenhængende digitalt fundament for fremtidig vækst.

Skab sammenhæng i produktets livscyklus med teknologi

Du bliver en del af IT-organisationen og refererer til vores IT Director. Som strategisk og praktisk bindeled mellem forretning og IT arbejder du tæt sammen med ledere, procesejere og specialister i R&D, Engineering, Produktion, Logistik og Supply Chain.

Din opgave er at identificere, hvor teknologi kan fjerne friktion, reducere manuelt arbejde, forbedre datakvaliteten og skabe et mere lean samarbejde på tværs. Det kan f.eks. være bedre sammenhæng mellem produktdata, engineering-værktøjer, PLM, ERP og produktionsprocesser, enklere workflows eller anvendelse af AI til videnssøgning, dokumentation, beslutningsstøtte og automatisering.

Du følger behovet fra den første dialog til et modent initiativ med tydeligt problem, forventet effekt, scope, sponsor og ejerskab. Sammen med forretningen og relevante IT-specialister afklarer du muligheder, afhængigheder, data, sikkerhed, økonomi og forandringsbehov, så beslutninger kan træffes hurtigt og på et forståeligt grundlag.

Rollen skal både kunne skabe momentum gennem afgrænsede forbedringer med hurtig effekt og bidrage til langsigtede roadmaps for capabilities, processer, data og teknologi. Du skal ikke selv designe alle tekniske løsninger eller drive alle projekter. Din styrke ligger i at skabe retning, forbinde de rette mennesker og sikre, at IT-leverancer bliver forståelige, anvendelige og målrettet reel forretningsværdi.

Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder bliver at:

  • Opbygge stærke relationer til R&D, Engineering, Produktion, Logistik og Supply Chain og forstå deres mål, processer og udfordringer.
  • Identificere muligheder for at forbedre hele produktets livscyklus og levering gennem bedre processer, data, integrationer og digitale færdigheder.
  • Omsætte behov og forbedringsmuligheder til en prioriteret pipeline af forståelige IT-initiativer med klare mål, scope, effekt og ejerskab.
  • Bidrage til sammenhængende roadmaps på tværs af PLM, engineering-værktøjer, ERP, produktionssystemer, integrationer og data.
  • Udarbejde beslutningsgrundlag, der balancerer forretningsværdi, brugerbehov, økonomi, risici, sikkerhed, data og organisatorisk kapacitet.
  • Prioritere initiativer og udvikle langsigtede roadmaps sammen med forretningen og IT
  • Facilitere beslutninger i relevante ledelsesfora og følge op på forretningsværdien

Din profil

Du trives i krydsfeltet mellem teknologi, processer og mennesker. Du kan gå tæt på en arbejdsgang, stille de spørgsmål der afdækker det reelle problem og samtidig løfte dialogen til et strategisk niveau. For dig er teknologi ikke et mål i sig selv, men et middel til at skabe bedre samarbejde, kortere gennemløbstider og mere robuste leverancer.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du kan skabe tillid på tværs af fagområder og oversætte mellem forretningens og ITs sprog. Du udfordrer konstruktivt, gør kompleksitet håndterbar og hjælper interessenter med at se både de hurtige muligheder og de langsigtede konsekvenser.

Vi forestiller os, at du har:

  • En relevant videregående uddannelse inden for IT, business eller engineering – eller tilsvarende relevant erhvervserfaring
  • Erfaring fra en forretningsnær IT-, digitaliserings-, transformations- eller løsningsarkitekturrolle, gerne med indsigt i R&D og Operations
  • God teknologiforståelse og erfaring med behovsafdækning, interessenthåndtering og facilitering på ledelsesniveau
  • Erfaring med business cases, prioritering og roadmaps samt blik for målbar forretningsværdi
  • God teknologiforståelse og evne til at vurdere muligheder inden for AI, automatisering, data, integrationer og moderne enterprise-platforme.
  • Evne til at kommunikere komplekse sammenhænge enkelt og skabe klare forventninger til IT-leverancer.
  • Stærke kommunikationsevner på dansk og engelsk

Ansøgning og kontakt

Søg venligst jobbet via vores hjemmeside senest den 29. november 2026.

Har du spørgsmål inden da, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores IT Director, Thomas Steinmetz, på thst@weibel.dk

Vær opmærksom på, at ansættelse forudsætter ren straffeattest og PET sikkerhedsgodkendelse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

You will lead the Project Execution Team consisting of 10 highly skilled engineers distributed across our two Danish development locations.

Our headquarters are located at Agro Food Park in Skejby, where approximately half of the team is based. The remaining team members are located at our development site in Glyngøre. As Project Execution Team Manager, you will be responsible for driving alignment, collaboration, and a strong team culture across both locations, ensuring that the teams operate as one.

The role requires a visible and engaged leadership presence at both sites. You should therefore expect to spend time every week at both the Agro Food Park headquarters in Skejby and the Glyngøre office, working closely with employees, Product Owners, Business Developers, and key stakeholders at both sites. Your ability to build relationships, develop people, and maintain strong execution across geographically distributed teams will be a key success factor.

Working closely with Product Owners, Business Developers, and senior management, you will help transform ideas into successful products while ensuring effective resource allocation, operational excellence, and a high-performing engineering organization.

Your role

As Project Execution Team Manager, you will be responsible for leading and developing the Project Execution Team. You will ensure that resources are allocated effectively, competencies continue to develop, and projects are executed according to priorities, project model, and strategic objectives.

You will act as the operational counterpart to Product Owners and Business Developers, enabling efficient execution across the development portfolio while maintaining visibility, structure, and accountability throughout the organization.

The role combines people leadership, resource management, project governance, and continuous project improvement. You will play a key role in ensuring that the organization has the capabilities, processes, and transparency required to deliver successful development projects today and in the future.

What you will be doing

As Project Execution Team Manager, you will be responsible for driving operational excellence across the our R&D team. In your daily work, you will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 10 skilled engineers across multiple technical disciplines.
  • Plan and allocate resources effectively across the R&D project portfolio, balancing priorities and capacity.
  • Drive operational planning and maintain transparency on project status, risks, priorities, and resource needs.
  • Lead R&D operations meetings and support portfolio planning, prioritization, and decision-making.
  • Partner closely with Product Owners and Business Developers to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Build the competencies and Lead Areas needed to support current and future business needs.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project execution, development processes, and ways of working, fostering collaboration, accountability, and execution excellence.

What will help you succeed

We believe successful leaders combine strong people leadership with operational discipline and a genuine passion for enabling others to perform at their best.

You are likely to bring many of the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, or a related field.
  • Proven leadership experience within a technical or engineering environment.
  • Experience managing complex development projects, programs, or portfolios.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience working in cross-functional product development involving both hardware and software.
  • Experience within AgTech, IoT, electronics, software, or industrial product development.
  • Experience with project governance, development processes, and both agile and traditional project management methodologies.

What makes this role unique

At dol-sensors, you will not just manage resources and processes. You will:

  • Lead a highly skilled multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • Play a central role in shaping and streamline how development projects are executed across the organization.
  • Work closely with Product Owners, Business Developers, and senior leadership.
  • Influence competency development and capability build-up for the future.
  • Help establish stronger governance, planning, and execution practices across R&D.
  • Operate at the intersection of people leadership, technology, and business priorities.
  • Contribute directly to innovative solutions that improve livestock production, animal welfare, and sustainability worldwide.

Your personal profile

  • Create structure without creating bureaucracy.
  • Lead through trust, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Balance strategic thinking with operational execution.
  • Buils strong teams and develops people.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently across all organizational levels.
  • Maintain focus and prioritization in a dynamic environment.
  • Demonstrate strong ownership and a results-oriented mindset.
  • Thrive in an environment where continuous improvement and execution excellence are key success factors.

About dol-sensors

dol-sensors develops intelligent sensing and monitoring solutions for modern livestock production. Through advanced sensor technologies, data insights, and innovative product development, we help customers improve animal welfare, operational efficiency, and sustainability.

As part of SKOV, we combine entrepreneurial agility with the strength of a global organization. Our teams work across hardware, software, electronics, data, and product development disciplines to deliver market-leading solutions to customers around the world.

Interested?

Apply as soon as possible. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing how you can contribute to strengthen project execution and operational excellence at dol-sensors.

title: Købmand
description:
Vi søger lige nu en driftig købmand, som vil stå i spidsen for butikken i Høruphav

Som Købmand i REMA 1000 kommer du med på vinderholdet i et af Danmarks mest succesrige franchisekoncepter med et bagland, der tager sig af alt fra sortiment, markedsføring og administration til daglig bogføring, så du i stedet kan koncentrere dig om at gøre det du er god til – nemlig at drive din butik.

I REMA 1000 kan du forløse dit fulde potentiale. Både som købmand og som leder. Du skal hver dag kunne engagere, motivere og skabe stolthed blandt dine medarbejdere, og du har selv ansvaret for at skabe et stærkt team i butikken. Som købmand skal du gøre en forskel for kunderne og lokalsamfundet – det gøres bl.a. igennem synligheden i butikken og i nærværet over for kunden hver eneste dag.

Jobbet som REMA 1000-købmand er en livsstil, og du har alle muligheder for at få succes og præge din egen indkomst. Vi tror på frihed sat i system – det vil sige, at du har en stor indflydelse på din egen hverdag. I REMA 1000 kan du skabe din egen succes. Vi knokler hårdt, men vi har det sjovt og lønsomt.

Bliv Købmand i REMA 1000
Savner du frihed i dit nuværende job? Er du initiativrig, dynamisk og villig til at yde en stor arbejdsindsats? Har du erfaring fra dagligvarehandelen som købmand, varehuschef, uddeler, butikschef eller lignende? Er du klar til at investere kr. 300.000 og blive selvstændig købmand?

Kan du svare ja til de fleste af spørgsmålene? Så er muligheden for at blive selvstændig Købmand og franchisetager i REMA 1000 kommet et skridt nærmere.

Tiltrædelse samt evt. oplæring vil være efter aftale.

Hvem er du?
Vores kultur er baseret på værdier. Derfor forventer vi, at alle ledere og købmænd efterlever vores værdier og går foran som det gode eksempel overfor medarbejderne og omverdenen. Du er som person arbejdsom, offensiv i din tankegang, har et positivt menneskesyn og ikke mindst en høj forretningsmoral. Når du bliver Købmand i REMA 1000 er det ikke ’bare et job’ og ikke kun dig som Købmand, der bliver involveret - men oftest også familien derhjemme. Derfor er det vigtigt at have den rette støtte og opbakning fra hjemmefronten, inden du takker ja til ’REMA 1000 livsstilen’. For at kunne begå dig som Købmand i REMA 1000 er det vigtigt, at du har et godt kendskab til og store erfaringer med dagligvarebranchen.

REMA 1000 fællesskabet
Hos REMA 1000 er vi en stor familie og du får hurtigt en følelse af, at alle kender alle til trods for, at vi er over 440 butikker i Danmark. Vi har et helt unikt REMA univers der gør, at vi sammen bliver bedre og kan dele vores viden med hinanden. I REMA 1000 er der højt til loftet og plads til forskellighed – det er en af vores største styrker. Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen i et fællesskab af frihed, passion og sammenhold.

Vi klæder dig godt på. Selvom du er Købmand i REMA 1000, har du ikke nået toppen. Vi udfordrer dig hele tiden, både menneskeligt og fagligt, så du også kan udfordre dig selv, din butik og dine medarbejdere. Vi tilbyder en række interne kurser, som klæder dig godt på til at bygge store mennesker i din butik.

Vi vurderer ansøgningerne løbende, og jobannoncen kan derfor blive fjernet inden ansøgningsfristen, hvis vi vurderer, at vi har tilstrækkeligt med ansøgere til stillingen. Kontakt gerne Svend Halse Petersen ved generelle spørgsmål om REMA 1000 på tlf. 40357670 eller regionschef Pernille Krøyer ved specifikke spørgsmål om butikken på tlf. 60390878.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os en ansøgning ved at klikke på "Søg stillingen". Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: EMEA Transformation Project Manager
description:
Be yourself at Protolabs
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply! You can help make our company even better. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself. We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams.

Why Protolabs?
We are the leaders in digital manufacturing. We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home.

Join our team as the EMEA Transformation Project Manager!

We are accepting applications from candidates based in the Netherlands, and this is a hybrid role requiring weekly onsite presence.
The EMEA Transformation Project Manager provides professional project management and execution support across the EMEA transformation portfolio, spanning operational and commercial improvement initiatives. The role provides project management methodology, structure and constructively challenges the team to deliver measurable results. Working alongside sponsors and transformation leadership, the project manager helps translate business problems into well-scoped projects, maintains consistent governance and execution cadence and make progress, risks, dependencies and decisions visible across programs in alignment with Protolabs project delivery framework.
Transformation initiatives often change how people work, who owns decisions, and how functions interact; this role therefore pairs delivery discipline with strong business acumen, structured problem solving, and change management fluency. The role requires close coordination across sales, marketing, customer service, engineering, pricing, supply chain, partner operations, and internal factory operations teams to deliver measurable business outcomes on an ambitious timeline. As the transformation program scales, this position will help shape the project management framework that additional PMs will follow.

What You Will Do:

Project Planning & Execution

  • Define project scope, goals, success metrics, deliverables, and project boundaries aligned to business objectives.
  • Develop and manage project plans, timelines, budgets, resource requirements, milestones, dependencies, and monthly commitments.
  • Drive accountability for deliverables, monitor financial performance against forecasts, and maintain effective portfolio planning and reporting practices.

Problem Definition & Business Case Support

  • Apply structured problem-solving to identify root causes, validate improvement opportunities, and prioritize initiatives based on measurable business impact.
  • Ensure teams clearly define problems and desired outcomes before moving to solution design.
  • Support business case execution by tracking benefits realization and connecting project outcomes to operational and financial performance.

Process Improvement & Business Acumen

  • Partner with process owners to analyze current and future-state workflows, identify inefficiencies, and uncover improvement opportunities across functions.
  • Challenge assumptions, drive data-based decision making, and establish meaningful process performance metrics.
  • Translate process insights into actionable implementation plans with defined owners, milestones, and measurable business benefits.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Organizational Change

  • Lead and align cross-functional teams across commercial, operational, and technical functions to achieve project objectives.
  • Coordinate stakeholder engagement and support organizational change efforts impacting processes, roles, and operating models.
  • Facilitate communication, decision-making, and alignment while managing competing priorities and dependencies across workstreams.

Governance, Reporting & Risk Management

  • Establish project governance structures and ensure adherence to enterprise project management standards, tools, and methodologies.
  • Monitor and communicate project status, milestones, financials, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance to leadership.
  • Proactively manage risks, resolve barriers, escalate critical issues, and drive accountability for commitments and decision-making.

Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate project outcomes and identify opportunities to improve business processes, operational performance, and delivery methodologies.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of ePMO practices, templates, governance frameworks, and project management capabilities.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience considered.10+ years of project management experience leading cross-functional transformation, process improvement, or operational initiatives.
  • Proven success delivering complex projects on time, within budget, and to quality expectations in matrixed organizations.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, including initiatives involving third-party vendors, contract manufacturers, or outsourced providers.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive organizational change, partnering with process owners and change management practitioners.
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to understand and influence cross-functional operations across commercial, technical, and manufacturing teams.
  • Experience with process mapping, analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies, including Lean, Six Sigma, BPMN, value stream mapping, or equivalent.
  • Skilled in structured problem solving, root-cause analysis, and translating findings into actionable business improvements.
  • Ability to develop, evaluate, and track business cases, benefits realization, and measurable operational and financial outcomes.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, including performance metrics, budget management, and cost tracking.
  • Knowledge of organizational change management principles and stakeholder engagement best practices.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills across all organizational levels.
  • Strong influence, critical thinking, and decision-making abilities, with a track record of driving accountability through collaboration and coaching.
  • Ability to navigate organizational complexity and build alignment across global, cross-functional teams.
  • Formal project management training and experience working within Agile, hybrid, waterfall, or similar delivery frameworks.

What Sets You Apart:

  • PMP or PgMP certification (PMI)
  • Formal change management training or certification (e.g., Prosci, ACMP)
  • Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or higher), or A3 problem-solving training
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, supply chain processes, and vendor/partner management principles
  • Experience in digital manufacturing, CNC machining, injection molding, 3D printing, or related manufacturing processes
  • Understanding of pricing models, quoting systems, or commercial operations (e.g., RFQ-to-order) in a manufacturing context
  • Experience with sales organization design, customer segmentation, or go-to-market transformation
  • Experience with ERP, CRM, or related commercial systems.

What's In It For You:

  • Part of our incredible journey is clearly down to our amazing team, and we strongly believe in giving people a space to truly, authentically be themselves. We also believe that treating our employees well and sprinkling a great place to work with some nice perks can make work a little sweeter.
  • Annual company bonus. We celebrate success together! Employees are not only rewarded for their achievements but also for contributing to the overall success of the business.
  • Wellness and well-being with access to OpenUp psychologists, practice mindfulness with Headspace and tons more.
  • Doggo-friendly office. We are big pet lovers and fully encourage hanging out with your (and your colleagues’) furry friends in the office
  • Daily Lunch and snacks are provided in the office; it's a moment for our teams to connect and recharge. Shared meals strengthen our bonds and fuel collaboration.
  • We offer learning and development days to be used for training or on volunteering, money to spend on learning courses, events, trainings, Access to our in-house LEARN platform with diverse courses, training, and workshops, In-house 3D Printing and much more!
  • Follow us on Instagram to see what Life at Protolabs is all about!

I. Job Summary

Oversees the transportation department of one or more locations within assigned geography; providing leader-ship within the location(s) as assigned. Acts as the liaison between customer, operations, CSRs, and the support team.

II. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain and manage inventory supplies to ensure that adequate inventories are always maintained
  • Manage route scheduling to ensure all scheduled customers will be serviced by end of day. Redirect manpower and resources as required, in order to service customers on routes that may have operational difficulties (i.e., vehicle breakdown, vehicle accident, or completely full truck)
  • Manage driver debrief process for every route. Ensure there is documentation (manifest, PDT receipt, etc) for every customer transaction. Update route comments as required
  • Maintain a high standard of customer service as measured by key metrics (on-time, no missed stops, loyalty, etc)
  • Manage open order report to resolve service issues
  • Manage the SAP cancellation process for customers cancelling contracts before the stated CSA end date
  • Develop relationships with customers and establish contacts that are comfortable providing accurate service feedback
  • Conduct customer visits to review service
  • Manage customer interaction records to resolve service issues
  • Company Growth:
  • Monitor operations and staff and recommends, when necessary, changes in methods, procedures, structure, and additions or changes in personnel to secure optimum utilization of resources
  • Monitor department work productivity, reports on trends, and recommends and implements changes to continually improve work productivity.
  • Review payroll hours to ensure overtime hours are necessary and all employees are working efficiently
  • Manage route vehicles, containers, load bars and straps, hand-trucks, PDT’s and printers, and all other company equipment and assets.
  • Monitor routes to improve route efficiency
  • Team Member Development:
  • Select, train, and develop an effective and efficient staff: Make every reasonable effort to select, train, and develop a qualified, diverse workforce
  • Establish and communicate performance standards and objectives; conduct performance appraisals
  • Recommend salary adjustments, promotions, transfers and dismissals
  • Coach employees on educational and job opportunities, to enhance career development and keep them informed of current problems, changes, and new developments in the department and the company by conducting team meetings
  • Perform “ride a-longs”, ensuring Route Drivers operate and work safely, efficiently, productively, and deliver a high level of customer service
  • Conduct “spot checks” to re-enforce proper Route Driver behavior as well as communicate the value we bring to the customer
  • Perform pre-employment screening activities, new Route Driver orientation, reviews of CSRs and monthly safety meetings
  • Complete daily yard walk
  • Compliance:
  • Track and input DOT hours/JJ Keller.
  • Administer Company policies and procedures, communicate to staff, interpret, as necessary, and ensure compliance and safety.
  • Monitor and ensure that employees are performing their functions safely and productively. Make recommendations for changes or improvement, when necessary, in order to prevent accident or injuries.
  • Conduct regularly scheduled safety meetings (i.e. monthly Safety, Committee, tailgate meetings).
  • Oversee and participate in the maintenance of Driver Qualification Files, DOT Log Files and Vehicle Condition Reports for all Route Drivers and equipment. Ensure DQF, DOT Logs and VCR are accurate and complete; must maintain DOT files.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities, as assigned.


III. Qualifications

A. Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 5 years of previous supervisory experience in a structured environment
  • 3 years of Transportation/Logistic experience required, demonstrating the ability to plan and supervise the work of others
  • Driver's License


B. Preferred Qualifications


IV. Physical Requirements

Listed below are key points regarding physical demands, physical and occupational risks, and the work environment of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

☒ Office: This job primarily operates in a professional office environment and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, copy machines, etc.

This role is designated as safety sensitive and will require the successful candidate to strictly comply with all safety rules and protocols. As part of the ongoing employment requirements, the successful candidate may be subject to drug and alcohol testing—including pre‑employment screening, post‑incident evaluations, reasonable suspicion checks, and random testing—in accordance with government regulations and company policies.

Pay: The expected base pay range for this on-site position is $70.000,00- $80.000,00. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific salary offered to a successful candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including the candidate’s relevant experience, education, training, certifications, qualifications, and work location

V. Benefits
At WM, each eligible employee receives a competitive total compensation package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Short-Term Disability. As well as a Stock Purchase Plan, Company match on RRSP, and more! Our employees also receive Paid Vacation, Holidays, and Personal Days. Please note that benefits may vary by site.

title: Senior Electrical Harness Engineer
description:
As a Senior Electrical Low Voltage Design Engineer at Zoox, you will own the design and integration of wire harnesses that connect the controllers, sensors, and subsystems of our autonomous vehicles. Working within the Electrical Systems Team, you will take harnesses from concept through prototype builds and production launch, defining routing and 3D packaging, releasing 2D manufacturing drawings, and working directly with suppliers and the assembly plant. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who owns outcomes, works independently with suppliers, troubleshoots on the shop floor and inside prototype vehicles, and drives continuous improvement in how our harness team works.

In this role, you will:

  • Own assigned harness families end to end, from concept through drawing release, prototype builds, and production launch.

  • Define and own harness routing and 3D packaging in CATIA V5/V6, optimizing for mass, cost, packaging space, serviceability, and assembly.

  • Create and release 2D harness manufacturing drawings and wire lists in Capital Harness (Siemens); read and understand electrical schematics and provide feedback to the electrical architecture team.

  • Select clips, connectors, terminals, seals, and wire; size circuits for power consumption, voltage drop, and fuse protection; define electrical interfaces and endpoints with connected devices.

  • Resolve technical issues including EMI, thermal protection, chafe/abrasion, mechanical strain, and environmental sealing; define protection, retention, and clipping strategies.

  • Lead packaging and design reviews, develop and execute Design Verification, DFM, and contribute to DFMEA.

  • Work directly and independently with harness suppliers from prototype development through design reviews, production readiness, and change implementation.

  • Support early prototype and pilot builds at the assembly plant, troubleshooting build and vehicle issues and driving manufacturing integration fixes.

  • Collaborate with electrical architecture, mechanical/packaging, manufacturing, and quality teams to align harness design with vehicle requirements.

  • Develop and improve engineering processes for device transmittals, schematics, and 3D harness routing, along with design guidelines, best practices, and component libraries.

Qualifications

  • Masters’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Electromechanical Engineering,

  • 8+ years of wire harness / EDS design experience, preferably in the automotive industry (aerospace, heavy truck, or similar also considered), with a demonstrable work history

  • Proficiency in 3D CAD for harness routing and packaging, preferably CATIA V5 or V6 (3DEXPERIENCE)

  • Experience with 2D harness design software, preferably Siemens Capital Harness

  • Ability to translate electrical schematics into 2D manufacturing drawings and 3D harness routing, including connector and terminal selection, wire sizing, power consumption, and electrical interfaces

  • Experience with selection and validation of the harness components (clips, wires, terminals, seal, etc.)

  • Working knowledge of automotive EE communication (CAN, LIN) and low-voltage power distribution architectures

  • Hands-on experience supporting vehicle development and industrialization, from prototype through production launch

  • Experience working directly with harness suppliers on design reviews and production readiness

title: HCV Assistant Director
location: Housing Authority of Kansas City, MO
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for directing the day-to-day activities of the HCV Program relative to customer service and rental integrity and housing quality standards. Must have knowledge and experience of multiple HCV programs (i.e. VASH, TBV, Mainstream, PBV, PBVR, NED, FUP).


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The duties listed below illustrate of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements regarding duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment in association with this position. Undertakes and performs the following and all other work-related duties as assigned.


  1. Assists in the supervision all personnel assigned to the HCV office, delegates assignments, and conducts the daily affairs of the office in a businesslike manner to ensure that the department maintains HCVP subsidy allotments filled with eligible participants.
  2. Provides day to day direction to and supervision of staff who perform reexaminations and other routine functions of the department.
  3. Provides ongoing assistance to support a positive and productive working environment. Plans, prioritizes, schedules, and assigns work.
  4. Ensures compliance with HUD guidelines and regulations, the Authority’s Administrative Plan, federal, state, and local regulations, laws, ordinances, and Authority policies as required and to achieve the highest possible rating under HUD’s Section 8 Management Assessment Program (SEMAP) or other HUD evaluation systems.
  5. Ensures assigned staff are properly trained to complete their duties initially and ongoing. Develops and implements training program.
  6. Assists staff in the interpretation of federal regulations and the Administrative Plan in daily operation. Writes and reviews processes and procedures to ensure program compliance with statutory deadlines.
  7. Delegates tasks as appropriate.
  8. Develops reports to monitor completion of tasks to ensure acceptable performance relative to SEMAP. Performs quality control reviews on tenant files as required.
  9. Monitors processing of services and documents. Performs regular audits for quality assurance purposes to determine accuracy and timeliness of services and payments.
  10. Timely submission of records to PIC, troubleshoot and correct errors; complete and submit other reports as required by HUD.
  11. Conducts performance appraisals.
  12. Monitors program turnover to ensure maximum voucher utilization.
  13. Prepares and recommends program policy changes and updates.
  14. Maintains and updates list of standard operating procedures.
  15. Meets regularly with Team Leaders to ensure efficient and timely completion of tasks.
  16. Conducts training, meetings and/or sits on committees which impact HCV policies, procedures, and regulations. Conducts regular staff meetings to keep employees informed of relevant information and to discuss current issues.
  17. Reviews quality control reports and implements necessary corrective action.
  18. Resolves complaints and disputes.
  19. Serves as the lead person on all PIC and software related issues and resolutions.
  20. Prepares required reports in an accurate and timely manner and in accordance with Authority standards.
  21. Attends professional meetings, seminars, and conferences to keep abreast of new trends, activities, and concepts in the HCVP. Supports, assists, and works with other Agencies and affiliated organizations in joint efforts, which are mutually beneficial.



SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Receives instructions from the Director of HCVP. Courses of action, deadlines, and priorities are established by procedure, the supervisor, or the employee, depending on the assignment. Meetings are held on a regular and frequent basis to discuss current issues, deadlines, and/or operational issues. Routine duties are initiated by the employee without supervisory direction. Instructions to the employee may be general or specific in nature. Problems or situations not covered by instructions are referred to the supervisor for resolution. The employee's finished work is reviewed closely for compliance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulations.


Under normal conditions, the employee makes general assignments to HCVP staff specifying priorities, deadlines, and objectives. The employee frequently makes specific assignments to department staff. Assignments to staff will include what is to be done, deadlines, quality, quantity, and priority.


Behavioral Competencies

This position requires the incumbent to exhibit the following behavioral skills:


Job Knowledge: Exhibits requisite knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the position effectively. Demonstrates knowledge of policies, procedures, goals, objectives, operational entities, requirements, and activities as they apply to the assigned organizational entity of the Authority. Uses appropriate judgment & decision making in accordance with level of responsibility.


Commitment: Sets high standards of performance; pursues aggressive goals and works hard/smart to achieve them; strives for results and success; conveys a sense of urgency and brings issues to closure; persists despite obstacles and opposition.


Customer Service: Meets/exceeds the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers; identifies, understands, monitors, and measures the needs of both internal and external customers; talks and acts with customers in mind. Recognizes work colleagues as customers.


Effective Communication: Ensures important information is passed to those who need to know; conveys necessary information clearly and effectively orally or in writing. Demonstrates attention to, and conveys understanding of, the comments and questions of others; listens effectively.


Initiative: Proactively seeks solutions to resolve unexpected challenges. Actively assists others without formal/informal direction. Possesses the capacity to learn and actively seeks developmental feedback. Applies feedback for continued growth by mastering concepts needed to perform work.


Responsiveness and Accountability: Demonstrates a high level of conscientiousness, holds oneself personally responsible for one's own work, does fair share of work.


Teamwork: Balances team and individual responsibilities; exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; gives and welcomes feedback; contributes to building a positive team spirit; puts success of team above own interests; supports everyone's efforts to succeed.


Leadership: Provides direction by clearly and effectively setting course of action for department and subordinates; manages performance by providing regular feedback and reinforcement to subordinates.


Job Competencies

  1. Thorough knowledge of the principles, techniques and practices of subsidized housing management including organization, management, maintenance, and operation of subsidized units and Housing Choice Voucher Program; federal, state, and local housing regulations and operating requirements; and the ability to apply that knowledge to perform the essential functions of the position.
  2. Thorough knowledge of Housing Choice Voucher eligibility and rent calculation requirements, as required by HUD and Housing Quality Standard (HQS) Inspection Program.
  3. Thorough knowledge of the principles, techniques, and practices of budget development and administration; financial planning, budget planning and analysis; and the ability to apply that knowledge to perform the essential functions of the position.
  4. Requires strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills; the ability to effectively communicate and interact with individuals of varying social, cultural, economic, professional, and educational backgrounds including the ability to effectively deal with individuals who may be angry, argumentative, or disagreeable; the ability to act with tact, good judgment, and discretion; and to maintain the confidentiality of matters as appropriate.
  5. Thorough knowledge of the modern principles, practices, and techniques of personnel management, training, and performance evaluation.
  6. Good knowledge of procurement regulations.
  7. Thorough knowledge of the modern principles, practices, and techniques of budgeting and accounting.
  8. Skill in addressing the public and other bodies and presenting information in a clear, organized, and convincing manner.
  9. Ability to accurately and completely document in writing appropriate events and activities.
  10. Ability to plan, direct, and supervise the work of others, to delegate responsibility and authority, and to hold subordinates accountable for tasks assigned.
  11. Ability to read and comprehend relatively complex material.
  12. Ability to identify operational problems and develop effective solutions.
  13. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with subordinates, co-workers, and persons outside the Authority.
  14. Ability to prepare clear and concise narrative and statistical reports and deal effectively with situations requiring tact and diplomacy, yet firmness.
  15. Knowledge of MS. Office Suite.
  16. Knowledge and experience working with HUD Secured Systems and PHA related software programs
  17. Knowledge of working with the VMS system and the ability to interpret program trends
  18. Ability to work in a fast-paced office environment while multitasking.
  19. Demonstrate the ability to work effectively with a diverse economic population.
  20. Must be able to perform mathematical calculations.
  21. Demonstrate good time management skills and ability to prioritize tasks as needed.
  22. Ability to be detail oriented, organized, and have good public communication skills.
  23. Must maintain punctuality and attendance as scheduled.

title: Direct Support Professional Front End (Night)-Entry Level

title: Konsulent til forskningsopfølgning
description:
Vil du være med til at styrke opfølgningen på den forskning, Kræftens Bekæmpelse støtter, og omsætte rapport- og bevillingsdata til anvendelig viden?

Vi søger en ny kollega til forskningsopfølgning, der kan kombinere forskningsforståelse med stærke kompetencer inden for data, analyse og systemer. Du bliver en del af enheden Bevilling og Opfølgning og kommer til at arbejde med både den løbende kvalitetssikring af forskningsfaglige afrapporteringer og udviklingen af vores datagrundlag, metoder og løsninger. Vi samarbejder desuden med kolleger i andre afdelinger om at levere data til organisationen.

Dine opgaver og ansvarsområder

  • Bearbejde og omsætte data til strategisk læring og beslutningsunderstøttelse
  • Vedligeholde og udvikle brugen af vores kvalitative og kvantitative data
  • Bidrage til udvikling og forbedring af de systemer og arbejdsgange, der understøtter ansøgning, bevilling og afrapportering
  • Indgå i et netværkssamarbejde på tværs af organisationen om at levere data om den forskning, som Kræftens Bekæmpelse støtter
  • Kommunikere med bevillingsmodtagere på både dansk og engelsk
  • Varetage den løbende gennemgang og kvalitetssikring af faglige afrapporteringer fra bevillingsmodtagere
  • Bidrage til teamets øvrige opgaver, herunder administrative og praktiske opgaver, når der er behov for det

Din faglige profil

Du har en relevant akademisk uddannelse og minimum tre års erfaring med for eksempel forskning, analyse, evaluering, databehandling, forskningsadministration eller fondsarbejde.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du

  • Har forståelse for forskning og forskningsprocesser
  • Kan kvalitetssikre og analysere både kvalitative og kvantitative data
  • Arbejder struktureret med større datamængder og har blik for datakvalitet
  • Har god systemforståelse og interesse for de bagvedliggende mekanismer samt gerne erfaring med lettere kodning
  • Kan formidle komplekst materiale og omsætte data så de skaber værdi

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med Power BI, bevillings- eller afrapporteringssystemer, impact assessment, evaluering eller udvikling af metoder og indikatorer.

Som person er du

  • Nysgerrig, initiativrig og udviklingsorienteret og har lyst til at forbedre eksisterende arbejdsgange og se nye muligheder
  • Analytisk og struktureret og kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til konkrete løsninger
  • Arbejdsom og vedholdende - du arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver til dørs
  • En imødekommende holdspiller, der bidrager til et godt kollegialt fællesskab med plads til forskellige fagligheder og perspektiver

Vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af et lille, velfungerende tværfagligt team bestående af seks engagerede administrative og akademiske medarbejdere, herunder en anden forskningsopfølgningskonsulent, hvor vi alle samarbejder om bevillingsprocesser og forskningsopfølgning. Vi har en uformel omgangstone og lægger vægt på faglig sparring, socialt samvær og på at hjælpe hinanden på tværs af opgaver og fagligheder. Området har gennem de seneste år været i udvikling, og stillingen giver gode muligheder for at bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling og for at være med til at sikre, at viden fra de støttede forskningsprojekter bliver samlet, kvalitetssikret og anvendt. Enheden Bevilling og Opfølgning hører under afdelingen Økonomi, IT og Dataanvendelse.

Vi har en god kantineordning og andre medarbejdertilbud, såsom kaffe- og frugtordning samt idræts- og kunstforening. Arbejdstiden er naturligvis 100% røgfri.

Den gennemsnitlige ugentlige arbejdstid er 32-37 timer inkl. frokost, og du vil få din daglige gang på vores hovedkontor på Østerbro i København med mulighed for fleksibel arbejdstid. Du får løn og pension efter overenskomst mellem Kræftens Bekæmpelse og den relevante faglige organisation.

Mere information

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Bevillingschef Christina Koefoed-Hansen på e-mail ckh@cancer.dk eller på telefon 35 25 72 59.

Ansøgning og ansøgningsfrist

Ansøgningsfristen er onsdag d. 25. november 2026, men vi læser løbende ansøgninger. Vi forventer at holde den første samtalerunde mandag og tirsdag i uge 49 og den anden samtalerunde mandag i uge 50.

Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. februar 2027 eller hurtigst muligt.

Vi modtager kun ansøgninger via vores elektroniske rekrutteringssystem på .

title: Grad Hourly OBGYN - BIRCWH
description: Position Summary The Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at the University of Illinois Chicago is seeking a Graduate Hourly employee to support clinical research activities within the Department of OBGYN. title: Service Project Manager - Commercial Interiors
description:
Skyline is Building Better Together
Come join us at Skyline Construction, a leader in commercial interior construction founded in 1996. Today, Skyline operates multiple offices located throughout California, Washington, and Illinois. Skyline is 100% employee-owned, and has been recognized as one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces for the past 5 years. We believe that we are “building better together.”
What’s in it for you?
Skyline Construction is seeking a hands-on Project Manager to lead smaller commercial tenant improvement and service projects. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys fast-moving work, direct client interaction, and managing multiple projects at different stages.
Projects may include single-office buildouts, office refreshes, painting and flooring replacements, conference room modifications, minor demolition and reconfiguration, door and hardware changes, millwork installations, and small mechanical, electrical, plumbing, or technology upgrades.
The Service Project Manager will be responsible for each project from the initial client request through estimating, proposal, construction, and closeout. Success in this role requires strong organization, responsiveness, construction knowledge, and the ability to provide practical solutions with limited oversight.
Our teams use a variety of tools, such as ProCore, Bluebeam, and Microsoft platforms to keep them on the cutting edge of construction management. Additionally, as a Project Manager, you will interact with professionals from all levels of the industry and, most importantly, clients.

As a Project Manager, you will serve in the following areas:

• Respond promptly to client requests and evaluate project scope, schedule, budget, and site conditions.
• Conduct site walks and help clients define the work required to meet their needs.
• Develop conceptual budgets, detailed estimates, and clear written proposals.
• Solicit and evaluate subcontractor and vendor pricing.
• Identify scope gaps, constructability concerns, long-lead items, and potential project risks.
• Coordinate permitting requirements when applicable.
• Develop project schedules and communicate key dates to clients, subcontractors, and internal teams.
• Manage multiple small projects simultaneously, from preconstruction through closeout.
• Procure subcontractors, materials, and equipment required to complete the work.
• Coordinate work in occupied buildings while minimizing disruption to tenants and building operations.
• Partner with field supervision and trade partners to maintain safety, quality, schedule, and site cleanliness.
• Manage project costs, commitments, change orders, invoicing, and financial forecasting.
• Maintain accurate project documentation, including contracts, RFIs, submittals, meeting notes, and closeout records.
• Communicate regularly with clients, property managers, design teams, building engineers, and subcontractors.

title: Project Consultant - Pharma Manufacturing
description:
Would you like to work on pharmaceutical manufacturing projects and help bring structure and momentum to complex programmes?

Join our Pharma & Life Science team in the US

NIRAS is a foundation- and employee-owned engineering consultancy founded in Denmark in 1956. Around 3,000 colleagues work from more than 60 offices on some 9,000 projects, under one purpose: engineering solutions for a shared future. Our values are simple: we listen, we learn, we deliver.

NIRAS Inc. is NIRAS' North American business, based in Cary, North Carolina. We are a team of about 20 consultants supporting global pharma, biotech and food & beverage manufacturers across capital programmes, PMO, CQV and FDA remediation. Our consultants currently work with clients across North Carolina, Indiana, New Jersey and Pennsylvania. With more than USD 370bn of new US pharma investment announced, we plan to roughly double in size by 2030, so the people who join now will help shape the business.

Your role

Our client, a global pharmaceutical manufacturer, is integrating and expanding a large sterile fill-finish site in Bloomington, IN. The site is running a major capital and integration program alongside remediation of FDA inspection findings, and needs people who can bring structure, follow-up and momentum.

As a NIRAS Project Consultant you join our on-site team and work inside the client's project organization: supporting project managers on new vial and fill lines, and driving the governance that gets open deviations, CAPAs and audit actions closed on time. Early-career candidates will learn fast alongside senior NIRAS program leaders; experienced candidates can take ownership of a workstream from day one.

What you will do

Support project managers on capital projects and line expansions: schedules, action logs, risk registers, meeting cadence and status reporting

  • Drive follow-up on open deviations, CAPAs and FDA commitments with the site's business owners and SMEs, and keep priorities and due dates visible
  • Build and maintain trackers, dashboards and management reports that turn scattered data into clear decisions
  • Prepare and facilitate project and governance meetings; capture decisions and ensure actions are followed through
  • Coordinate across engineering, quality, validation, manufacturing and vendors
  • Use AI tools and simple automation to speed up tracking, data analysis, meeting minutes and reporting
  • Spot gaps and improvement opportunities on site and raise them with the NIRAS team

What you bring

Must have

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in engineering, life sciences or a related field
  • 1–8 years of experience in pharma, biotech, medical devices or another regulated manufacturing environment (internships and co-ops count)
  • A structured approach and the ability to keep track of multiple activities and follow them through
  • Good working knowledge of Excel and MS Project, Smartsheet or similar tools
  • Practical, everyday use of AI tools (e.g. Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or Claude) to analyze data, draft reports and speed up follow-up, and the judgment to check AI output in a GMP environment
  • Clear written and spoken English and the confidence to follow up with senior stakeholders
  • Authorized to work in the US and able to work on site in Bloomington

Nice to have

  • Experience with GMP, deviations and CAPA, or FDA inspection follow-up
  • Knowledge of aseptic / sterile fill-finish operations
  • Experience with capital projects, CQV or technology transfer
  • Power BI or other data and reporting tools

What we offer

  • A small, flat US team where your voice counts, backed by the engineering depth of 3,000 NIRAS colleagues worldwide
  • Leadership roles on client sites from day one, and a clear path toward Senior Consultant and Regional Account Manager (on-site client lead) roles
  • Exposure to some of the largest pharma manufacturing investments in the US
  • Coaching from senior program leaders with decades of GMP, capital project and FDA experience
  • Competitive salary and benefits package

How to apply

If the role sounds interesting to you, we would be happy to hear from you. Please apply directly through this page. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Location: Bloomington, IN (on site, typically 4–5 days a week)

Start date: November 2026.

Mitä tulet tekemään?

  • Suunnittelet ja toteutat asiakkaiden digitaalisia palveluita full-stack-kehittäjänä osana ketterää tiimiä.
  • Otat kokemuksesi mukaan vastuuta kokonaisuudesta: tekniset valinnat, laatu ja toimitus.
  • Työskentelet suoraan asiakkaan kanssa, selvität todelliset tarpeet ja ehdotat parempaa ratkaisua, jos speksi ei vie tavoitteeseen.
  • Olet mukana erilaisten digipalveluiden modernisoinnissa ja jatkokehityksessä: kirkastat tiimin kanssa tarpeet, rakennat uusia toiminnallisuuksia ja viet palvelua eteenpäin vaiheittain.
  • Kehität esimerkiksi asiakasportaaleja ja itsepalvelukanavia, joissa tieto, dokumentaatio ja asiointi tuodaan yhteen selkeäksi kokonaisuudeksi.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Yli 5 vuoden kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä sekä vahvaa osaamista Java- tai TypeScript/React-pohjaisesta kehityksestä
  • Kokemusta pilvipalveluista
  • Kokemusta REST API -rajapintojen toteuttamisesta ja turvallisesta hyödyntämisestä
  • Kokemusta AI-työkalujen hyödyntämisestä osana ohjelmistokehitystä sekä kykyä arvioida niiden tuottamien ratkaisujen laatua ja soveltuvuutta
  • Kykyä tehdä teknisiä ratkaisuja itsenäisesti ja kantaa vastuuta niiden laadusta
  • Kykyä keskustella asiakkaan kanssa tarpeista ja ratkaisuista ymmärrettävästi

title: Gel Coater L3W
description:

MUST HAVE DEMONSTRABLE EXPERIENCE AS A GEL COATER OR SIMILAR ROLE IN A BOAT MANUFACTURING ENVIRONMENT

Company Description

Everglades Boats is an industry leader in premium offshore fishing boats. Founded in 1997, Everglades provides the ultimate choice for discerning boat owners and knowledgeable big-water anglers. Everglades is a high-end, refined brand that makes a personal statement about the status and savvy of its owner by applying best-in-class fishing amenities, premium-grade materials, and a highly-refined fit and finish.

Widely recognized and respected in the industry for its hull performance and ride, Everglades patented RAMPCAP hulls are found throughout its model lineup. Receiving numerous industry awards and an unparalleled reputation for superior performance, Everglades recruits and retains the best talent in the industry.

Position Summary

Everglades Boats is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Gel Coater with proven marine manufacturing experience to join our overnight production team. This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for a craftsman who understands the importance of cosmetic excellence, material precision, and consistency in producing high-gloss, premium marine finishes.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical knowledge of gel coat application, environmental control awareness, and a commitment to delivering flawless results that meet the standards of a high-end offshore brand.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare molds to premium cosmetic standards, including inspection, cleaning, waxing, masking, and staging.

  • Mix gel coat materials, pigments, and catalysts accurately in accordance with manufacturer specifications and internal quality requirements.

  • Apply gel coat using professional spray equipment to meet established thickness, coverage, and finish standards.

  • Monitor environmental conditions to ensure proper curing and surface integrity.

  • Verify coating thickness and consistency using appropriate measuring tools.

  • Identify, troubleshoot, and correct surface defects such as fisheyes, sags, pinholes, air entrapment, dry spray, and color variation.

  • Perform detailed touch-ups and cosmetic corrections to meet Everglades’ premium finish expectations.

  • Maintain and troubleshoot spray equipment to ensure optimal performance and minimal downtime.

  • Coordinate closely with laminators, mold prep technicians, and quality control to maintain production flow and cosmetic integrity.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional workspace aligned with 5S and safety standards.

  • Adhere strictly to all PPE, safety protocols, and hazardous material handling procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of two (2)+ years of gel coat application experience in a marine manufacturing or premium composite environment.

  • Demonstrated experience producing high-quality cosmetic finishes in boat building or similar industries (marine preferred).

  • Strong working knowledge of gel coat chemistry, catalyst ratios, cure times, and environmental impacts on finish quality.

  • Experience operating and maintaining professional gel coat spray systems.

  • Ability to read and follow detailed build specifications and production instructions.

  • Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining quality and pace.

  • Strong attention to detail and pride in workmanship.

  • Ability to wear a respirator and required PPE for extended periods in a non-climate-controlled environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in premium offshore or performance boat manufacturing.

  • Experience with color matching and custom pigmentation.

  • Familiarity with composite quality standards and cosmetic inspection processes.

  • Track record of low rework rates and high first-pass quality.

Work Environment

  • Non-climate-controlled composite manufacturing environment.

  • Frequent exposure to fumes, fiberglass dust, and airborne particles.

  • Loud production environment requiring hearing protection.

  • Overnight schedule with weekend and overtime requirements based on production needs.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand for extended shifts (10+ hours).

  • Frequent bending, kneeling, crouching, climbing, and working in and around molds.

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.

  • Ability to work safely and efficiently in potentially hazardous conditions while wearing required PPE.
