title: Dean of the College of Education and Human Development
description:
The University of Maine, the state’s flagship and land-grant university, invites applications and nominations for Dean of the College of Education and Human Development (COEHD). The next Dean will lead the College’s programmatic expansion and deepen its statewide impact while implementing a streamlined administrative structure approved by COEHD faculty in 2025. The Dean will join a close-knit community in a region of notable natural beauty and exceptional quality of life.

The University seeks a transformative leader committed to its “learner-centered R1” vision. Building on the University-wide Strategic Reenvisioning process, the Dean will develop and implement a holistic organizational strategy that brings together the College’s historic strengths in educator preparation and its emerging strengths in human development and allied health. Working collaboratively within COEHD, across the University, and with external partners, the Dean will help guide interdisciplinary academic programs, research, and outreach with the goal of improving the lives of individuals, families, schools, and communities across Maine and beyond.

Reporting to the Executive Vice President for Academic Affairs and Provost, the Dean serves as the College’s chief executive officer, with responsibility for academic, fiscal, strategic planning, and personnel matters. The Dean guides and assists in securing state, federal, and private grants; participates actively in University fundraising initiatives; and serves as the College’s primary spokesperson to constituencies within and beyond the University of Maine. The salary range for this position is anticipated to be $215,000 to $225,000. The final compensation package will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, and leadership accomplishments.

The dean will:

  • Oversee the college’s administrative and physical portfolio, fostering excellence in teaching, research, and service
  • Manage the college’s financial and human resources to optimize alignment with UMaine’s strategic initiatives and to strengthen the college's financial sustainability
  • Foster a supportive culture for faculty, staff, and students
  • Ensure sustainable, relevant, and impactful academic programs for undergraduate and graduate students
  • Ensure sustainable, relevant, and impactful research programs that include undergraduate and graduate students
  • Partner with other UMaine units to increase programmatic impact, particularly in state priority areas
  • Represent the college within UMaine and beyond, leveraging fundraising and engagement opportunities to strengthen our value to and catalyze partnerships with our stakeholders.

About the University of Maine

Founded in 1865, the University of Maine is the state’s land, sea, and space grant institution. The University of Maine, which is part of the seven-member University of Maine System created in 1968, proudly holds the distinction of serving as the flagship institution within the system, responsible for providing high-quality undergraduate and graduate education, basic and applied research, and outreach services to extend the University of Maine’s expertise and resources statewide and beyond.

About the College

COEHD prepares professionals who advance learning, leadership, health, and quality of life across the lifespan. Its faculty conducts research that informs policy and practice for educators working from birth through adult learning, health professionals, child and family specialists, and educational leaders. College priorities include growing undergraduate and graduate programs in educator preparation, allied health, and human development; fostering a first-class undergraduate experience; strengthening research and graduate education; and reinforcing relationships with schools, healthcare systems, community organizations, industry, and other stakeholders. The Dean will also play a pivotal role in implementing the recommendations of a newly launched task force on allied health and clinical education programs.

COEHD offers four-year undergraduate programs in kinesiology and physical education, human development sciences, and elementary and secondary education. Its certificate, master’s, specialist, and doctoral programs account for roughly 25% of the University’s total graduate enrollment. These include northern New England’s only master’s program in athletic training located at an R1 university, an executive doctoral program in educational leadership, and a traditional PhD in education. COEHD operates programs that meet or exceed national quality benchmarks: its athletic training program is accredited by CAATE, and its educator preparation programs are accredited by CAEP. The College also collaborates closely with education programs at the University’s regional campus, the University of Maine at Machias, and with other universities in the UMaine system.

Other Information:

To be considered for this position you will need to “Apply” and upload the documentation listed below:

  1. a letter of interest
  2. a current curriculum vitae
  3. contact information for five professional references (named referees will not be contacted without the candidate’s prior consent)

Incomplete application materials cannot be considered. Materials received after the initial review date will be reviewed at the discretion of the University.

For full consideration, materials must be submitted by 4:30 p.m. EST on January 11, 2027.

Nominations and inquiries should be addressed to Mr. Chuck O’Boyle of C. V. O’Boyle, Jr., LLC at chuck@cvoboyle.com.

title: Fagchef til Sikring & Strøm
description:
Er du erfaren indenfor sikring- eller strøm, og er klar til næste skridt i karrieren? Vil du være med til at sætte retningen for fremtidens bæredygtige jernbane og hæve det faglige niveau i branchen? Så kom og vær med!

I Sikring og Strøm arbejder vi med nogle af landets mest komplekse og samfundskritiske infrastrukturprojekter. Lige nu søger vi en erfaren og udviklingsorienteret specialist med solid faglig baggrund inden for sikring eller strøm, som har lyst til at stå i spidsen for vores faglige udvikling og være med til at forme fremtidens opgaveportefølje – med et særligt fokus på de voksende muligheder inden for strømområdet.

Bliv faglig nøgleperson og vær med til at sætte retningen

Du bliver du en nøglespiller i at sikre kvalitet og retning i vores projekter. Du får ansvar for at omsætte store budgetter til teknisk bygbare løsninger i tæt samarbejde med nogle af branchens dygtigste specialister. Det er komplekst, men det er også det, der gør det spændende.

Som fagchef får du en central rolle i at udvikle og løfte fagligheden på tværs af afdelingen. Du bliver en vigtig drivkraft i arbejdet med at udvikle vores metoder, processer og tekniske løsninger, og du får samtidig mulighed for at sætte dit præg på, hvordan vi fremover arbejder med projektering og gennemførelse af vores projekter.

Et fagområde i udvikling

Sikring & Strøm står over for en spændende udvikling i de kommende år. I takt med udrulningen af nye signalsystemer forventes opgaverne inden for de traditionelle sikringsanlæg gradvist at ændre karakter og på længere sigt få et mindre omfang. Samtidig ser vi et betydeligt udviklingspotentiale inden for strømområdet, hvor elektrificering, modernisering og nye tekniske løsninger forventes at få en stadig større betydning.

Som fagchef får du derfor en vigtig rolle i at understøtte denne udvikling, hvor vi både skal sikre og videreudvikle vores eksisterende faglige kompetencer og samtidig styrke vores kapacitet og faglighed inden for strømområdet.

Du vil være med til at sætte retningen for, hvordan vi tilpasser vores kompetencer, metoder og organisering til fremtidens opgaver, med et særligt fokus på de muligheder og behov, der opstår inden for strømområdet.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med afdelingslederen, sektionschefen og teamlederne om at fastholde et højt fagligt niveau, understøtte medarbejdernes udvikling og fremme den teknologiske udvikling. Rollen kombinerer solid teknisk faglighed med faglig ledelse, strategisk udvikling og et tæt samarbejde med projekterne.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • sætte retning for fagligheden og være med til at sikre høj kvalitet og ensartethed i løsningerne.
  • udvikle fagmiljøet gennem sparring og tæt tværfagligt samarbejde
  • omsætte erfaring til forbedringer ved at indsamle læring fra projekterne og bruge den til at udvikle vores standarder, metoder og arbejdsprocesser
  • udfordre og understøtte egenprojektering- og projekteringslederteams, så vi hele tiden bliver bedre til at planlægge og gennemføre projekterne
  • bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling af Banedanmarks model for egenprojektering.

Du får dermed en rolle med både faglig tyngde og strategisk perspektiv. Du skal kunne bevæge dig mellem de konkrete tekniske problemstillinger i projekterne og det mere langsigtede arbejde med at udvikle fagområdet, organisationen og vores måde at arbejde på.

Det er en stilling for dig, der motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem andre, sætte en faglig retning og omsætte erfaring og ny viden til bedre løsninger. Din indsats vil bidrage til et bedre metodegrundlag, mere robuste projekter, højere kvalitet og en mere effektiv løsning af Banedanmarks opgaver.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har +8års erfaring som projekterende ingeniør. Du kan også have en anden teknisk baggrund, hvorfra du har oparbejdet solid specialistviden indenfor sikring- eller strøm.

Du har erfaring med både projektering, planlægning og gennemførelse af sikring eller strøm projekter og har desuden et godt kendskab til branchens teknologier, trends og udvikling. Du formår at analysere komplekse problemstillinger igennem en struktureret og løsningsorienteret tilgang. Derudover har du forståelse for risici og forudsætninger på tværs af projekter og formår at omsætte teknisk indsigt til konkrete handlinger.

Dine nye arbejdsplads – et stærkt fællesskab

Du bliver en del af Afdelingen Sikring & Strøm, hvor vi værdsætter samarbejde, faglighed og gensidig sparring. Du får dygtige og engagerede kolleger og du træder ind i et fagligt velfunderet og positivt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi tror på, at gode resultater skabes bedst, når vi trives og arbejder sammen om gode løsninger.

Dit kommende arbejdssted afhænger af din bopæl. Vi har både kontorer i København, Fredericia, så vi er fleksible i forhold til, hvor du foretrækker at arbejde. Da afdelingen er spredt på lokationer, må der forventes lidt rejseaktivitet på tværs af landet. Begge lokationer har let adgang til parkering af bil og cykel og ligger i kort gå-afstand fra togstation.

Banedanmark er desuden en moderne arbejdsplads med gode rammer for et arbejdsliv i balance. Der er mulighed for fleksible arbejdstider og mulighed for hjemmearbejde, når opgaverne tillader det.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Hvis du er akademiker, ansættes du efter den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten.

Du indplaceres på baggrund af akademisk anciennitet og erfaring som specialkonsulent eller chefkonsulent jf. gældende overenskomst, som du finder her og Medarbejder- og Kompetencestyrelsens lønoversigt, som du finder her.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der vil være tilknyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning på 18,07 %.

Ellers ansættes du efter den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt indplaceret i løngruppe 4 jf. gældende overenskomst, som du finder her og Medarbejder- og Kompetencestyrelsens lønoversigt, som du finder her.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der vil til den samlede løn være tilknyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning på 16 %.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Har du spørgsmål eller vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Ledende sektionschef for Sikring og Strøm, Osama Hussein, på tlf. 2518 3291.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår kan du kontakte vores HR-konsulenter på mail banedanmarkpersonale@bane.dk

Ellers er du velkommen til at sende os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt, da vi vurderer ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende. Går du videre fra de indledende samtaler, kan der blive indhentet referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgiver. Du vil blive informeret inden, at der bliver indhentet en reference.

For at søge stillingen skal du klikke på linket ‘Søg stilling’ og følge instrukserne.

title: French Voyageur Summer Camp Junior Counselor

title: Patient Registrar
description:
About the Role:

The Patient Registrar plays a critical role in the healthcare system by serving as the first point of contact for patients entering a medical facility. This position is responsible for accurately collecting and verifying patient information, ensuring that all data is complete and compliant with healthcare regulations. The Patient Registrar facilitates smooth patient flow by coordinating appointments, managing patient records, and communicating effectively with both patients and healthcare providers. By maintaining meticulous records and handling sensitive information with confidentiality, the Patient Registrar supports the overall efficiency and quality of patient care. Ultimately, this role contributes to a positive patient experience and the operational success of the healthcare facility.

We’re thrilled to share that Albany Gastroenterology Consultants in Albany, NY is currently seeking a Full-time Patient Registrar to join our team!

Responsibilities:

  • Greet patients and visitors promptly and courteously upon arrival at the healthcare facility.
  • Collect, verify, and enter patient demographic and insurance information accurately into electronic health record (EHR) systems.
  • Schedule and confirm patient appointments, coordinating with clinical staff to optimize patient flow.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy laws and healthcare regulations when handling patient information.
  • Assist patients with completing necessary forms and provide clear instructions regarding facility policies and procedures.
  • Communicate effectively with healthcare providers, insurance companies, and patients to resolve registration issues.
  • Maintain organized and up-to-date patient records, including updating information as needed.
  • Handle billing and insurance verification processes to facilitate timely reimbursement.
  • Respond to patient inquiries and provide support to enhance the overall patient experience.

Skills:

The Patient Registrar utilizes strong communication skills daily to interact effectively with patients, healthcare providers, and insurance representatives, ensuring clear and accurate information exchange. Attention to detail is essential when entering patient data into electronic health record systems to maintain accuracy and compliance with healthcare regulations. Organizational skills are applied to manage appointment scheduling and patient flow efficiently, minimizing wait times and enhancing patient satisfaction. Problem-solving abilities help resolve discrepancies in patient information or insurance coverage promptly. Additionally, proficiency with healthcare software and technology supports seamless data management and contributes to the overall operational success of the healthcare facility.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in a healthcare or customer service environment preferred.
  • Basic computer skills, including familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification as a Patient Access Representative or Medical Registrar.
  • Experience with specific EHR software such as Epic, Cerner, or Meditech.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare insurance processes.
  • Bilingual abilities to assist a diverse patient population.
  • Training in HIPAA compliance and healthcare privacy regulations.

We offer competitive base salary, generous benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Voluntary, Time-Off Benefits, EAP, 401K and Commuter Benefits.

title: Barselsvikariatet som Beskæftigelsesrådgiver til unge mellem 18-25 søges til Ungerådgivningen i Odder Kommune
description:
Vi søger en beskæftigelsesrådgiver som drømmer om at med unge mennesker mellem 15-25 år efter Lov om en aktiv beskæftigelsesindsats - en myndighedsrådgiver der har energi og gåpåmod, når det gælder om at finde de rette løsninger for de unge. Vi er nemlig ambitiøse når det gælder gode og varige løsninger for vores unge i Odder kommune.


Hvis jeg får stillingen hos jer, hvad skal jeg så lave?
Du skal gerne finde følgende arbejdspunkter genkendelige og interessante, hvis du ønsker at søge stillingen

  • At arbejde motiverende og målrettet med en bred gruppe af unge. Målgruppen er fra de åbenlys uddannelses parate til de aktivitetsparate, samt selvforsørgende og unge fra 15 år og op til 25 år.
  • Via IPS-metoden sikre at sårbare unge får den håndholdte hjælp på vejen til job eller uddannelse, hvor der særligt at fokus på det virksomhedsrettet arbejde og samarbejde med psykiatrien.
  • At tage ansvar for det gode samarbejde med unge mennesker, netværk, familie, civilsamfund og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere.
  • I samarbejde med øvrige kollegaer i teamet, varetage visitationen i samarbejde med vores Uddannelsesvejleder.
  • At iværksætte og følge op på indsatser efter kap. 11-14 i beskæftigelsesindsatsloven.
  • At arbejde virksomhedsrettet med tydeligt fokus på kompetencer der kan bruges på arbejdsmarkedet.
  • At afdække om den unge er i målgruppe til anden forsørgelse end kontanthjælp.

Lige meget hvad, får du nogle gode kolleger, der nok skal sætte dig grundigt ind i dine nye opgaver.

Faglige krav og kompetencer

Vi har brug for kollegaer der både fagligt og personligt kan sige ”ja” til enten alle eller største delen af følgende punkter:

  • Du skal have en relevant uddannelse som socialrådgiver/socialformidler.
  • Du må have erfaring med at navigere i LAB-loven.
  • Du skal, lige som os, synes, at det er spændende at finde løsninger på de udfordringer, de unge er i, og du begejstres ved, at når en fra afdelingen, teamet eller dig selv har gjort en forskel.
  • Du må gerne have relevant arbejdserfaring med beskæftigelsesindsatsloven og du mestrer og finder det interessant at sidde for bordenden og samarbejde tværfagligt.
  • Du synes, det er sjovt og spændende at samarbejde med unge mennesker, interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere, netværk og frivillige foreninger – for vi har nemlig fokus på at vores unge får varige relationer
  • Du har blik for dine kollegaer – for vi vægter både højt fagligt niveau men også at vi trives når vi går på arbejde


Samtidig skal du kunne formidle viden, så de unge, du er rådgiver for, forstår dig. Formidlingen er både mundtlig og skriftlig, så det er også vigtigt, at du kan lide at sidde med den administrative kerneopgave.

Vi tror på, at du er den slags rådgiver, den unge altid har lyst til at vende tilbage til: Både fordi du udviser respekt for den unge, fordi du er knalddygtig fagligt, og ikke mindst fordi du er nem og god at arbejde sammen med.

Endelig må du gerne have blik for, hvordan vi hele tiden kan blive bedre og skarpere i vores løsninger. Du skal synes, at det er sjovt at tænke udvikling og have blik for, hvordan vi fortsat kan levere de rigtige løsninger til vores unge – og hjælper dem med at skabe retning i livet.

Hvem er vi – Ungerådgivningen i Odder Kommune:
Vi er 15 medarbejdere og en Teamleder. Vi samarbejder med unge i alderen 15 – 25 år.

Du får kolleger, der også arbejder med de unge: Uddannelsesvejledere, erhvervsplaymaker og rådgivere der arbejder med Barnets Lov. Du kommer derfor i kontakt med rigtig mange forskellige fagområder og kolleger, som kan være med til at berige arbejdet omkring de unge – kollegaer der alle finder det meningsgivende at understøtte de unge i deres vej til uddannelse og beskæftigelse.

Ud over dit monofaglige team, bliver du også en del af en tværfaglig afdeling, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen omkring vores unge. Vi har mange spændende opgaver, og vi gør alt, hvad vi kan for, at det er både sjovt og spændende at gå på arbejde.

Praktiske detaljer – løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Der er tale om et barselsvikariat på 37 timer/uge. Stillingen er til besættelse den 1. februar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til aftalen mellem KL og den relevante faglige organisation. Lønnen forhandles mellem den forhandlingsberettigede organisation og Odder Kommune med afsæt i et lønniveau på ca. 404.000 kr. årligt ekskl. pension som forhandlingsgrundlag.


Har du specifikke spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte

Teamleder Louise Koldsø, tlf.nr.: 2459 2516.

Ungerådgiver Amalie Ostenfeld, tlf.nr: 5138 6166

Ungerådgiver Kristina Gissel, tlf.nr: 5138 6183

Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning.

Den skal sammen med dit CV være hos os senest d. 27. november 2026 kl. 23:59.
Vi forventer at afholde samtaler torsdag d. 10. december 2026.

Odder Kommunes

Odder Kommunes organisation er kendetegnet ved korte beslutningsveje med få ledelseslag mellem direktørerne og de decentrale institutioner.

Den flade struktur og de korte beslutningsveje gør organisationen smidig og sikrer, at der ikke er langt fra tanke til handling.

title: Director, Clinic Operations, Pediatric Specialties, Inova Schar Cancer Institute
description:
This role will support the Oncology, Blood Disorders, Gastroenterology & Outpatient Infusion clinics.

The Director, Clinic Operations, Pediatric Specialties provides strategic and operational leadership for a portfolio of pediatric specialty practices, ensuring an exceptional experience for children, families, physicians, and team members. This leader is accountable for the overall performance of assigned practices, including access, patient experience, clinical operations, workforce, financial performance, and practice growth.

Working closely with pediatric physicians, advanced practice providers, nursing leaders, clinical teams, and system partners, the Director translates organizational strategy into efficient, innovative, and family-centered ambulatory care delivery. The role serves as a key operational partner to physician leadership and is responsible for creating an environment where high-quality pediatric specialty care can thrive.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative and forward-thinking healthcare leader who understands the unique needs of pediatric patients and families and can successfully balance operational excellence with compassionate, family-centered care.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for assigned pediatric specialty practices, ensuring strong performance across patient access, experience, workforce, quality, productivity, and financial outcomes.
  • Partner closely with pediatric physicians, advanced practice providers, nursing leaders, and interdisciplinary teams to establish shared priorities and advance practice and organizational goals.
  • Develop and implement innovative operational strategies that improve access to specialty care, patient flow, care coordination, provider capacity, and the overall experience for children and families.
  • Own the day-to-day operational performance of assigned practices, including scheduling, registration, referrals and authorizations, patient communications, medical records, facilities, staffing, and other essential practice functions.
  • Establish and monitor standards for patient access, including appointment availability, telephone responsiveness, scheduling efficiency, and wait times, identifying opportunities to improve the patient and family journey.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, reduce barriers to care, and support timely access to pediatric specialty services.
  • Monitor financial and operational performance, including budgets, productivity, staffing, non-salary expenses, revenue cycle performance, and capital needs, and develop action plans to address opportunities and challenges.
  • Use operational and financial data to identify trends, inform decision-making, and develop strategies that improve practice performance and long-term sustainability.
  • Serve as a trusted operational advisor to physician leadership and collaborate on initiatives related to practice growth, provider capacity, access, workflow optimization, and care delivery.
  • Promote a culture of family-centered care that recognizes the unique needs of pediatric patients and their caregivers throughout the care journey.
  • Ensure appropriate policies, procedures, and operational controls are in place to support patient safety, regulatory compliance, financial stewardship, and effective practice operations.
  • Ensure assigned practices operate in alignment with Inova's mission, vision, values, strategic priorities, and applicable regulatory and professional standards.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 3 years healthcare management experience
  • 5 years of experience in healthcare operations in an ambulatory or hospital setting
  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (or 4 years of experience in lieu of degree)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting pediatric clinics or service lines
  • Demonstrated success leading multi-site clinic operations

title: Logistics Analyst
description:
Are you passionate about delivering internet streaming for our customers?

Are you excited about logistics operations in high-tech environment?

Join our Logistics team

We are seeking a detail-oriented Logistics & Order undefined professional to join our Global Logistics Team. The role oversees end-to-end order management and leads shipping issue resolution. It supports Akamai's global platform by coordinating with 3PL, manufacturers, vendors, carriers, and customs. Key priorities include ensuring timely delivery, maintaining system accuracy, and enhancing stakeholder satisfaction across international operations.

Partner with the best

Akamai Cloud Platform team takes ownership for planning, building, maintaining and operating our global platform. Responsibilities include designing, developing, and deploying essential technologies. This encompasses hardware, software, and network infrastructure supporting all Akamai products. The team ensures consistent availability and performance for our customers.

As a Logistics Analyst, you will be responsible for:

  • Managing the complete order lifecycle, ensuring accurate fulfilment, timely execution, cost efficiency, and proper documentation.
  • Addressing shipping disruptions such as delays, lost shipments, customs holds and compliance issues effectively.
  • Collaborating with manufacturing and repair vendors to monitor order status and returns.
  • Partnering with internal teams to communicate timelines, resolve and flag inventory discrepancies, and improve undefined speed.
  • Monitoring and reporting on performance metrics for order accuracy, on-time delivery, and vendor reliability.
  • Building ad hoc reports to manage orders in queue as they hit set milestones.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have 2 years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field or its equivalent
  • Have experience in logistics, supply chain, or international shipping.
  • Be experienced in fulfilment/order management and end-to-end logistics process.
  • Be familiar with customs documentation, Incoterms, and global freight processes.
  • Have advanced Excel and analytical skills.
  • Be familiar with working across systems (ERP, WMS, tracking tools).
  • Demonstrate exceptional abilities in problem-solving, organization, and effective communication.

title: Contract
description:

We are looking for an HR professional for the position of Executive with 2–5 years of experience in employee engagement, HR programs, employee experience, or HR operations.
The role involves coordinating employee engagement initiatives, organization-wide surveys, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) programs, and internal communications across global teams.

title: Piccolo/Piccoline – deltid
description:
Som piccolo/piccoline bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen på projektkontoret. Du er med til at sikre, at kontoret fungerer, at medarbejdere og gæster føler sig velkomne, og at de praktiske opgaver bliver løst effektivt og professionelt. Stillingen er på ca. 15 timer om ugen fordelt på 2-3 hverdage.

En varieret hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver
Du får en bred rolle med mange forskellige opgaver og kontaktflader. Nogle dage handler om at holde styr på kontorets daglige drift, mens andre byder på koordinering af møder og arrangementer.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Sørge for, at kontoret fremstår pænt, ryddeligt og præsentabelt
  • Bestille forplejning, kontorartikler og øvrige forbrugsvarer samt sikre, at lageret er fyldt op
  • Fejlmelde IT-udstyr og koordinere med IT-support ved tekniske problemer
  • Bestille og koordinere serviceydelser som VVS, elektriker, vintertjeneste og vinduespudsning efter behov
  • Bestille adgangskort og koordinere adgang for entreprenører og samarbejdspartnere
  • Opdatere mødebookingark, ferielister og årshjul
  • Hjælpe med gæstebesøg, møder, fejringer og arrangementer, herunder bestilling af forplejning, blomster og pynt

Du får tingene til at fungere
Vi søger en kollega, der motiveres af at skabe gode rammer på kontoret og trives i en koordinerende funktion. Du er imødekommende, hjælpsom og tager naturligt ansvar for de opgaver, der opstår i løbet af dagen.

Du kan fx være studerende, holde sabbatår eller bare være på udkig efter et godt deltidsjob. Din baggrund er mindre vigtig. Det vigtigste er, at du får tingene til at spille i en travl hverdag.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• Trives med praktiske og varierende opgaver og løser opgaverne effektivt
• Er mødestabil, serviceminded og kan lide at give andre en god oplevelse
• Har god erfaring med almindelige IT-værktøjer, herunder Outlook og Excel
• Bidrager positivt til samarbejdet og det gode arbejdsmiljø på projektkontoret

Dygtige kolleger er klar til at byde dig velkommen
Du bliver ansat i Projekt- & Ledelsessupport og refererer til sektionslederen, mens din daglige arbejdsplads er projektkontoret for Svanemøllens Skybrudstunnel i Nordhavn, hvor du bliver en del af hverdagen i projektgruppen.

Du kan læse mere om vores medarbejdergoder her

Sådan bliver du vores kollega
Er du klar til nye muligheder, ser vi frem til at høre fra dig senest den 22. november 2026. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt for dig at søge, så du skal ikke skrive en traditionel ansøgning. Send i stedet dit CV, hvor du kort sætter ord på din motivation for at søge stillingen. Du kan finde inspiration til at skrive et motiveret CV her

Processen består af 1. samtalerunde og vi afholder 1. samtaler i uge 49.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Tanja Bergmann på tanb@hofor.dk.

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen”.

title: Lead Hospital Services Technician
description:
Lead Hospital Services Technician

$21.75/hr, Good Benefits & Day Shift

I. Job Summary

Under management's direction, The Hospital Services Lead travels between customer healthcare facilities providing on-site proactive collection and exchange waste containers for various Stericycle programs. This includes, but not limited to: Sharps Management Service, Pharmaceutical Waste, Controlled Substances, and Document Management. This service is provided at regularly scheduled intervals for assigned facilities. Fills in for other Team Members who are on vacation, sick, leave, etc. Assists Supervisor, as needed, covers schedules and locations, which may vary based on coverage required. The Lead is in charge for a shift, providing guidance, training and coaching to other Technicians. Is primary Hospital Services worker contact for the customer.

II. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Travels between customer healthcare facilities to proactively monitor, collect, and exchange waste containers for various WMHS programs and services, including but not limited to: Sharps Management Service, Pharmaceutical Waste, Controlled Substance and Document Shredding. Installs product, resurvey accounts and assists Supervisor in asset/inventory management.
  • In absence of Service Supervisor, is the lead in charge of Hospital Services Technicians. Trains, coaches and provides guidance to them.
  • Acts as primary on-site contact for the customer. Interacts professionally with onsite customer staff to ensure service expectations are met or exceeded. May travel to customers in assigned area to proactively resolve customer service questions and issues.
  • Interacts professionally with onsite customer staff to ensure service expectations are met or exceeded. May travel to customers in assigned area to proactively resolve customer service questions and issues.

  • 2 years industry related experience in a customer service capacity preferred, or the equivalent in related work experience, demonstrating strong communication skills or preferred education requirement

B. Preferred Qualifications

As part of the ongoing employment requirements, the successful candidate may be subject to drug and alcohol testing—including pre‑employment screening, post‑incident evaluations, reasonable suspicion checks, and random testing—in accordance with government regulations and company policies.

title: Tax Analyst 1 - Property
description:
The tax analyst-property performs tax and accounting reporting, analysis and compliance activities supporting the property tax and sales and use tax functions of Berkshire Hathaway Energy, MidAmerican Energy Company, BHE Renewables LLC, BHE U.S. Transmission LLC, Berkshire HomeServices of America and other companies as assigned. The position develops knowledge of applicable tax requirements, company operations, accounting processes and tax systems while completing assigned responsibilities with guidance and review.

Prepare property tax renditions, reports, schedules and payment documentation using established procedures and source data. Assist with budgets, forecasts, cash flow estimates and accounting activities related to property tax, sales and use tax and excise tax. Develop proficiency in tax systems, accounting systems and departmental procedures.

Assist in reviewing property tax assessments and identifying items requiring further evaluation. Prepare or assist with monthly property tax provisions and supporting reconciliations. Monthly analyze, reconcile and adjust use tax accounts. Support Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) regulatory reporting and rate-case filings related to non-income taxes.

Complete assigned tax filings, reports, payments and responses to notices and information requests within established deadlines. Assist company personnel with routine sales and use tax questions by gathering relevant facts, applying established guidance and escalating matters requiring additional technical analysis. Research and document routine and moderately complex tax issues with guidance. Prepare supporting schedules, correspondence and memoranda documenting the applicable facts and conclusions. Maintain sales and use tax reference and training materials used by company personnel.

Assist with sales and use tax and property tax audits, property tax payments, special projects and analyses. Assist with reviewing transactions and purchase agreements for potential sales and use tax implications. Perform additional responsibilities as requested or assigned.

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.

Coursework or experience in accounting, taxation, finance or data analysis is preferred for Tax Analyst 1 - Property 1 position.

Two or more years of related professional experience, including at least one year of tax, accounting, finance or closely related analytical experience for the Tax Analyst 2 - Property.

Working knowledge of accounting principles and demonstrated ability to analyze financial and operational information. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including the ability to organize and analyze data in Microsoft Excel.

Effective written and oral communication skills. Ability to research issues, document work, follow established procedures and communicate questions or concerns promptly. Ability to prioritize and complete multiple assignments within established deadlines.

Ability to interact effectively with personnel inside and outside the department and to adapt to changing priorities, systems and business requirements.

title: Pensions Committee Independent Person
location: Lambeth Civic Centre, 6 Brixton Hill, London,SW2 1EG, United Kingdom
description:
Pensions Committee Independent Person

3 Years Fixed Term Contract

Part–time -3.5hr per week -15days per year.

About Us:

Located in the heart of South London, Lambeth Borough is a vibrant community of over 317,600 residents. Stretching from the dynamic neighbourhood of Streatham in the South to the iconic landmarks of Waterloo in the North, we are proud to be the 9th largest borough in London. Our diversity is our strength, with more than 130 languages spoken, making Lambeth the home of the Windrush generation, London's largest LGBTQ+ community, and a thriving Portuguese-speaking community.

It is an exciting time to join Lambeth Council, we have bold ambitions for the future of Lambeth’s communities and residents through ourLambeth 2030 Plan ‘Our Future, Our Lambeth.

With exceptional schools, lush green spaces including Brockwell Park, cultural gems like the Black Cultural Archives, and world-renowned institutions such as St Thomas's Hospital, Lambeth offers an enriching and dynamic environment.

Please have a look at our dedicated One Lambeth Values and Behaviours page.

About the Team:

The London Borough of Lambeth is the Administering Authority for the Lambeth Pension Fund, which is part of the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS).

Following recent reforms to the LGPS and the introduction of Regulation 53A, the Fund is required to appoint a named Independent Person. This is a non-voting position that will provide independent strategic advice, support and constructive challenge to the Pension Fund Committee, the Senior Officer and the asset pool. The role is intended to strengthen the Fund's governance arrangements through supporting the Senior Officer and Chair of the Pensions committee by providing independent scrutiny of advice and recommendations received by the fund, ensuring alignment with statutory guidance.

The postholder will also support the development and review of key Fund strategies, policies and governance documents.

About the Role:

Comparable to the role of a Non-Executive Director or Professional Trustee, the position will be expected to cover a wide range of duties. These include but are not limited to:

• To support and contribute to the development of all strategies for which the Pensions Committee is responsible

• To scrutinise any advice given to the Committee, whether from the pool or any other organisation or individual

• To help monitor and assess performance against targets set in LGPS strategies, including administrative performance and the London CIV’s implementation of the investment strategy, and help monitor whether the collective pool oversight process is meeting the requirements of the administering authority

• To support consideration of the Committee’s governance arrangements, including any action plans arising from Independent Governance Reviews

• Uphold independence and avoid conflicts, providing assurance to scheme

members and employers through high standards of conduct.

• To contribute in any other way appropriate to the authority’s LGPS functions

The role will also encompass oversight of the administering authority's position as both shareholder and client of its asset pooling company, London CIV, supporting the monitoring of the asset pool’s implementation of the Fund’s investment strategy.

The successful candidate will bring significant pensions experience and expertise together with a understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing the LGPS. Applicants should either:

• Hold a relevant qualification from the Pensions Management Institute (PMI)

• be a member of, and accredited by, the Association of Professional Pension Trustees (APPT)

• or be able to demonstrate extensive knowledge and experience within the LGPS environment.

title: Leiðari til Frítiðarskipanir í Tórshavn
description:
Almannaverkið leitar eftir einum eldhugaðum og virkisfúsum leiðara, ið skal standa á odda fyri Frítíðarskipanini á Frúutrø og Frítiðarskipanini á Tinghúsvegi. Hesar eru til børn og ung við serligum tørvi.

Um Frítíðarskipanina á Frúutrøð og á Tinghúsvegi

Frítíðarskipanin hevur heimild í grein 40 í Løgtingslóg um almannatrygd og tænastur. Endamálið við skipanini er at tryggja børnunum og teimum ungu ein virknan og innihaldsríkan gerandisdag soleiðis, at tey varðveita og menna sínar persónligu og sosialu førleikar, har tann einstaki er í miðdeplinum.

Frítíðarskipanin er ætlað børnum og ungum í aldrinum 9-18 ár. Endamálið er at geva børnunum og teimum ungu eina mennandi námsfrøðiliga skipan eftir skúlatíð. Dentur verður lagdur á at menna sálarligu, fatanarligu, málsligu og sosialu førleikar teirra, soleiðis at tey betur verða før fyri at virka í felagsskapi og gerast so sjálvstøðug, sum til ber.

Um starvið
Talan er um eitt starv fulla tíð at seta 01.01.2027. Nýggi leiðarin vísir til eindarleiðaran og verður partur av einum leiðslutoymi við seks leiðarum.

Arbeiðsuppgávur og ábyrgd

Høvuðsuppgávan er at leiða starvsfólkini og dagliga arbeiðið á stovninum. Leiðarin hevur ábyrgd av at økið verður rikið skynsamt fakliga, fíggjarliga og starvsfólkaliga.

Uppgávan er at leiða Frítíðarskipanirnar ið eru opnar fyri børnum dagliga eftir skúlatíð 12 til kl. 17. Í ferium er vanliga longri opið.
Nýggi leiðarin hevur góðar møguleikar at seta sín dám á virksemið. Leiðarin skal saman við eindarleiðaranum og leiðslutoyminum ganga á odda og við fakligum innliti skapa karmarnar fyri einum góðum læringarumhvørvi.

Arbeitt verður við støði í KRAP, sum er ein sosialnámsfrøðilig tilgongd, har vit tilvitað arbeiða viðurkennandi út frá sterku síðunum hjá borgarunum.

Somuleiðis skal leiðarin duga at leiða og menna soleiðis at starvsfólk trívast og kenna seg sum ein part av einum spennandi og mennandi arbeiðsplássi. Eisini skal leiðarin arbeiða fyri at skapa eitt tætt og gott samstarv við avvarðandi.

Førleikar
Námsfrøðilig útbúgving. Tað er ein fyrimunur at hava leiðsluroyndir. Møguleiki er at førleikamenna seg innan leiðslu.

Væntanir
Væntað verður, at tú hevur evni at leiða og hevur góðar eginleikar at samskifta og samstarva. Harumframt, at tú dugir at arbeiða sjálvstøðugt og raðfesta, kanst hugsa framskygt og hevur gott innlit at leiða í gerandisdegnum. Eisini verður væntað, at tú dugir at orða teg í skrift og talu, og at tú hevur kt-førleika á brúkarastøði.

Vit kunnu bjóða
Í góðum arbeiðsumhvørvi fært tú eitt spennandi starvsøki við fjølbroyttum og avbjóðandi uppgávum við møguleika fyri bæði fakligari og persónligari menning. Tú verður partur av einum dugnaligum leiðslutoymi og fert at hava tætt samstarv við eindarleiðaran og leiðslutoymið. Skipað verður fyri góðari innleiðslu.

Barnaváttan

Vísandi til Løgtingslóg um barnaváttanir § 4 stk 3 hevur Almannaverkið skyldu til at útvega barnaváttan, áðrenn setanin verður framd.

Setanar- og lønarviðurskifti
Setanarøkið er Almannaverkið og tænastan er í Veitingar og tænastur, Børn og ung Tann, ið sett/-ur verður, má tola broytingar í starvinum, og at hetta kann verða umskipað til eisini at fevna um aðrar uppgávur.
Starvið er flokkað í lønarflokki 33 í lønartalvuni fyri Tænastumenn landsins, tó uttan at vera tænastumannastarv. Setanartreytir annars eru sum fyri sáttmálasett, sambært sáttmála millum Fíggjarmálaráðið og Føroya Pedagogfelag.
Um viðkomandi, ið sett/-ur verður, frammanundan er tænastumaður innan økið, er møguleiki fyri at halda fram sum tænastumaður.

Umsókn

Tú søkir starvið við at trýsta á tann grøna knøttin "Søk starvið" og við síðan at útfylla umsóknarblaðið og viðhefta viðkomandi fílur.

Freist
Umsóknir skulu vera Almannaverkinum í hendi í seinasta lagi 20.11.2026. kl. 23.00.

Nærri upplýsingar
Nærri upplýsingar um starvið fáast við at venda sær til eindarleiðarin í eindini børn og ung

title: QC Analyst II
description:
The Quality Control Analyst II will be responsible for analytical testing and data verification supporting both late-stage clinical and commercial biosimilar products in cGMP-compliant laboratories and will also be expected to be engaged in continuous improvement initiatives to drive efficiency and effectiveness of Kashiv’s Quality Systems.

A strong background in protein chemistry will be essential to perform and troubleshoot techniques such as HPLC, SDS-PAGE, cell-based bioassays, capillary electrophoresis, SDS-PAGE, ELISA, and standard compendial assays. A demonstrated ability to collaborate across multiple departments to drive timely resolution of projects, laboratory investigations, and process improvements is required.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Analytical testing to support product in-process, release, and stability programs.
  • Strong knowledge of cGMP, Quality Systems, and ICH / regulatory guidance.
  • Conduct, compile, and/or review Out of Specification lab investigations, deviations, and corrective and preventative actions plans.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to advance projects, maintain equipment, and authoring of documents and reports.
  • Train other analysts to perform laboratory procedures and assays. Participate in internal assessments and audits as and when required.
  • Performs other functions as required or assigned
  • Complies with all company policies and standards

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, biochemistry, chemistry, or related field with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a pharmaceutical/biotech QC laboratory.
  • Alternatively, Master’s degree in above areas with 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical/biotech QC laboratory or PhD in above areas with a minimum of 2 years of experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience:

  • Previous experience in a cGMP laboratory.
  • Strong background in protein chemistry and experience troubleshooting analytical results.
  • Demonstrated success at writing, revising, and complying with SOPs, protocols/reports, and QC methods.

Special Skills:

  • Demonstrated success working with techniques such as HPLC, SDS-PAGE, cell-based bioassays, capillary electrophoresis, SDS-PAGE, ELISA, and standard compendial assays.
  • Previous experience supporting regulatory inspections (e.g. PAI).

  • Familiarity with preparing regulatory dossiers and data packages for interactions between Kashiv and regulatory agencies.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:

  • Some time spent in an office doing office work (reading, writing, reviewing, and editing documents).
  • Significant amount of time spent in the laboratory.
  • Must be able to lift at least 25 lbs.

title: Business Planning & Operations Partner - 11955
description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.
Why join Coupa?
  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

title: Materials Senior Project Manager
description:
If you enjoy taking ownership of projects, collaborating with teams, and building strong client relationships, this role offers the opportunity to manage facilities, materials, environmental, or geotechnical engineering projects from start to finish. You’ll help ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within the contracted scope, and within budget while monitoring progress and performance against the project plan.

You’ll play an important role in keeping projects moving forward by identifying operational challenges, troubleshooting issues, recommending or implementing solutions, and helping minimize delays. Responsibilities may also include managing resources, project schedules, budgets and forecasts, and coordinating with external vendors, subcontractors, and contractors.

Throughout the project, you’ll conduct meetings, prepare project status reports, establish priorities, assign tasks, and coordinate project staff to meet project targets and milestones. You may also communicate directly with clients and coordinate the delivery of work products to support client satisfaction.

You’ll work closely with the APR to ensure opportunities for engagement throughout the project, particularly at critical junctures, and will also be involved in invoice approvals, preparing change orders, and collections.

  • Manage all aspects of large-scale, complex projects from planning through completion.
  • Partner with the client or NAM to define project scope, schedule, and budget.
  • Lead interactions with clients and key stakeholders to ensure their goals and priorities are considered throughout project execution.
  • Develop, communicate, and implement project plans that establish a clear path for successful project completion.
  • Lead project safety efforts, including preparation of and compliance with approved safety plans.
  • Identify and resolve operational challenges to minimize delays and keep projects moving forward.
  • Identify, develop, and secure the resources necessary to successfully complete projects.
  • Prepare designs and work specifications; develop schedules, budgets, and forecasts; and select appropriate materials, equipment, project staff, and contractors.
  • Estimate the costs, resources, and time required for project completion.
  • Prepare expenditure forecasts and manage project scope and schedule to support delivery within budget.
  • Monitor project activities, allocate resources, and assign tasks to ensure project targets and milestones are achieved.
  • Collaborate with other departments and offices to secure specialized resources and expertise needed to support project success.
  • Lead project meetings and prepare reports to clearly communicate project status within and beyond the project team.
  • Coach and mentor project staff, providing support and guidance to help resolve project-related challenges.
  • Coordinate with the APR to ensure appropriate oversight is in place and sufficient time is provided for quality reviews.
  • Coordinate with Accounting to support the financial management of business intelligence, invoicing, and collections.
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of project-related risks, including potential project challenges and methods for protecting the Company, and maintain familiarity with applicable Company risk policies.
  • Lead and promote safety efforts across the project team, ensuring adherence to safety rules and guidelines. Create and model a safe work environment, demonstrate appropriate safety practices, and promote pre-task planning for all projects.
  • Promote continuous quality monitoring and improvement throughout projects. Monitor quality standards and practices and engage APRs at the onset of projects to support appropriate quality oversight.
  • Bachelor’s degree in technical discipline practices by the Firm including Engineering, Environmental Science or Geology and a minimum of 10 years’ related experience. Or, in lieu of a degree, a minimum of 14 years’ related experience.
  • A valid driver’s license with acceptable violation history may be required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional Engineer (PE), Professional Geologist (PG) or similar professional registration/certification relevant to the type of services and projects being managed
  • Authorized Project Reviewer status

title: Mech Design Engr II
description:
Mech Design Engineer II Role Summary Honeywell is seeking a motivated Mechanical Design Engineer to join the product development team at the Bangalore Design Center. The ideal candidate will bring experience in electromechanical product design and development, including exposure to New Product Introduction and product lifecycle activities for aerospace and defense applications.

This role is part of Honeywell’s Sensing Solutions business, which develops leading-edge sensors and switches for rugged and harsh environments. The selected candidate will work with a talented team of design engineers to develop advanced sensing technologies for the Aerospace and Defense line of business.

Your role will include overseeing, supervising and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end-to-end processes and projects for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely and accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on tasks to be performed; and mentoring and guiding junior colleagues to Support their skill development, professional growth, and overall success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own mechanical design activities as an individual contributor within a global engineering team.

  • Execute mechanical design and development from concept through product release.

  • Design mechanical packaging solutions for electromechanical products used in aerospace and industrial environments.

  • Generate concepts, conduct design trade-off studies, and perform detailed engineering analysis.

  • Conduct tolerance stack-up analysis and ensure compliance with functional, manufacturing, and quality requirements.

  • Collaborate with simulation, drafting, validation, manufacturing, marketing, supply chain, and other cross-functional teams.

  • Assess product application environments, identify technical risks, and support risk mitigation through simulation, testing, and validation.

  • Perform product and process capability studies, gauge MSA, design reviews, and engineering evaluations.

  • Prepare test plans, technical reports, product validation documentation, and project progress reports.

  • Support Engineering Change Orders and Engineering Change Notices, including drawings, CAD models, and related PDM activities.

  • Create CAD models and drawings for mechanical assemblies, subassemblies, and components.

  • Support prototype assembly, lab work, and product improvement initiatives.

Required Experience and Education

  • B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering;

  • 4–6 years of relevant mechanical design experience.

  • Intermediate proficiency in PTC Creo Parametric or Pro/ENGINEER.

  • Working knowledge of Siemens Teamcenter or similar PDM/PLM systems.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Professional Skills and Knowledge

  • Experience in new product development for electromechanical products.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical packaging design for parts, subassemblies, and finished products.

  • Hands-on experience designing electromechanical products with mechanisms.

  • Ability to translate product requirements into critical-to-quality design characteristics.

  • Knowledge of engineering plastics, metals, plating, and material selection considerations.

  • Familiarity with GD&T, ASME Y14.5, statistical tolerance analysis, design for manufacturability, and design for assembly.

  • Experience identifying, quantifying, and mitigating technical risks through DFMEA, PFMEA, control plans, and process flow charts.

  • Ability to support quality improvement projects using structured engineering methods.

  • Familiarity with Six Sigma tools and methodology.

  • Strong technical research, documentation, communication, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, external customers, and suppliers.

WE VALUE


  • Collaborative team player with a willingness to learn and adapt.

  • Able to work effectively in a global environment across time zones.

  • Open to mentoring, feedback, and continuous development.

  • Strong time management, task prioritization, and accountability for assigned deliverables.

  • Professional, dependable, and able to meet project deadlines.

  • Willing to travel domestically or internationally for business, training, or project needs.

  • Able to support critical project timelines when business needs require additional effort.

Experience: 4–6 years

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering;

title: Person In Charge (PIC) Spokane Valley, WA

title: Family Services Specialist I/II
description:
Title Description- Family Services Specialist I represents the entry level employees working under close supervision while being trained in program areas such as, Adult/Adult Protective Services, Child Protective Services, Foster Care/’Adoption, Child Care, and Employment Services. Employees perform routine- to journey-level casework activities and the casework usually is reviewed by the supervisor prior to implementing a case action. Upon completion of the training program and attainment of necessary approvals, the employee shall be redefined to a full-performance Family Services Specialist II and becomes eligible for a pay increase as defined by the local agency compensation plan. The Family Services Specialist I is distinguished from the Family Services Specialist II by the latter’s functioning more independently as a full performance Family Services Specialist.
Title Description- This is the full performance level in the occupational group for Family Services. Employees are responsible for developing and implementing individualized service plans involving the application of casework methods in Employment Services and Child Care, and basic service level caseloads of Adult/Adult Protective Services, Child Protective Services, Foster Care, Adoptions. Employees may provide services in all program areas or specialize in one or several program areas. Typically employees perform all tasks independently and only seek supervisory advice on unusual situations or when policies and procedures require supervisory review or involvement. The Family Services Specialist II is distinguished from the Family Services Specialist III by the latter's functioning at the advanced level, and becoming more specialized in program areas and assuming more complex duties (such as: interviewing/investigating in cases involving suspected child/adult abuse/neglect, out-of-home placements, guardianships, emergency protective orders, and adoptions).
General Work Tasks (Illustrative Only) –
  • Interprets laws, policies and regulations as applied to specific area of responsibility;
  • Monitors, coordinates and administers specific programs as assigned;
  • Coordinates services within specific area of responsibility;
  • Interviews and assesses customer needs and other relevant factors – such as education/skill levels, abilities, interests, and support systems.
  • Informs clients of related service programs rules/regulations, and right to participate;
  • Presents cases to determine appropriate services and writes/implements service plans;
  • Provides case management services to monitor compliance;
  • Manages program waiting lists;
  • Tracks expenditures, prepares/submits budget estimates and ensures payment for services;
  • Completes necessary federal, state and local planning and reporting requirements;
  • Coordinates with other agencies and participates in multi-disciplinary and interagency teams providing services to customers;
  • Conducts overall monitoring of programs in specific area of responsibility;
  • Serves as resource to clients and the community in area of expertise; and
  • Provides after hours on-call coverage and responds to emergencies in child/adult protective services and/or foster care.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Knowledge- Some knowledge of: social work principles and practices; human behavior and motivational theory; and social, economic, and health problems.

Skills- Skill in operating a motor vehicle and personal computer with associated software.

Abilities- Demonstrated ability to: communicate effectively both orally and in writing; interview, assess needs, counsel and refer clients to other resources as needed; develop and implement service plans in order to insure the delivery of appropriate services to the client; make sound judgments within the framework of existing laws, policies, and regulations; respond to the client's emotions in order to accomplish services objectives; plan and manage own work activities including service delivery preparing reports, and correspondence, record keeping responsibilities and related activities; establish and maintain effective relationships; and stay abreast of current trends and developments in the social work field.

Education and Experience- Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in a Human Services field or minimum of a Bachelor's degree in any field with a minimum of two years of appropriate and related experience in a Human Services area as mandated in Section 22VAC40-670-20 of the Administrative Code of Virginia and implemented by the Virginia Board of Social Services. Possession of a BSW or MSW degree and a Commonwealth of Virginia Social Worker license are desirable.

Minimum Qualifications:
Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in a Human Services field.

title: Team Leader
description:
SUMMARY OF POSITION

Mainstream Living provides services designed to enhance opportunities, create success and fulfill dreams. The Team Leader position is a professional direct staff position which provides oversight to a designated caseload of members residing in a variety of residential settings; and provides direct supervision to Direct Support Professional (DSP) staff and Assistant Team Leaders (ATL). This position is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and service implementation to the members assigned to their caseload. This position is also responsible for the training and ongoing supervision of the personnel providing direct care to the members. This position may also be assigned to provide or arrange specific skills or supports, conduct activities including appointments and community activities and implement management functions, including policies and procedures relating to IAC 78.41(1).


QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Human Services or related field is preferred.

Must have High School Diploma or Equivalency/HiSet/GED. *

Experience: 2 years Human Service Experience or supervisory experience is preferred.*

* Combination of education and experience will be assessed for determination of qualified applicants.

Driving: This position requires possession of valid Driver’s License, legal driving privileges and ability in the State of Iowa and qualification with Mainstream Living’s underwriter as an insurable driver.

Computer: Basic data entry skills required. Familiarity with Word Processing, Google Docs, Microsoft Excel/spreadsheets is strongly preferred.

Post hire: Must demonstrate competencies to complete internal training, including training to pass medication.

General: All employees must work diligently to incorporate the spirit and intent of the Mainstream Living's mission, vision and values. This includes respectful communication to all others at all times. Employees must be able to establish a rapport and develop positive relationships with others while conducting themselves in line with the agency Code of Ethics. Employees must also: demonstrate consistent professional conduct and establish and maintain appropriate boundaries with others; take accountability for own work while demonstrating a willingness to accept responsibility and offer constructive recommendations; demonstrate dependability and flexibility when shift times or duties of the day change; apply common sense to carry out instructions furnished in written or oral form; and ensure that the best interest of the members are a top priority at all times.


The Team Leader position requires good attention to detail and superior organizational skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required, with ability to listen effectively, respond appropriately, and maintain mutual comfort level while relating to diversity. Must have the ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Have the ability to interpret a variety of instructions, furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.


The Team Leader is a leadership position. This individual must be a stable, mature, professional person capable of working in stressful situations. Must possess good judgment in crisis situations and demonstrate the same. The Team Leader must be flexible, and able to collaborate with the team to develop strategies and systems that resolve problems. Must be able to objectively examine situations and determine appropriate courses of action.


The Team Leader must both serve as a role model for members and DSP staff; and act as a role model for the company by maintaining positive and professional relationships with members, guardians, staff, case managers and other stakeholders regarding direct service and specific needs of the member.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

This position is considered an essential health care worker position and in the event of an emergency may be required to work one-on-one with members to ensure their safety.


Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Supervises Assistant Team Leaders (ATL) and Direct Support Professionals (DSP).

  • Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable law.

  • Play an integral role in recruitment, selection, onboarding/transition, and retention of direct reports (ATL and DSP).

  • Support and develop staff to provide optimal services to members, including the monitoring of training to ensure completion and comprehension.

  • Maintain methods for and oversee shift to shift communication. Complete daily review of Communication Book and address challenges and opportunities. Plan and conduct routine staff meetings and 1:1’s.

  • Provide timely and consistent feedback and discipline to staff. Assess risk and impact of performance and/or conduct to facilitate initial inquiry. Consult with supervisor, and Human Resources as appropriate.

  • Ensure required documentation is submitted by DSP on time e.g., incident reports, medical information, expense reimbursement, receipts, etc. Maintain communication with internal stakeholders responsible for review.

  • Develop staff schedule templates that meet both member supervision and budgetary needs, with desirable/hirable shift packages to degree possible.

  • Assist ATL with scheduling requirements; monitor overtime and spot check accurate reporting of staff work times.

  • Participate in on-call rotation. Work direct care shifts when necessary.


Member Related Duties:

  • Ensure that Mainstream Living policies and procedures and regulatory standards and guidelines are implemented appropriately for each member within their living environment.

  • Participate in the selection of new members and conduct member intake tasks. Establish regular and consistent contact during the transition.

  • Monitor member sites and living environments. Implement systems to address safety concerns, trends or hazards.

  • Be an expert in the the development and monitoring of individualized member program goals, objectives, supports to ensure members are safe, happy, and empowered. Monitor rights restrictions on a routine basis to provide the least restrictive environment necessary.

  • Check medication areas and follow up on any medication errors, organizational issues, outdated medication, drug destruction, etc.

  • Complete serious/critical incident reports and related follow-up; oversee member crisis intervention and risk management planning. Assist in developing and implementing corrective action plans.

  • Assist in investigations and grievance resolution procedures as necessary to meet the needs of members and their DSP staff.

  • Be physically present for matters of importance e.g., meetings with guardians or other stakeholders, specialty medical appointments, member team meetings, annual team meetings or assessments.

  • Attend and participate in the member assessments. Coordinate with member Case Managers, parents, guardians, and others as needed, to facilitate individualized service provision.

  • Promote members’ health and well-being in a manner which is satisfactory to the member and their team, and Mainstream Living values, ensuring that routine and non routine appointments are scheduled, attended; staff are available and ongoing follow up appointments occur.

  • Communicate member medical and/or health needs with nurse/medical staff as necessary and in a timely manner, including not limited to member illness, injury, medication, hospitalization, or serious incident. Ensure immediate steps are taken as needed and follow up steps or checks are completed. Monitor member hospitalizations.

  • Assist in the development, training, implementation and monitoring of member behavioral support plans.

  • Maintain routine and timely communication that fosters positive and professional relationships with members, guardians, staff, case managers and other stakeholders regarding direct service and specific needs of members, including quarterly updates with MCO’s.

  • Complete protocols for member discharges or transfers.


General administrative

  • Attendance and communication are essential to this position. Although there is flexibility in setting personal work schedules, it is essential to be physically present for meetings or events, site or member visits, appointments, etc. Remote attendance may be proactively approved by Program Coordinator or designee, on a case by case basis but shall not be the standard.

  • Maintain routine communication that fosters positive and professional relationships with other MSL departments, including timely follow up to email/phone inquiries and other requests.

  • In consultation with ATL, communicate with HR or Payroll personnel regarding employee matters, e.g., employee leaves/FMLA, status changes, transfers, work comp injuries, terminations, employee conduct/performance, etc. Ensure necessary reports or follow up are completed in a timely manner.

  • Follow HIPAA and agency confidentiality guidelines for all communication or agency documentation that occurs or is taken off work premises.

  • Monitor individual or member site budgets and ensure time worked reflects efficient services from staff and that overall service provision meets the requirements of each individual’s plan.

  • Monitor and account for agency funds accurately e.g., petty cash, purchases.

  • Complete special projects as assigned and attend internal and external committees/meetings as assigned, acting as professional representative of the agency.

  • Participate in ongoing personal development and keep informed of news/changes from internal and external parties.


We are pleased to provide eligible employees with fantastic benefits which include:

  • 403(b) retirement plan with match
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays and sick time
  • Regular wage increase evaluation
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Education grants
  • Life insurance, cancer coverage, and flexible spending accounts
  • Opportunities for bonuses/incentives and internal recognition programs

title: Tilsynsmedarbejder til Vedligehold og Kontrakter
description:
Vil du være med til at sikre en stabil og sikker jernbaneinfrastruktur, så er dette job noget for dig!

Hos Banedanmark arbejder vi målrettet mod en vision, hvor 90 % af vedligeholdelsen af jernbanen skal udføres af eksterne entreprenører. Det stiller store krav til vores tilsynsarbejde, og vi har brug for dygtige tilsynsmedarbejdere, der sikrer, at vedligeholdelsen sker efter de rette aftaler, planer, kontrakter og normer.

Som en del af vores team vil du spille en central rolle i tilsynsopgaver på jernbanen på Sjælland, Lolland og Falster. Du bliver en del af et team på 14 medarbejdere, der er i en spændende udvikling, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på arbejdsgange i teamet og bidrage til vores fælles mål.

Vi arbejder fra vores moderne domicil i Ringsted og værdsætter videndeling, godt kollegaskab og tværfagligt samarbejde, så vi sammen kan levere tilsynsopgaver af højeste kvalitet.

Dine primære opgaver

Som tilsynsmedarbejder i Banedanmark vil du:

  • Føre tilsyn med vedligeholdelsesopgaver i henhold til kontrakter
  • Deltage i fornyelses- og forbedringsprojekter
  • Kombinere administrativt arbejde og fysisk tilsyn på jernbanen
  • Udarbejde rapporter og bidrage til vidensdeling i teamet
  • Gennemføre kvalitetskontrol af udført arbejde samt overvåge arbejdsmiljø og jernbanesikkerhed m.m.

Arbejdet vil primært foregå i dagtimerne, men natarbejde kan forekomme i forbindelse med specifikke opgaver og projekter.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger en engageret tilsynsmedarbejder, der trives med at tage ansvar og samarbejde med mange forskellige faggrupper. Du har en fagteknisk baggrund og interesse for drift, vedligeholdelse og udvikling af jernbanen.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med sporarbejde og gerne kendskab til Sporteknik 1+2, modul 3, SR2 og ORF/S
  • Har erfaring med teknisk fornyelse, drift og vedligeholdelse
  • Er god til at skabe relationer og samarbejde med både kolleger og samarbejdspartnere
  • Har en struktureret og systematisk tilgang til dine opgaver,
  • Har gode IT-kompetencer og gerne med erfaring i SAP

Har du ikke de nævnte Sporteknik-kurser og sikkerhedskompetencer, men den rette faglige baggrund og motivation, hører vi stadig gerne fra dig. Vi sørger for den nødvendige oplæring og uddannelse.

Du skal have kørekort til personbil, og ansættelsen forudsætter, at du kan opnå den helbredsgodkendelse, som stillingen kræver.

Hvad kan du forvente?

Hos os får du en varieret hverdag med både tilsyn på jernbanen og administrative opgaver. Du får en selvstændig rolle med stor indflydelse på planlægningen af dine opgaver. Samtidig får du et grundigt oplærings- og uddannelsesforløb samt gode muligheder for at udvikle dine faglige og personlige kompetencer.

Desuden tilbyder vi:

  • Betalt frokostpause, god kantineordning og fitnesslokaler
  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde
  • Prioriteret firmabil til arbejdskørsel
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab med fokus på samarbejde og videndeling

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Du ansættes efter den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftalen mellem Banedanmark og Dansk Jernbaneforbund.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt indplaceret i løngruppe 4, svarende til en basisløn ekskl. pension på 32.813,86 kr. jf. gældende overenskomst, som du finder her.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der vil til den samlede løn være tilknyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning på 16 %.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte Teamleder Klaus Ehlers på tlf.: 2116 6831.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår, kan du kontakte vores HR-konsulenter på mail banedanmarkpersonale@BANE.dk.

For at søge stillingen skal du klikke på linket ‘Søg stilling’ og følge instrukserne.

Går du videre fra de indledende samtaler, kan der blive indhentet referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgiver. Du vil blive informeret inden, at der bliver indhentet en reference.

Forskellige perspektiver gør os stærkere. Derfor værdsætter Banedanmark mangfoldighed og opfordrer alle interesserede kandidater, uanset personlig baggrund, til at søge.
