title: Senior Software Developer – Embedded VOIP
description:
Senior Software Developer – Embedded VoIP Systems

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Embedded Software Developer to join our team working on VoIP telephone development as part of the FortiVoice solution.

This role involves low-level embedded Linux development as well as application-level VoIP software development. The successful candidate should be comfortable working across the embedded software stack, including bootloaders, the Linux kernel, device drivers, system software, and applications.

A strong understanding of resource-constrained embedded systems, debugging, and performance optimization is important for this role.

Key Responsibilities

Embedded Linux & System Software

  • Develop and maintain software for embedded Linux-based platforms.

  • Work with bootloaders, the Linux kernel, and device drivers, including modifying and debugging existing code when required.

  • Configure, build, and troubleshoot the Linux kernel and bootloader for target hardware.

  • Use embedded toolchains and cross-compilation environments to build system and application software for target platforms.

  • Work with real-time and performance-sensitive Linux environments.

  • Debug issues across the software stack, from bootloader and kernel-level problems to user-space applications.

  • Work with IPC (Inter-Process Communication), multithreading, synchronization, and related system-level concepts.

  • Analyze and optimize CPU usage, memory usage, startup time, and overall system performance.

VoIP & Telephony Development

  • Develop and maintain embedded software for VoIP telephone products.

  • Work with SIP and related VoIP/telephony technologies.

  • Investigate and resolve signaling, media, networking, and system integration issues.

  • Develop efficient software suitable for embedded systems with limited CPU and memory resources.

Software Development

  • Design, implement, test, and maintain software primarily in C and C++.

  • Apply object-oriented design principles where appropriate.

  • Diagnose complex software problems using effective debugging techniques and tools.

  • Work with static and dynamic libraries, including library linking and dependency management.

  • Use development environments and tools such as Eclipse, Visual Studio, GDB, and related embedded development/debugging tools.

  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to software design and architecture discussions.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Strong experience in embedded software development using C/C++.

  • Hands-on experience developing software in a Linux embedded environment.

  • Working knowledge of Linux kernel architecture and kernel-level development.

  • Experience working with and debugging Linux device drivers.

  • Experience working with bootloaders and the embedded Linux boot process.

  • Hands-on experience with cross-compilation, embedded toolchains, and target platform builds.

  • Good understanding of IPC, multithreading, synchronization, and process management.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including the ability to troubleshoot issues across multiple layers of an embedded system.

  • Understanding of memory and performance constraints common to embedded systems.

Preferred / Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following would be an asset but is not required:

  • Telephony systems and technologies.

  • VoIP protocols, particularly SIP.

  • Real-time Linux and performance-sensitive applications.

  • Networking protocols and network programming.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Clear and effective communication skills.

  • Responsible, self-motivated, and proactive.

  • Comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

  • Able to prioritize and deliver high-quality work under schedule constraints.

  • Willing and able to learn new technologies quickly.

The Canada base salary range for this full-time position is expected to be between $150,000 - $183,000 annually. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.

Fortinet strives to provide you and your family with a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. We offer competitive Paid Time Off and flexible leave policies, including paid health days, to help you take care of yourself and your family members.

title: Residential Real Estate Appraiser
description:
The Residential Real Property Appraiser is responsible for appraising and valuing residential real estate for ad valorem tax purposes in accordance with the Texas Property Tax Code and established appraisal standards. This position conducts field inspections, analyzes property and market data, determines property values, and communicates appraisal information to property owners and stakeholders.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, and committed to ensuring accurate, equitable, and uniform property valuations while providing exceptional customer service.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collect, analyze, and maintain accurate property information used in the appraisal process.

  • Update and maintain property records within the district's appraisal systems.
  • Research and interpret property ownership records, deeds, legal descriptions, maps, plats, architectural plans, and related documents.
  • Monitor and review new construction, remodeling, additions, and demolition activity.
  • Respond to taxpayer inquiries regarding property values, appraisal methods, and valuation notices.
  • Conduct informal reviews with property owners and assist with property valuation disputes.
  • Prepare valuation evidence and supporting documentation for Appraisal Review Board (ARB) hearings.
  • Ensure compliance with the Texas Property Tax Code, district policies, and professional appraisal standards.
  • Complete required training, continuing education, and certification requirements.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.


Compensation

Salary Range: $50,400 to $69,500 annually, depending on qualifications and experience.

Additional Compensation: $800 monthly automobile allowance


Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Retirement plan
  • Deferred Compensation
  • Paid holidays and paid time off
  • Professional development and certification
  • Advancement Opportunities


Why Join DCAD?

At the Dallas Central Appraisal District (DCAD), we are committed to providing equal and fair property valuations for all property owners throughout Dallas County.


We are seeking a Residential Real Property Appraiser who shares our commitment to fairness, professionalism, and public service. If you are a motivated, detail-oriented individual with an interest in real estate, property valuation, and serving the community, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.


Entry-level applicants are encouraged to apply. We provide comprehensive training, mentoring, and professional development opportunities to help employees build successful careers in property appraisal.

title: Senior/Staff Technical Program Manager - Automation & Scaling
description:
The Program Management Office (PMO) at Zoox is responsible for driving cross-functional program planning and execution at the highest level. We partner with leaders from across the company in vehicle development, system design, software engineering, manufacturing, fleet operations, and business functions to develop and deliver major corporate milestones on the path to launch, and beyond. Our program managers contribute to the end-to-end success of technical, integrated product milestones involving both of our vehicle platforms - the Toyota Highlander test fleet and Zoox's purpose-built robotaxi.

As Zoox scales its fleet and expands into new cities, we are evolving how we develop, validate, and release software by leveraging simulation, automation, faster triage, and scalable infrastructure. Our goal is to deliver improvements to our autonomous fleet faster and more frequently, while upholding our high bar for safety and quality.

As the Technical Program Manager for Automation & Scaling, you will own the systems that make that cadence possible. That means leveraging simulation to validate at scale, scaling the cloud infrastructure behind it, and automating the triage and metrics pipelines that shorten review cycles. This is a hands-on builder role. We are looking for a technically deep program leader who has built and deployed automation that measurably cut cycle time, and who can turn promising research and prototypes across Zoox into operational, production-grade systems.

In this role, you will:

  • Leverage simulation at scale: Partner with Simulation, Autonomy, and Mission Assurance teams to make simulation the primary engine for validation, expanding coverage and reducing reliance on on-road testing.
  • Drive automation: Identify manual, repetitive steps across development, validation, and release, and lead the design and deployment of automation that removes them, prioritizing the work that most reduces cycle time.
  • Enable faster triage: Deploy AI-assisted systems that parse logs, classify failures, and route issues, significantly reducing the time from test results to actionable fixes.
  • Build scalable infrastructure: Scale cloud-based (AWS) simulation, metrics, data processing, and release evaluation pipelines so they grow with volume and support a faster, more frequent release cadence.
  • Operationalize what already exists: Work alongside Zoox's technical experts and research teams, apply a programmatic lens, and turn prototypes into production systems that teams depend on.
  • Drive and measure impact: Instrument the process end to end, find the bottlenecks, and report progress against cycle-time goals in clear, data-backed narratives for executive leadership

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, technical program management, or a combination, with a strong software background.
  • A track record of designing and deploying automation that measurably reduced cycle time, such as CI/CD, test, data, or triage pipelines.
  • Hands-on familiarity with AWS and large-scale distributed compute and data systems, including simulation workloads.
  • Experience building or applying AI/ML-based tools to analyze logs, detect failures, or automate engineering workflows.
  • Proven ability to take research or prototype work into production, and to influence technical experts without formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including turning technical bottlenecks into clear decisions for leadership.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Deep experience leveraging simulation platforms, virtual validation strategies, or synthetic data in autonomous vehicles or robotics.
  • Experience moving a large engineering organization from infrequent releases to a release train or continuous delivery model.
  • Experience with release qualification, verification and validation, or safety-critical software.
  • Hands-on coding experience in Python or similar, building internal tools and automation.
About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

CHAIL is a youth, family, and community focused 501(c)(3) organization with multiple locations and 450 staff, located in Peoria, IL. Children’s Home Association of Illinois (CHAIL) is the largest social service agency for youth and families in downstate Illinois. title: Intern, Health Promotions
description:

The intern will assist the American Lung Association Health Promotions staff to execute program planning, outreach and health education activities to gain experience in the field of public health, with an emphasis on supporting the Better Breathers Club program for adults living with chronic lung disease and their caregivers. They will also assist in developing public facing educational content related to chronic lung disease.

This is an unpaid internship position requiring a minimum time commitment of 10 hours per week (flexible schedule) and must be eligible for course credit or fulfill a graduation requirement. This position is for the Winter/Spring academic term of 2027 and may be completed in Spring/Summer 2027.

LOCATION: This position will be remote opportunity.

PROJECTS

This is a great opportunity for the intern to enhance their skills in organization, multi-tasking and communications. The intern can expect to develop confidence and marketable skills by engaging in or assisting with many of the following activities:

  • Gain a basic understanding of the American Lung Association
    • Become knowledgeable of mission, development, and communications efforts.
    • Participate in staff meetings and learning opportunities.
    • Develop skills in working across a multi-disciplinary team to achieve a common outcome.
    • Gain technical training by utilizing internal learning management system (LMS) to complete lung health education and program training curricula
  • Support health promotion programs and activities
    • Work across both local and national teams to ensure Better Breathers Clubs and the trained facilitators are meeting current American Lung Association guidelines
    • Assist with promotion and marketing efforts of the Better Breathers Club.
    • Assist in compiling, verifying and updating Better Breathers Club program records and contact information, including attending and observing Clubs if possible.
    • Assist with brainstorming and providing creative ideas to execute partnership development and program promotion outreach.
    • Develop one or more creative ideas for public facing educational content related to lung health.


LEARNING OUTCOMES

  • Learn about non-profit structure, including mission, development, and communications efforts.
  • Gain a basic understanding of program delivery, e-communications and constituent record management platforms.
  • Gain technical training by utilizing internal learning management system (LMS) to complete lung health education and program training curricula.
  • Learn about team building and collaborating with staff.
  • Learn how to develop communications for program promotion to partner organizations, clinicians and the public.
  • Learn to cultivate relationships.
  • Learn how to communicate in a professional office setting.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be working towards a master’s degree in Non-Profit Management, Public Health, Health Education, Social Work, Communications or related field
  • Must be eligible to receive college credit for internship or fulfill a graduation requirement
  • Qualified candidates must be enthusiastic, reliable, and interested in developing a career in public health.
  • Qualified candidates should possess strong writing skills, attention to detail, and have a keen interest in the mission of the American Lung Association
  • Ability to multitask, perform in a team environment, and a demonstrated willingness to learn
  • Ability to work independently

  • Ability to lift and carry 25 lbs. (supplies)

title: Yard Management Specialist
description:
This role is an onsite position at our Bardstown Bottling facility. Schedule is Monday-Friday 7:00am-3:00pm.

What the Role Is

The Yard Management System (YMS) / Spotting Specialist is responsible for coordinating trailer movements, yard activity, dock assignments, and spotting operations to support safe, efficient, and timely warehouse and transportation operations. The Specialist serves as a key point of coordination between Heaven Hill’s warehouse, transportation, inventory control, carriers, drivers, and yard spotting operations. This position will actively manage the Yard Management System, maintain accurate trailer and yard inventory, prioritize trailer moves based on operational needs, and ensure equipment is positioned at the correct dock or yard location when required.

The Yard Management Specialist reports to the Manager of Logistics and Inventory Control and works primarily on first shift, supporting daily yard, warehouse, transportation, and inventory control activities. Some flexibility outside normal first-shift hours may be required based on business and operational needs.

How You Will Spend Your Time?

Yard Management & Trailer Control

  • Maintain accurate, real-time trailer locations and statuses within the Yard Management System.
  • Monitor inbound, outbound, loaded, empty, staged, and out-of-service trailers throughout the Heaven Hill facility.
  • Conduct regular yard inventory reconciliation and resolve discrepancies between physical trailer locations and YMS records.
  • Ensure trailers are properly assigned to designated yard locations, dock doors, staging areas, or parking locations.
  • Track trailer dwell time and identify equipment that may require additional attention or escalation.
  • Maintain visibility of available empty trailers to support shipping requirements.
  • Coordinate trailer availability with transportation and warehouse teams to prevent operational delays.

Spotting Coordination

  • Coordinate and prioritize trailer moves for yard spotters based on warehouse, shipping, receiving, inventory, and transportation requirements.
  • Dispatch spotting moves through the YMS, radio, mobile device, or other approved communication method.
  • Monitor outstanding spotter moves and adjust priorities as operational conditions change.
  • Ensure trailers are moved to dock doors and staging locations according to scheduled loading and unloading requirements.
  • Coordinate removal of completed trailers from dock doors to maintain dock availability.
  • Communicate special handling instructions, equipment requirements, or priority movements to yard spotters.
  • Escalate delays, equipment shortages, congestion, or other issues that could impact shipping or receiving operations.

Shipping & Receiving Coordination

  • Communicate with shipping and receiving teams regarding trailer readiness, dock availability, and operational priorities.
  • Coordinate inbound trailers to receiving doors based on appointment schedules and warehouse capacity.
  • Coordinate outbound trailers to shipping doors based on production schedules, customer requirements, and carrier pickup times.
  • Monitor scheduled carrier arrivals and departures and communicate exceptions to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Help ensure trailers are available and positioned in advance of scheduled loading or unloading activities.

Carrier & Driver Coordination

  • Assist with driver check-in and check-out processes as required.
  • Provide drivers with accurate instructions regarding trailer locations, dock assignments, staging areas, and facility procedures.
  • Verify trailer numbers, carrier information, shipment status, and equipment assignments.
  • Communicate with carriers regarding trailer availability, drop-and-hook activity, and equipment requirements.
  • Escalate late arrivals, missed pickups, equipment issues, or other carrier-related exceptions.

Safety & Compliance

  • Support compliance with all Heaven Hill safety rules, policies, and yard operating procedures.
  • Ensure trailer movements are coordinated in a manner that minimizes yard congestion and unnecessary movements.
  • Report unsafe conditions, damaged trailers, equipment issues, seal discrepancies, or other concerns immediately.
  • Maintain clear communication with spotters and drivers regarding pedestrian traffic, restricted areas, and yard safety requirements.
  • Support compliance with company transportation, security, quality, food/beverage safety, and regulatory requirements where applicable.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor key yard performance indicators such as:
    • Trailer dwell time
    • Spotting move completion time
    • Dock utilization
    • Trailer inventory accuracy
    • Empty trailer availability
    • Carrier wait time
    • Yard congestion
  • Identify recurring operational issues and recommend improvements to yard processes.
  • Assist with development and maintenance of standard operating procedures for yard and spotting operations.
  • Provide shift updates and communicate unresolved issues to the next shift or appropriate leadership.
  • Support effective handoffs between first, second, and third shifts as needed.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to transportation, warehouse flow, trailer utilization, inventory control, and yard efficiency.

Who You Are…

Required Skills and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in transportation, logistics, warehousing, distribution, shipping/receiving, yard operations, or a related field, preferably in a high-volume distribution, manufacturing or CPG operation
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple trailer moves and operational priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills. Frequent communication with yard drivers, carriers, warehouse personnel, inventory control, and transportation teams is required.
  • Basic computer proficiency and ability to learn transportation and warehouse management systems.
  • Ability to work effectively with drivers, carriers, spotters, warehouse associates, transportation personnel, inventory control, and leadership.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate system information.
  • Ability to make timely decisions in a fast-paced operating environment.

Valued but not Required Skills:

  • Previous experience coordinating yard spotters or trailer movements.
  • Experience using a Yard Management System (YMS), Transportation Management System (TMS), or Warehouse Management System (WMS).
  • Knowledge of drop-and-hook operations, trailer pools, dock scheduling, and carrier operations.
  • Familiarity with transportation terminology, trailer types, shipping documentation, and DOT-related operating requirements.

Physical Requirements

While performing duties of job, employee is occasionally required to:

  • Stand, walk, use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects, operate a computer, and reach with hands and arms.
  • Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.
  • May require periodic work outdoors or in yard areas to verify equipment locations. Must be comfortable working around tractors, trailers, forklifts, and other material-handling equipment.

Benefits

  • Paid Vacation
  • 11 Paid Holidays
  • Health, Dental & Vision eligibility from day one
  • FSA/HSA
  • 401K match
  • EAP
  • Maternity/Paternity Leave

Heaven Hill and its affiliates are committed to fostering a diverse workforce as an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, natural origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Korleder til Hvidovre Musik- og Billedskole
description:
I Hvidovre Kommune bygger vores samarbejde på en anerkendende og positiv kultur, hvor forskellighed er en styrke. Engagement, nysgerrighed og arbejdsglæde fremmer nye idéer og god service til borgere, virksomheder, kulturliv og samarbejdspartnere.


Hvidovre er en grøn forstad med en stærk historie; tæt ved vandet og hovedstaden og lige midt i Øresundsregionen.


Hvidovre Kommune ser mangfoldighed som en ressource, og ønsker at afspejle samfundet. Derfor opfordres alle til at søge uanset køn, alder, religion, seksuel orientering, handicap/funktionsnedsættelse og etnisk baggrund.

Korleder til Hvidovre Musikskole

Genopslag

Er du en kompetent korleder, som favner bredt, er her en spændende stilling på én af hovedstadsområdets attraktive musikskoler.

Opgaverne omfatter:

  • Lungekor – ifølge Lungeforeningen landets største af sin slags
  • Morgensang med byens borgere i kommunens nye og indbydende kulturhus
  • Spire- og børnekor for hhv. 1.-2. klasse og 3.-4. klasse på Musikskolen
  • Korklasser eller korprojekter i folkeskolen

På Hvidovre musikskole ønsker vi at udvikle et børnekormiljø nedefra, og som vores nye kollega kommer du til at spille en central rolle i dette vigtige arbejde.

Rent praktisk ligger morgensang og Lungekor fast på onsdage, og vores fem årlige personalemøder ligger på fredag formiddage. De øvrige funktioner i stillingen kan placeres mere frit.

Hvidovre Musikskole har 766 elever og 34 ansatte, og er én af hovedstadsområdets store kulturskoler.

Vi har skønne rammer centralt i Hvidovre og ligger i bekvem cykelafstand til København. Skolen er kendt for et stærkt og varmt kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi har foruden musikundervisning en billedskole og undervisning i dans og drama og dertil et rigt udbygget samarbejde med alle kommunens folkeskoler.

Stillingens størrelse vil forventeligt ligge omkring 17/37, men alt efter den valgte kandidats kompetencer, kan den være større eller mindre.

Stillingen ønskes besat 1. februar 2027 – og gerne tidligere, hvis muligt.

Ansøgningsfrist: Tirsdag 1. december 2026

Samtaler: Tirsdag 8. december først på dagen.

Ved spørgsmål til stillingen er du hjertens velkommen til at tage kontakt til musikskoleleder Marie Okkels på 50843950 eller oky@hvidovre.dk

title: EPC Sr. Construction Specialist
description:
Job Summary:

Centrus Energy is seeking senior field Construction Specialists that will plan and control field execution of facility modifications and new installations at the American Centrifuge Plant (ACP) on the DOE Portsmouth reservation in Piketon, Ohio. Projects are under NRC regulation, requiring rigorous safety, quality, and regulatory discipline in construction and turnover activities. This supports evolving mission needs and infrastructure changes across a range of potential enrichment and processing operations. Overall value of construction is estimated at over $1B in the next five years.

What You Will Do:

Act as Subcontract Technical Representative for field construction contractors ensuring they meet contractual requirements to deliver assigned scopes of work

  • Support project planning, included contracted scopes, cost, schedule, risks, and opportunities to construct the ACPx projects. Projects will include renovation of legacy and construction of new nuclear quality class structures
  • Support constructability reviews of conceptual and detailed design outputs including statements of work (SOWs), specifications, and drawings
  • Supports execution of design outputs via contracted companies into executable work deliverables including but not limited to permits, procedures, testing, hold points, and acceptance criteria. Sponsor team resolution of RFIs/RFCs, manage redlines, and drive as-built documentation to maintain configuration control
  • Support or lead construction scopes administered via EPC and specialty contractors – monitor cost, schedule, and performance; enforce contract requirements; and manage change orders and progress verification
  • Ensure group regulatory compliance during field execution that aligns with applicable codes/standards (e.g., NEC/NFPA/OSHA/IEEE), site procedures, and the ACP licensing/regulatory framework governing operations at Piketon
  • Champion safety first within construction staff including industrial and electrical safety (LO/TO, arc-flash controls) and DOE/nuclear-quality expectations during pre-job briefs, hazard analyses, and audits; verify contractor compliance and immediate corrective action for deficiencies
  • Plan and witness construction tests, ensure punch-list completion, and coordinate functional testing/energization with operations to achieve Ready-for-Operations and clean handover packages
  • Provide clear field status, risks, and mitigations to project managers and site leadership; coordinate interfaces with DOE/utility stakeholders as needed for power or site services
  • Capture lessons learned and proposed procedural or design feedback to reduce rework and improve constructability on future ACP/HALEU scopes


We’d Love to Hear from People With:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil/Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, or related) or Construction Management from an accredited institution and or equivalent field experience will be considered
  • 5+ years in construction engineering role or field engineering role for industrial facilities (nuclear, chemical process, oil & gas, or large manufacturing), including oversight of contractors and multi-discipline field scopes
  • Hands-on experience with work planning and approval documentation, QA/QC inspections, welding/mechanical/electrical installation oversight, and startup/commissioning support. Familiar with RFIs, NCRs, test plans, and as-built control
  • Demonstrated collaboration with EPCs and vendors and familiarity with progress tracking, change control, and field estimating
  • Working knowledge of DOE site operations or similarly regulated environments; ability to execute work consistent with ACP’s licensing basis and site procedures
  • Practical application of NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA, IEEE/NEMA; strong safety leadership record supporting high-hazard work
  • Must possess or be able to obtain and maintain a “Q” level security clearance

A Successful Candidate Brings:

  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Holds an active “Q” or Top-Secret Clearance
Pay:
Estimated Starting Base Salary Range: $67,564 - $135,128. This position is Incentive eligible. Centrus considers several factors when extending job offers, including but not limited to candidates’ key skills, relevant work experience, and education/training/certifications. While the posted range reflects the anticipated hiring range for this position, compensation above the range may be considered for candidates with exceptional qualifications and directly relevant experience.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

This position will require a pre­-employment background check and a pre-employment drug test.

Centrus Energy and all subsidiaries shall abide by the applicable legal requirements. We prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin.

This position requires the successful candidate to obtain and maintain a Q security clearance. Candidates for positions requiring a security clearance are required to be tested for the absence of any illegal drug as defined in 10 CFR 707.4 prior to an offer of employment being made. In addition, once employed, employees will become part of a random drug testing program and may also be tested in the event of any incident causing injury or causing damage to property, or if it is determined that there is a reasonable suspicion the employee is under the influence of drugs or alcohol. This position will require preemployment background check on the part of the Company and in order to receive a Q security clearance, a background investigation by the Federal government. Subsequent Federal government reinvestigations may be required.

title: QA Automation Manager
description:
About Us


At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.

We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavor Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers. We get things done with urgency and focus, driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego, fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious—always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.


About the Role


We’re looking for a QA Automation Manager to lead quality automation across Félix’s products. You will expand and lead the QA Automation function, set the test automation vision and strategy across engineering teams, and make sure every release that moves our customers’ money is reliable, fast, and safe.

You’ll lead a growing team of QA Automation engineers through two QA Leads who report directly to you. We believe great QA leadership is hands-on: you’ll stay deep in the technical work by leading architecture discussions, guiding the team toward the best technical path, and getting your hands dirty when complex problems need you. You’ll partner closely with engineering, product, and platform leaders to make quality a shared responsibility and to keep release velocity high without compromising production health.


Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Growth
  • Lead and develop the QA Leads, and through them a team of QA Automation engineers, with clear goals, regular 1:1s, and career development.
  • Hire and onboard new QA Automation talent as the team scales.
  • Set clear expectations and ownership for QA Automation coverage across product squads.

Quality Automation Strategy & Release Readiness
  • Define and own the end-to-end quality automation strategy across products, from design reviews to production.
  • Establish quality gates, acceptance criteria, and release-readiness standards with product and engineering.
  • Make or inform go/no-go release decisions using clear test metrics and risk analysis.
  • Drive improvements in release velocity while keeping production health strong.

Technical Direction & Infrastructure
  • Own the roadmap for our automation frameworks (UI, API, and performance) and their CI/CD integration.
  • Lead architecture discussions and give the final technical call on test automation design and tooling.
  • Drive performance testing initiatives to ensure our systems scale reliably.
  • Champion the use of AI to improve QA efficiency, coverage, and tooling.
  • Ensure regression and smoke suites are reliable, fast, and scalable.
  • Partner with engineers so they write testable code and own quality alongside QA.

Process, Metrics & Defect Management
  • Define QA Automation processes and best practices, and champion a quality-first culture across the organization.
  • Track and report quality metrics (coverage, defect trends, escaped bugs, test stability) to leadership.
  • Oversee defect triage and root-cause analysis with stakeholders, closing the loop on fixes and prevention.
  • Build and maintain monitoring for test health and stability.


Requirements


  • 8+ years of experience in QA Automation, including 2+ years leading or managing QA Automation engineers.
  • Strong hands-on automation background: you can go from high-level strategy to technical detail in the same conversation.
  • Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining AI-powered tools and solutions for QA purposes.
  • Hands-on experience leading performance testing projects.
  • Python experience, including pytest.
  • Experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks for UI, API, and performance (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.

title: Introduktionsstilling i neurologi ved Afdeling for Hjerne- og Nervesygdomme, Herlev og Gentofte Hospital
description:
Synes du neurologien er spændende, og ønsker du dig gode muligheder for at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt, så er en introduktionsstilling på Afdeling for Hjerne- og Nervesygdomme, Herlev og Gentofte Hospital lige noget for dig!

Vi har på afdelingen stort fokus på uddannelse og arbejder med struktureret kompetencevurdering, supervision ved speciallæge i alle kliniske funktioner samt daglige undervisningsseancer i forbindelse med morgenkonference. Vores mål er sammen med dig at skræddersy det rigtige uddannelsesforløb med fokus på udvikling af din neurologiske faglighed samt kvalifikation til HU i neurologi.

Du vil komme til at arbejde i en lægegruppe med højt til loftet og stor lyst til sparring, faglig drøftelse og prioritere bed-side supervision hvilket også afspejles nylig inspektorrapport ved vurdering af at der i afdelingen er særdeles godt uddannelsesmiljøet og tilbud og læring i rollen som medicinsk ekspert og akademiker. Du får således i afdelingen god mulighed for trygt at udvikle dine diagnostiske evner inden for især den akutte neurologi.

Afdelingen kort fortalt
Afdelingen består af to sengeafsnit (ét for akut neurologi og ét for stroke), et neurologisk ambulatorium med subspecialiserede klinikker, samt en hukommelsesklinik. Vi er derudover en del af den fælles akutmodtagelse, hvor vi har vores eget neuro-team med dedikeret plejepersonale og speciallæge i front.

Vi har en forskningsenhed for stroke, hvor forskerne tæller både læger, sygeplejerske og fysioterapeut. Vi er lokal neurologisk afdeling for ca. 450.000 borgere i Planområde Midt.

Vi er ca. 170 medarbejdere i afdelingen, hvoraf lægegruppen består af ca. 45 læger fordelt på speciallæger, yngre læger i hoveduddannelse og introduktionsstillinger, KBU-læger, og yngre læger i uklassificerede stillinger.

Dine arbejdsområder
Arbejdet består i vagtarbejde, dagarbejde med stuegang eller ambulatoriearbejde. Altid superviseret af en mere erfaren kollega. Arbejdet planlægges under hensyntagen til dine kvalifikationer og interesse.

Du får din egen vejleder og vil, efter lyst og kompetence, få rig mulighed for at byde ind på forskellige ansvarsområder som kan være med til at kvalificere til en hoveduddannelse uanset speciale. Det kan være kvalitetsarbejde, tillidshverv (TR, UKYL, skemalægning og lignende), undervisning af både medicinstuderende, plejepersonale og patienter. Ligeledes vil der være mulighed for at deltage i større og mindre forskningsprojekter.

Dine kvalifikationer
Engagement, interesse, lyst og prioritering af faglig udvikling og arbejdsglæde er vigtige kvalifikationer. Ligeledes ønsker vi ansøgere som har lyst til at bidrage til vores gode arbejdsmiljø.

Hvis du har neurologisk erfaring præ- såvel som postgraduat, herunder neuro-relateret forskningserfaring, vil det selvfølgelig være yderligere kvalificerende

Flere oplysninger
Ønsker du yderligere informationer, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

  • Cheflæge, Lars-Henrik Krarup på telefon 3868 1174 eller mail lars-henrik.krarup@regionh.dk
  • Uddannelsesansvarlig overlæge, Hanne Yri på telefon 3868 5963 eller mail hanne.maria.yri@regionh.dk

Hvornår

title: Vil du spille en central rolle som systemforvalter i et samfundskritisk it-system?
description:
CPR er en grundsten i det danske samfund. Det stiller høje krav til den løbende forvaltning, vedligeholdelse og udvikling af systemet – ikke mindst i en tid, hvor opmærksomheden på sikkerhed og robusthed er stor.

Vi søger en systemforvalter, der vil være med til at sikre, at CPR-systemet fungerer stabilt og tilpasses nye behov og krav. Du får en central rolle i den daglige forvaltning af et samfundskritisk system, hvor kvalitet, overblik og samarbejde er afgørende.

Om stillingen
Du skal i tæt samarbejde med CPRs driftsoperatør være med til at understøtte procesforvaltning ift. systemet, at der er styr på opfølgning og dokumentation samt understøtte samarbejdet med leverandøren og de relevante samarbejdspartnere.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • bidrage til at udvikle og forbedre arbejdsgange og processer for forvaltningen af CPR-systemet
  • koordinere og følge op på den løbende forvaltning af CPR-systemet - herunder drift, vedligeholdelse, fejlrettelser og releases
  • håndtere driftsproblemer, risici og afhængigheder i samarbejde med tekniske specialister og leverandører
  • sikre, at systemdokumentation, forvaltningsprocesser og aftaler er opdaterede og anvendelige

Du bliver en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor tekniske, administrative og juridiske opgaver hænger tæt sammen. Vi samarbejder på tværs for at sikre, at CPR-systemet er velfungerende, sikkert og tidssvarende.

Om dig
Vi leder efter dig, der har en relevant akademisk uddannelsesbaggrund og erfaring med systemforvaltning, herunder drift, vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af it-systemer. Du skal have lyst til at sætte dig ind i et komplekst system og tage ansvar for, at opgaver bliver fulgt til dørs.

Du vil passe godt til stillingen, hvis du:

  • har erfaring med systemforvaltning eller lignende opgaver og forstår samspillet mellem drift, vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af et it-system
  • kan bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver og hensyn skal håndteres samtidig, og sikre, at aftaler, ændringer og problemer bliver fulgt til dørs
  • er god til at samarbejde med tekniske specialister og leverandører samt følger op på opgaver og løsninger – også når du ikke selv har de tekniske svar
  • arbejder systematisk med dokumentation og processer og kan se, hvor der er behov for bedre struktur eller opfølgning

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med større eller komplekse it-systemer, leverandørstyring, ændringshåndtering eller systemer med høje krav til stabilitet og sikkerhed.

CPR-administraionen
CPR er – også i en international målestok – et unikt register, som udgør et grundlæggende fundament for en smidig og effektiv administration i den offentlige og private sektor. Personnummeret er den entydige nøgle, der gør det muligt at sammenholde og ajourføre personoplysninger på tværs af en lang række både offentlige og private it-systemer.

CPR varetager dels opgaverne med CPR’s drift, vedligeholdelse, udvikling samt levering af CPR’s data til offentlige myndigheder og den private sektor, dels opgaverne i forbindelse med CPR-lovgivningen, herunder folkeregistreringsreglerne vedrørende bopælssager, juridisk kønsskifte mv.

CPR er organisatorisk placeret i Forsknings-, Uddannelses- og Digitaliseringsministeriets departement.

Vi er ca. 15 kollegaer i kontoret med en overvægt af tekniske specialister og jurister. Vi har et stærkt fagligt og socialt fællesskab, hvor vi vægter sparring og faglig udvikling højt. Vi bruger hinandens forskellige kompetencer og tror på, at vi kommer bedre og hurtigere i mål, når vi samarbejder, videndeler og koordinerer.

Vi tager et fælles ansvar for at være en god arbejdsplads, hvor det er sjovt at gå på arbejde, og hvor der er plads til at udvikle sig.

Til daglig mødes vi som udgangspunkt på vores kontor i København tæt ved Kongens Nytorv, men du kan løbende aftale hjemmearbejde med din chef.

Du kan læse mere om os på .

Skal du være med til at forme fremtiden?
Viden former fremtiden, og i Forsknings-, Uddannelses- og Digitaliseringsministeriet arbejder vi for at skabe værdi i samfundet gennem fremragende uddannelse og forskning. Digitalisering er en del af danskernes hverdag og verden, og i Forsknings-, Uddannelses- og Digitaliseringsministeriet skal vi samtidig være Danmarks strategiske blik på digitaliseringen, så Danmark også kan være et digitalt foregangsland i morgen. Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere bidrager til et miljø præget af samarbejde, trivsel og resultater.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Du ansættes som fuldmægtig eller konsulent i Forsknings-, Uddannelses- og Digitaliseringsministeriet efter overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Akademikere i staten (AC). Der er mulighed for at forhandle tillæg, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

Du kan finde oplysninger om lønniveauerne på .

Stillingen er på fuld tid. Vi forventer at byde vores nye kollega velkommen den 1. februar 2027.

Vi holder til hos Digitaliseringsstyrelsen, så arbejdsstedet er Landgreven 4, 1301 København K.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Maria Antonsen på telefonnummer 72 26 97 30 eller på e-mail man@cpr.dk. Send gerne en SMS, så ringer hun dig op.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og efterfølgende opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen i hele din ansættelsesperiode. I forbindelse med ansættelse vil du blive bedt om at fremvise en privat straffeattest.

Søg stillingen
Klik på knappen ”søg stillingen” eller søg via vores hjemmeside fudm.dk. Vi skal have din ansøgning senest fredag den 20. november 2026.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 49-51. Der kan i forbindelse med ansættelsessamtalerne blive brugt case. Der vil forud for ansættelsen blive indhentet referencer.

Ligestilling i alle dens aspekter er vigtig. Derfor opfordres alle interesserede uanset etnisk tilhørsforhold, religion, køn, alder og lign. til at søge stillingen.

title: Principal Consultant - Pharma | Life Sciences
description:
Job Summary:
We are seeking a Principal Consultant with 6-11 years of experience in intellectual property, innovation, and business research within the pharmaceutical, healthcare, or biotechnology sectors. The ideal candidate will have a postgraduate qualification in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Life Sciences, or a relevant PhD, along with strong expertise in chemical structure searching, Markush analysis, and STN-based patent research. The role requires strong techno-commercial research capabilities, the ability to translate complex scientific and patent information into actionable insights, and experience managing client-facing consulting engagements.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead and execute IP, innovation, and business research projects for clients across the pharmaceutical, healthcare, and biotechnology sectors.
  • Conduct patent landscape, prior-art, freedom-to-operate, novelty, invalidity, chemical structure, substructure, similarity, and Markush searches to support strategic decision-making.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive search strategies on STN, including registry, substance, reaction, structure, and Markush searches, and interpret results for pharmaceutical and life sciences projects.
  • Perform market, competitor, pipeline, indication, therapy-area, and emerging-technology research using secondary research, patent databases, scientific literature, and commercial sources.
  • Evaluate innovation opportunities, whitespace areas, technology trends, partnerships, licensing prospects, and potential growth avenues for clients.
  • Synthesize scientific, IP, regulatory, and commercial information into clear insights, recommendations, presentations, and executive-ready reports.
  • Manage project scope, timelines, quality, and stakeholder communication; mentor junior team members and contribute to client proposals, capability presentations, and business development initiatives.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical, healthcare, or biotechnology value chain, including drug discovery, development, commercialization, and evolving industry trends.
  • Hands-on experience in IP research and patent analytics, including prior art, FTO, novelty, invalidity, patent landscape, chemical structure search, substructure search, similarity search, and Markush analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency in STN, including query formulation, structure and substance searching, Registry/CAS-based searches, Markush retrieval, result analysis, and search documentation. Familiarity with tools such as SciFinder-n, Reaxys, Derwent Innovation, Orbit, or PatBase will be an advantage.
  • Proficiency in business research, market intelligence, competitor benchmarking, company profiling, pipeline analysis, and opportunity assessment.
  • Ability to integrate scientific, patent, market, and business information to identify innovation themes, whitespace opportunities, risks, and strategic implications.
  • Strong consulting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous questions, develop research frameworks, and deliver evidence-based recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience in preparing high-quality client reports, proposals, and presentations.
  • Strong project management skills, including work planning, stakeholder management, quality review, and delivery across multiple concurrent assignments.
  • Client-oriented and collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, subject matter experts, and senior stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable mentoring team members while maintaining high standards of accuracy, confidentiality, and delivery excellence.

Postgraduate degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Life Sciences, or a relevant PhD.
6-11 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical or life sciences IP research, including hands-on chemical structure searching, Markush analysis, STN, patent analytics, innovation consulting, or related business research assignments.

Evalueserve is a global leader in managed services that empower smarter decision-making and streamline critical workflows for more than 30% of the Fortune 500 companies across 45 countries. With over 4,500 professionals worldwide, our solutions are grounded in deep domain expertise and enhanced by cutting-edge AI and automation to boost productivity and scale client impact. Over the last 25 years, we have helped clients transform how they work—and today, we are pushing the frontier further with generative and agentic AI.

title: Full Time Anesthesiologist
description:
Full Time Anesthesiologist
Welcome to Allied Digestive Health! We are seeking a Full Time Anesthesiologist at our state-of-the-art Endoscopy center at Princeton Gastroenterology!

About the Role:

As an Anesthesiologist, you will play a critical role in ensuring the safety and comfort of patients undergoing surgical procedures. Your primary responsibility will be to administer anesthesia and monitor patients' vital signs throughout the surgical process. You will collaborate closely with surgeons, nurses, and other medical professionals to develop and implement individualized anesthesia care plans. Additionally, you will be responsible for assessing patients' medical histories and conducting pre-operative evaluations to determine the most appropriate anesthesia methods. Ultimately, your expertise will contribute to positive surgical outcomes and enhance the overall patient experience in the healthcare setting.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree from an accredited institution.
  • Completion of an accredited residency program in anesthesiology.
  • Board certification or eligibility in anesthesiology.
  • NJ Medical License in good standing, DEA and CDS

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Fellowship training in a subspecialty of anesthesiology, such as pain management or pediatric anesthesiology.
  • Experience in a variety of surgical settings, including outpatient and inpatient procedures.
  • Proficiency in advanced anesthesia techniques and technology.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer anesthesia to patients before, during, and after surgical procedures.
  • Monitor patients' vital signs and adjust anesthesia levels as necessary throughout the surgery.
  • Conduct pre-operative assessments to evaluate patients' medical histories and anesthesia risks.
  • Collaborate with surgical teams to develop and implement anesthesia care plans tailored to individual patient needs.
  • Provide post-operative care and pain management solutions to ensure patient comfort and recovery.

Key Benefits:

  • No nights, weekends or call
  • Health Benefits day one to include medical, dental, vision, prescription, life, and Disabilty
  • 401K with Safe Harbor Contribution
  • Malpractice Occurrence based
  • Paid Time Off ( PTO) 4 weeks
  • Licensure reimbursement

Skills:

The required skills for this position include a deep understanding of pharmacology and physiology, which are essential for safely administering anesthesia. Strong communication skills are vital for effectively collaborating with surgical teams and explaining procedures to patients. Attention to detail is crucial in monitoring patients' vital signs and making real-time adjustments to anesthesia levels. Preferred skills, such as proficiency in advanced anesthesia techniques, will enhance your ability to provide specialized care in complex surgical cases. Overall, both required and preferred skills will be utilized daily to ensure patient safety and comfort throughout the surgical experience.

title: Studentermedhjælpere til Slots- og Kulturstyrelsen
description:
Vil du have et studiejob, hvor du arbejder med administration og økonomi i praksis? Trives du med struktur, koordinering og at få tingene til at hænge sammen? Så er du måske vores nye studentermedhjælper i Slots- og Kulturstyrelsens Fællesteam for ejendomsområdet.

Vi søger to studentermedhjælpere til teamet. I den ene stilling er der særligt fokus på administration og forvaltning, og den anden stilling har særligt fokus på økonomi og dataanalyse, men der vil være overlap i opgaveløsningen mellem de to stillinger.

Om jobbet

I bliver en vigtig del af teamet og får en bred opgaveportefølje.

Indenfor administration og forvaltning vil det være opgaver som:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser i ejendomsområdets digitale postkasser (Outlook) og lettere sagsbehandling

  • Koordinere møder og understøtte den daglige administration

  • Kvalitetssikre og behandle fakturaer.

Indenfor økonomi og dataanalyse vil det være opgaver som:

  • Udarbejde budgetopfølgning, økonomisk rapportering og ledelsesinformation

  • Indsamle, strukturere og analysere data

  • Administrere og følge op i forskellige digitale systemer. Fx Slots- og Kulturstyrelsens eget økonomistyringssystem

  • Følge op på aftaler, tidsregistrering og øvrige administrative processer.

Om dig

Fælles for begge stillinger er, at I er studerende på en relevant videregående uddannelse og har lyst til at omsætte teori til praksis. I arbejder struktureret og detaljeorienteret, og har en udpræget talforståelse og en analytisk tilgang.

I kan arbejde selvstændige, proaktivt og tager ansvar for jeres opgaver og samtidig yde god service til kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Derudover lægges der vægt på, at I:

  • Har flair for systemer og data, og derudover har sublime Excel-kompetencer

  • Har forståelse for, og trives med at følge procedurer og sikre ensartede arbejdsgange

  • Er nysgerrig og ikke bange for at stille spørgsmål

Vi tilbyder

I bliver en del af et team på 16 medarbejdere, som understøtter styrelsens ejendomsområde og ikke mindst områdets ledelse bestående af vicedirektør og fire kontorchefer.

Fælles for teamet er en høj faglighed og specialiserede kompetencer indenfor økonomi, projektledelse, udvikling af nye styringsværktøjer og processer, jura, udbud/indkøb samt ledelsesunderstøttelse i bred forstand såsom beslutningsoplæg, notater, budgetprocesser osv. I vil med andre ord have en bred berøringsflade og mange faglige sparringspartnere i en dagligdag præget af højt tempo og ambitionsniveau.

I får et spændende studiejob med stor variation i opgaverne, gode udviklingsmuligheder og indsigt i arbejdet med drift, økonomi og administration af nogle af Danmarks mest betydningsfulde ejendomme.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og HK/Stat. Arbejdstiden er gennemsnitligt 15 timer pr. uge med ansættelse hurtigst muligt.

Det er en betingelse for ansættelsen, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes, og at du kan opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under ansættelsen.

Hos os vil du få en arbejdsplads, hvor tilstedeværelse vægtes højt. Vi tror på værdien af at mødes fysisk – både for at løse opgaverne effektivt, for at kunne sparre og for at fastholde et stærkt fællesskab. Du skal derfor være indstillet på, at stillingen i høj grad er baseret på fysisk fremmøde på vores adresse i Hammerichsgade.

title: Vi söker en butiksmedarbetare till Flying Tiger Copenhagen, Göteborg Allum

title: Director, Transformation & Performance Management

Performance Management System

  • Extend the system to all sites and standardize it into a repeatable program.

Change Adoption

  • Own change adoption through a direct report, including SOP currency, training design, cutover and parallel-run readiness, and post-go-live adoption measurement.
  • Ensure each initiative meets its adoption targets before it is closed, and correct course when it does not.

Automation, Technology & AI

  • Lead the evaluation and deployment of technology solutions, from opportunity assessment and business case through vendor selection, solution design, go-live, and post-implementation ROI review, in partnership with Technology, Operations and Finance.
  • Identify where AI and advanced analytics create measurable operational value, and lead pilots accordingly.

Executive Support & Team Leadership

  • Prepare strategic planning and board-level materials for the executive team.
  • Lead, coach, and develop direct reports, including goal setting, documentation, and mid-year and annual reviews.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Track record of initiatives that were built, deployed, and sustained, not just recommended.
  • Strong analytical and problem-structuring skills; able to take an undefined problem and drive it to a decision.
  • Financial fluency sufficient to build and defend business cases to executive and board audiences.
  • Executive presence with excellent written and verbal communication; credible on the warehouse floor and in the boardroom.
  • Ability to lead through influence across functions where outcomes depend on others.
  • Working knowledge of how automation, advanced analytics, and AI are applied in an operating environment, including where they introduce risk rather than value.
  • Familiarity with warehousing, logistics, transportation, or supply chain is required.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; a concentration in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Analytics, Economics, or Finance is preferred. Advanced degree is a plus but not required.
  • 8–10+ years of experience leading strategic, transformational, or operational improvement initiatives, including 3+ years of people leadership. Relevant backgrounds include management consulting, corporate strategy, analytics, or operations transformation.
  • Experience leading an automation, robotics, WMS/WES, or comparable technology deployment from evaluation through go-live is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in warehousing, logistics, transportation, or a broader 3PL environment is preferred.
  • Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, A3 thinking, or other structured continuous improvement methods is a plus.

Work Environment

  • This role is hybrid and requires regular presence at RJW facilities and headquarters; the balance of remote and onsite time will flex with the demands of active initiatives.
  • The role requires meaningful time in warehouse, yard, dock, and other operational environments to observe processes firsthand, investigate issues, support implementations, and align with stakeholders.
